(def service-config
 ;; Note: This approach is not ideal and should be avoided in general. Each service
 ;; should hold it's own authorization policy directly within it's configuration.
 ;; Due to cyclic dependency issues, we have decoupled the authorization policy
 ;; from the component-service and moved it to a separate file. This workaround solves
 ;; the dependency problem but should not be considered a standard practice.
  (merge {:service :component-service}
         component-repo/unredacted-config
         component-auth/authorization-policy))

(defmethod authorization-service/action-authorized? [:component-service :create]
  [_ ctx {:keys [entity] :as op}]
  (or (application-privilege-service/has-privileges? ctx [::privileges/global-data-access])
      (authorization-service/has-permission? service-config
                                             ctx
                                             (authorization-service/->op :create entity))))

(defmethod authorization-service/action-authorized? [:component-service :partial-bulk-update]
  [_component-service ctx {:keys [entity] :as op}]
  (or (application-privilege-service/has-privileges? ctx [::privileges/global-data-access])
      (let [workspace-ids (util/fn-set :rootWorkspace entity)]
        (authorization-service/every-permission? ctx :update workspace-ids))))

(defn ensure-non-nil-persistent [component]
  (update component :ardoq-persistent (fnil identity {})))

(defn field-access->repo-config
  "Returns a component repo config that redacts confidential field values according to
  `field-access-context`.

  Use this when the caller has already decided which confidential fields may be read,
  rather than letting the read resolve that from the current user."
  [field-access-context]
  (->> (component-repo/create-redaction-hooks field-access-context)
       (merge component-repo/unredacted-config)))

(defn redacted-repo-config
  "'Redacted' in this context relates to Ardoq's Confidential Fields feature.

  When a global field is marked as confidential, we redact (nil out) the values
  of sensitive confidential fields that the user is not permitted to see on
  all components that are returned from a query.

  The query functions in this namespace all use redacted-repo-config.

  See: `component-repo/unredacted-config` for querying raw unredacted data, and
  `field-access->repo-config` for redacting against a caller-supplied field access
  context instead of the current user's."
  [ctx]
  (field-access->repo-config (field-permission-service/resolve-user-field-access-context ctx)))

(defn- install-cf-redaction-hooks
  "Installs Confidential Fields post-read & pre-write redaction hooks based on
  current CF handling mode. Queries DB for user's field access permissions."
  [component-service ctx]
  (if (field-permission-util/unrestricted? component-service)
    component-service
    (let [field-access-context (field-permission-service/resolve-user-field-access-context ctx)
          hooks (cond-> (component-repo/create-redaction-hooks field-access-context)
                  (field-permission-util/unrestricted-reads? component-service)
                  (dissoc :post-read-please-don't-use)
                  (field-permission-util/unrestricted-writes? component-service)
                  (dissoc :pre-write-please-don't-use))]
      (merge component-service hooks))))

(defn with-cf-redaction
  "Configures Confidential Fields (CF) redaction for the component-service.
  Sets redaction mode and installs post-read & pre-write hooks.

   Options:
     :reads  - :redacted (default) or :open
     :writes - :redacted (default) or :open

   Examples:
     (with-cf-redaction svc ctx)                              ; both redacted
     (with-cf-redaction svc ctx :reads :open :writes :open)   ; full bypass
     (with-cf-redaction svc ctx :reads :open)                 ; open reads, redacted writes"
  [component-service ctx & {:keys [reads writes]
                            :or {reads :redacted writes :redacted}}]
  (-> component-service
      (field-permission-util/with-cf-mode :reads reads :writes writes)
      (install-cf-redaction-hooks ctx)))

(defn- with-open-cf-reads
  "Configures Confidential Field redaction with open reads, preserving the
  caller's redactive write preference."
  [component-service ctx]
  (if (field-permission-util/unrestricted-writes? component-service)
    (with-cf-redaction component-service ctx :reads :open :writes :open)
    (with-cf-redaction component-service ctx :reads :open :writes :redacted)))

(defn pre-create [component]
  (->> component
       (component-repo/remove-deps)
       (ensure-non-nil-persistent)))

(defn descendants!
  "Return all the components in tree rooted at the component with id
  `root-id`. "
  [ctx root-id]
  (loop [todo (->> (component-repo/children root-id)
                   (entity/query! component-repo/unredacted-config ctx)
                   set
                   medley/queue)
         done #{}]
    (if-let [next-component (peek todo)]
      (recur (->> next-component
                  core/id
                  component-repo/children
                  (entity/query! component-repo/unredacted-config ctx)
                  set
                  (into (pop todo)))
             (conj done next-component))
      done)))

(defn include-parents
  "Returns the original collection extended with all components recursively reachable
   via the parent relation - parents, grandparents etc

   An optional `exclude-parents-of` collection may be provided. This is a collection of
   component ids whose parents should be excluded from the computation. This allows for us to
   compute the reachable parents for a set of components with respect to a *potential* change in
   the system.

   Example:
   Assume the state in the DB is a follows
     C1.parent = C10
     C2.parent = C20
     C3.parent = C30
   The user want to make the following change:
     C1.parent = nil
     C2.parent = C200
     C3.parent = C30 (remains unchanged)
   We want to find all recursively reachable components with respect to this potential change.

   (include-parents ctx [C1,C2,C3,C200] {:exclude-parents-of [(:_id C1),(:_id C2)]})
   "
  ([ctx components] (include-parents ctx components {}))
  ([ctx components {:keys [exclude-parents-of]}]
   (let [exclude-parents-of-set (set exclude-parents-of)
         comp-ids (core/id-set components)]
     (trace-service/with-span! ::include-parents (count comp-ids)
       (loop [components-batch components
              parents {}]
         (let [parents-batch-ids
               (->> components-batch
                    (into #{}
                          (comp (filter #(not (contains? exclude-parents-of-set (core/id %))))
                                (keep :parent)
                                (remove (set (keys parents)))
                                (remove comp-ids))))]
           (if (empty? parents-batch-ids)
             (doall (into components (vals parents)))
             (let [parents-batch (entity/query! component-repo/unredacted-config
                                                ctx
                                                (pq/by-ids parents-batch-ids))]
               (recur parents-batch
                      (merge parents
                             (core/by-id parents-batch)))))))))))

(defn resolve-parents [id->component components]
  (let [ancestors (loop [unresolved (set (keep :parent components))
                         resolved-parents #{}]
                    (let [parents (map id->component unresolved)
                          more-work (set (keep :parent parents))]
                      (if (seq more-work)
                        (recur more-work (into resolved-parents parents))
                        (into resolved-parents parents))))]
    (util/set* components ancestors)))

(defn- add-model-if-missing
  [workspace-model {wid :rootWorkspace :as component}]
  (if workspace-model
    (assoc component :model (str workspace-model))
    (client-utils/throw ::client-utils/component-exception {:message (str "Workspace <" wid "> doesn't exist!")})))

(defn- components->workspace-models!
  [ctx components]
  (core/index-by core/id :componentModel (entity/query! workspace-repo/config ctx
                                                        (pq/by-ids (map :rootWorkspace components))
                                                        [:_id :componentModel])))

(defn- add-component-models! [ctx components]
  (let [id->workspace-model (components->workspace-models! ctx components)]
    (map (fn [{wid :rootWorkspace :as component}]
           (add-model-if-missing (get id->workspace-model wid) component))
         components)))

(defn add-references [ctx component]
  (assoc component
         :references
         {:out (->> (reference-repo/by-source-id (core/id component))
                    (entity/query! reference-repo/config ctx)
                    (authorization-service/filter-authorized reference-service/service-config
                                                             ctx
                                                             :read))
          :in (->> (reference-repo/by-target-id (core/id component))
                   (entity/query! reference-repo/config ctx)
                   (authorization-service/filter-authorized reference-service/service-config
                                                            ctx
                                                            :read))}))

(defn paginated-query!
  ([ctx query sort-options from size] (paginated-query! ctx query sort-options from size nil))
  ([ctx query sort-options from size fields]
   (let [aggregate-query (component-repo/recent-by-query query sort-options from size
                                                         (or fields postgres/all-columns))]
     (repo/entity-query! (redacted-repo-config ctx) ctx aggregate-query))))

(def component-defaults {:parent nil
                         :description nil})

(defn- _order!
  "Add the `_order` value to multiple components in the same workspace.
  Will overwrite existing _order values."
  [ctx workspace-id components]
  (let [parent-ids (map :parent components)
        query (component-repo/siblings workspace-id parent-ids)
        siblings (entity/query! component-repo/unredacted-config ctx query [:_order :parent])
        by-parent (merge (into {} (map (fn [p] [p []]) parent-ids))
                         (group-by :parent siblings))
        order-by-parent (update-vals by-parent component-util/next-_order)]
    (:components
     (reduce
      (fn [{:keys [components next-order]} {:keys [parent] :as component}]
        (let [order (next-order parent)
              next-val (component-util/next-order-value order)
              component (assoc component :_order order)]
          {:components (conj components component)
           :next-order (assoc next-order parent next-val)}))
      {:components []
       :next-order order-by-parent}
      components))))

(defn- set-order!
  [ctx workspace-id components]
  (let [has-order (filter :_order components)
        needs-order (filter (complement :_order) components)]
    (into has-order (some->> (not-empty needs-order)
                             (_order! ctx workspace-id)))))

(defn generate-component-keys!
  "Generate `n` new component-keys in the workspace with
  `id` residing in `org-db`."
  [{:keys [track-service] :as component-service} ctx wid n]
  {:post [(= (count %) n)]}
  (if-let [{:keys [workspace-key comp-counter]}
           (repo/system-update! (repo/with-tracking workspace-repo/config
                                  track-service)
                                ctx
                                (pq/by-id wid)
                                (workspace-repo/inc-comp-counter-by n))]
    (let [comp-counter (inc comp-counter) ;inc to make the interval exclusive in both ends
          interval (range (- comp-counter n) comp-counter)]
      (map (partial str workspace-key "-") interval))
    (client-utils/throw ::client-utils/workspace-doesn't-exist [wid])))

(defn- set-component-keys [component-service ctx workspace-id components]
  (let [has-key (filter :component-key components)
        needs-key (filter (complement :component-key) components)]
    (if (empty? needs-key)
      has-key
      (into has-key (map (fn [key comp] (assoc comp :component-key key))
                         (generate-component-keys! component-service ctx workspace-id (count needs-key))
                         needs-key)))))

(defn- immutability-error
  "Returns a client error if `new-entity` violates a field immutability invariant
   relative to `stored`, nil otherwise. Covers rootWorkspace (component cannot be
   moved between workspaces) and component-key (immutable after creation)."
  [stored new-entity]
  (cond
    (and (contains? new-entity :rootWorkspace)
         (not= (:rootWorkspace stored) (:rootWorkspace new-entity)))
    (client-utils/error ::client-utils/component-can't-be-moved
                        {:componentName (:name new-entity)
                         :componentId (core/id new-entity)}
                        {:existing-ws (:rootWorkspace stored)
                         :new-ws (:rootWorkspace new-entity)})

    (and (contains? new-entity :component-key)
         (not= (:component-key stored) (:component-key new-entity)))
    (client-utils/error ::client-utils/component-key-can't-be-changed
                        {:expectedKey (:component-key stored)
                         :actualKey (:component-key new-entity)
                         :componentId (core/id new-entity)})))

(defn merge-components-processable? [{:keys [entity] :as op}]
  ;; This is shared by scenario service
  (let [{:keys [subsumed-component-ids subsumed-components merged-component-data
                stored-merged-component affected-read-only-field-kws]} entity
        all-used-comps (conj subsumed-components merged-component-data)
        rootWorkspaces (util/fn-set :rootWorkspace all-used-comps)
        typeIds (util/fn-set :typeId all-used-comps)
        resolved-subsumed-ids (core/id-set subsumed-components)
        immutability-error-instance (immutability-error stored-merged-component merged-component-data)]
    (cond
      (not= (set subsumed-component-ids) resolved-subsumed-ids)
      (client-utils/throw ::client-utils/cannot-merge-non-existant-ids)

      ;; Subsuming the survivor deletes it, and its subtree with it, right after the merge
      ;; has reported it as the updated component.
      (contains? resolved-subsumed-ids (core/id merged-component-data))
      (client-utils/throw ::client-utils/cannot-merge-component-into-itself)

      immutability-error-instance
      (client-utils/throw-if-error immutability-error-instance)

      (not= (count rootWorkspaces) 1)
      (client-utils/throw ::client-utils/cannot-merge-entities-in-multiple-workspaces)

      (not= (count typeIds) 1)
      (client-utils/throw ::client-utils/cannot-merge-entities-of-different-types)

      (seq (select-keys merged-component-data affected-read-only-field-kws))
      (client-utils/throw ::client-utils/cannot-merge-values-for-calculated-fields)

      (= (:parent merged-component-data) (core/id merged-component-data))
      (client-utils/throw ::client-utils/component-is-own-parent)

      ;; The surviving component's stored children come from the DB, so a survivor parented by
      ;; a subsumed component would be reparented onto itself when the subsumed are absorbed.
      (contains? resolved-subsumed-ids (:parent stored-merged-component))
      (client-utils/throw ::client-utils/cannot-merge-component-into-its-own-parent)

      :else
      op)))

(defn- circular-hierarchy-as-client-error
  [{:keys [entity new-entity] :as op} g id->scc-with-cycle]
  (let [id (or (core/id new-entity) (core/id entity))]
    (when-let [circular-hierarchy (some-> (id->scc-with-cycle id)
                                          (graph-util/scc->cycle g id))]
      (client-utils/error ::client-utils/grandfather-paradox [] {:name (or (:name new-entity) (:name entity))
                                                                 :hierarchy circular-hierarchy}))))

(defn- image-references-foreign-workspace?
  [{:keys [image rootWorkspace]}]
  (when-let [{:keys [resource-type resource-id]} (attachment-util/parse-image-uri image)]
    (and (= resource-type "workspace")
         (not= resource-id rootWorkspace))))

(defn immutability-errors
  "Returns a lazy seq of client errors for components in `new-entities` that violate
   immutability invariants (rootWorkspace, component-key). Takes `id->stored` — a map
   of entity-id → stored entity — so the caller can share the DB fetch with other
   operations (e.g. retain-read-only-field-values on the branch reset path)."
  [id->stored new-entities]
  (keep (fn [new-entity]
          (some-> (get id->stored (core/id new-entity))
                  (immutability-error new-entity)))
        new-entities))

(defn- processable-operation?
  [{:keys [action entity new-entity] :as op} transmuted-models workspaces parents hierarchy-graph id->scc-with-cycle]
  (case action
    :create
    (if-let [workspace (get workspaces (:rootWorkspace entity))]
      (let [parent (get parents (:parent entity))
            transmuted-model (get transmuted-models (:componentModel workspace))
            circular-hierarchy-error (circular-hierarchy-as-client-error op hierarchy-graph id->scc-with-cycle)]
        (cond
          (and (:parent entity) (not parent))
          (client-utils/error ::client-utils/parent-not-found
                              {:parentId (:parent entity)
                               :componentName (:name entity)
                               :componentId (:_id entity)})

          (not transmuted-model)
          (client-utils/error ::client-utils/component-has-no-model
                              {:componentName (:name entity)
                               :componentId (core/id entity)})

          circular-hierarchy-error circular-hierarchy-error

          :else
          (model-util/legal-hierarchy-error transmuted-model parent entity)))
      (client-utils/error ::client-utils/workspace-not-found {:workspaceId (:rootWorkspace entity)}))

    :update
    (let [transmuted-model (get transmuted-models (:model new-entity))
          parent (get parents (:parent new-entity))
          circular-hierarchy-error (circular-hierarchy-as-client-error op hierarchy-graph id->scc-with-cycle)
          immutability-error-instance (immutability-error entity new-entity)]
      (cond
        immutability-error-instance
        immutability-error-instance

        (not transmuted-model)
        (client-utils/error ::client-utils/component-has-no-model
                            {:componentName (:name new-entity)
                             :componentId (core/id new-entity)})

        (and (:parent new-entity) (not parent))
        (client-utils/error ::client-utils/component's-parent-doesn't-exist
                            {:parentId (:parent new-entity)
                             :componentName (:name new-entity)
                             :componentId (:_id new-entity)})

        (and parent (not= (:model parent) (:model new-entity)))
        (client-utils/error ::client-utils/component-parent-different-model
                            {:componentId (:_id new-entity)
                             :parentId (:parent new-entity)})

        (= (:parent new-entity) (core/id new-entity))
        (client-utils/error ::client-utils/component-is-own-parent)

        circular-hierarchy-error circular-hierarchy-error

        :else
        (model-util/legal-hierarchy-error transmuted-model parent new-entity)))

    :copy-components
    (let [workspace-count (->> entity (map :rootWorkspace) set count)]
      (if (not= workspace-count 1)
        (client-utils/error ::client-utils/copy-component-from-different-workspaces)
        op))

    :merge-components (merge-components-processable? op)

    op))

(defn- fetch-hierarchies!
  "Return `id->parent-id` map build of the batch-related entities from DB with applied hierarchy changes from `batch`.
   Can be used to observe hierarchy after applying the batch to DB. For example, to detect cycles."
  [ctx operations]
  (let [;; New components cannot introduce cycles in the hierarchy segments stored in DB.
        ;; We need to fetch from DB only info for updated components where parent is changed to non-nil value.
        stored-components-to-check (for [{:keys [entity new-entity]} (filter #(= :update (:action %)) operations)
                                         ;; when parent=nil, it cannot be a part of any cycle
                                         ;; when parent=old-parent, it cannot introduce a cycle
                                         :when (and (:parent new-entity)
                                                    (not= (:parent new-entity) (:parent entity)))]
                                     new-entity)
        starting-oids (-> (set/union (util/fn-set core/id stored-components-to-check)
                                     (util/fn-set :parent stored-components-to-check))
                          (disj nil))
        oid->parent (->> (when (seq starting-oids)
                           (component-service-hierarchy/descendants! ctx starting-oids))
                         (core/index-by core/id :parent))
        updated-components (->> (filter #(= :update (:action %)) operations)
                                (keep :new-entity))
        new-components (->> (filter #(= :create (:action %)) operations)
                            (keep :entity))]
    (merge oid->parent
           (core/index-by core/id :parent updated-components)
           (core/index-by core/id :parent new-components))))

(defn- get-parent-id->new-component [parent-ids operations]
  (->> operations
       (filter #(= :create (:action %)))
       (map :entity)
       (filter #(parent-ids (core/id %)))
       (medley/index-by core/id)))

(defn- apply-update-operations
  [operations components]
  (let [id->updates (into {}
                          (comp
                           (filter #(= :update (:action %)))
                           (map (fn [{:keys [entity new-entity]}]
                                  [(core/id entity) new-entity])))
                          operations)]
    (map (fn [parent]
           (if-let [updates (get id->updates (core/id parent))]
             (merge parent updates)
             parent))
         components)))

(defmethod crud-service/every-processable? :component-service
  [component-service ctx operations]
  (let [components (keep #(or (:new-entity %) (:entity %)) operations)
        id->workspace (some->> (keep :rootWorkspace components)
                               not-empty
                               pq/by-ids
                               (entity/query! workspace-repo/config ctx)
                               (medley/index-by core/id))
        id->transmuted-model (some->> (vals id->workspace)
                                      not-empty
                                      model-repo/by-workspaces
                                      (model-query-service/query! ctx)
                                      (map model-adapter/transmute)
                                      (medley/index-by core/id))
        parent-ids (set (keep :parent components))
        parent-id->new-component (get-parent-id->new-component parent-ids operations)
        parent-id->db-component (some->> (set/difference parent-ids (set (keys parent-id->new-component)))
                                         not-empty
                                         pq/by-ids
                                         (entity/query! component-repo/unredacted-config ctx)
                                         (apply-update-operations operations)
                                         (medley/index-by core/id))
        ;; `id->parent` includes only components referred as parents from `operations` (direct ascendants only)
        ;; `id->parent-id` includes components from `operations` and full their hierarchies (all ascendants/descendants)
        id->parent (merge parent-id->new-component parent-id->db-component)
        id->parent-id (fetch-hierarchies! ctx operations)
        hierarchy-graph (-> (medley/filter-vals some? id->parent-id)
                            graph-util/edges->digraph)
        id->scc-with-cycles (->> (for [scc (graph-util/scc-with-cycles hierarchy-graph)
                                       id scc]
                                   [id scc])
                                 (into {}))]
    (or (some (fn [op]
                (crud-service/unprocessable-response
                 (processable-operation? op id->transmuted-model id->workspace id->parent
                                         hierarchy-graph id->scc-with-cycles)))
              operations)
        true)))

(defmethod crud-service/processable? :component-service [component-service ctx op]
  (crud-service/every-processable? component-service ctx [op]))

(defn- components->parents!
  [ctx components]
  (if-let [parent-ids (not-empty (keep :parent components))]
    (->> (pq/by-ids parent-ids)
         (entity/query! component-repo/unredacted-config ctx))
    []))

(defn- components-created-metric [ctx components]
  (metrics-service/prometheus-org-metrics ctx)
  components)

(defn- components-deleted-metric [ctx]
  (metrics-service/prometheus-org-metrics ctx))

(defn- maybe-run-locally-derived-field-transformations
  [ctx transformations-done-by-someone-else? components]
  (if transformations-done-by-someone-else?
    components
    (let [fields (field-query-service/locally-derived-fields-applicable-to-components! ctx components)]
      (locally-derived-field-service/run-transformations-for-all fields components))))

(defn validate-image-on-create!
  "Rejects components with image values that don't conform to valid-id-based-attachment-uri? or that
   reference an attachment from a different workspace. Nil image is always allowed (no image set)."
  [components]
  (doseq [{:keys [image] :as component} components]
    (when (some? image)
      (when-not (specs/valid-id-based-attachment-uri? image)
        (client-utils/throw ::client-utils/invalid-component-image))
      (when (image-references-foreign-workspace? component)
        (client-utils/throw ::client-utils/component-image-references-foreign-workspace
                            {:componentName (:name component)}))))
  components)

(defn bulk-create-sans-events!
  [component-service ctx components]
  (trace-service/with-span! ::bulk-create! {:count-components (count components)}
    (let [redacting-component-service (with-open-cf-reads component-service ctx)]
      (->> components
           (map (partial merge component-defaults))
           (add-component-models! ctx)
           (model-service/resolve-component-types! ctx (components->parents! ctx components))
           (model-service/ensure-valid-fields-many! ctx nil)
           (crud-service/pre-bulk-create-default! service-config ctx)

           (group-by :rootWorkspace)
           (medley/map-kv-vals (partial set-order! ctx))
           (medley/map-kv-vals (partial set-component-keys redacting-component-service ctx))
           (reduce-kv (fn [acc _workspace-id components] (into acc components)) [])

           (maybe-run-locally-derived-field-transformations ctx false)

           (entity/create-many! redacting-component-service ctx)

           (component-deps/assoc-deps! ctx component-deps/default-deps)

           (hook-service/run-hooks! hook-service/hooks ctx ::hook-service/components-created)
           (components-created-metric ctx)
           doall))))

(defn- graph-updated!
  "Announce committed graph changes, returning `entities`. Quiet inside a transaction -
  the writes aren't committed yet, so its owner announces them instead."
  [ctx entities]
  (when (and (seq entities) (not (postgres/in-transaction? ctx)))
    (hook-service/run-hooks! hook-service/hooks ctx ::hook-service/graph-updated nil))
  entities)

(defn bulk-create!
  [{:keys [event-service] :as component-service} ctx components]
  (->> (bulk-create-sans-events! component-service ctx components)
       ;; events for different subscribers have different confidential field redaction
       ;; requirements, so we can't use redacted components here
       (event-service/publish-events! event-service ctx :create)
       (field-permission-service/redact-confidential-fields! ctx)
       (graph-updated! ctx)))

(defn create!
  [component-service ctx component]
  (validate-image-on-create! [component])
  (first (bulk-create! component-service ctx [component])))

(defn- coerce-components [component-service components]
  (trace-service/with-span! ::coerce-components (count components)
    (doall
     (map #(crud-service/coerce! (:spec component-service)
                                 (-> %
                                     (update :_id str)
                                     (metadata-service/without-metadata)))
          components))))

(defn find-parent-cycles! [{:keys [org-ds] :as ctx} components]
  (trace-service/with-span! ::find-parent-cycles! {:starting-count (count components)}
    (->> (group-by :rootWorkspace components)
         (medley/map-kv
          (fn [ws-id components]
            [ws-id (->> (component-repo/parent-cycle-paths ws-id (map core/id components))
                        (postgres/execute! org-ds)
                        (map :path)
                        (set))]))
         (medley/filter-vals not-empty))))

(defn- validate-image-on-update!
  "Rejects updates that change a component's image to an invalid or foreign-workspace attachment URI.
   Allows: nil (clearing), unchanged values (even invalid/foreign legacy from copies), valid new URIs."
  [id->db-component components]
  (doseq [{:keys [image] :as component} components]
    (let [old-image (:image (get id->db-component (core/id component)))]
      (when (and (some? image)
                 (not= image old-image))
        (when-not (specs/valid-id-based-attachment-uri? image)
          (client-utils/throw ::client-utils/invalid-component-image))
        (when (image-references-foreign-workspace? component)
          (client-utils/throw ::client-utils/component-image-references-foreign-workspace
                              {:componentName (:name component)})))))
  components)

(defn- validate-immutability-on-update!
  [id->db-component components]
  (some-> (immutability-errors id->db-component components)
          first
          client-utils/throw-if-error)
  components)

(defn bulk-update-sans-events!
  [component-service ctx components & [{:keys [skip-field-transformations?]}]]
  (trace-service/with-span! ::bulk-update! {:count-components (count components)}
    (if (empty? components)
      components
      (let [redacting-component-service (with-open-cf-reads component-service ctx)
            id->db-component (->> (pq/by-ids (core/id-set components))
                                  (entity/query! component-repo/unredacted-config ctx)
                                  (medley/index-by core/id))]
        (->> components
             (validate-immutability-on-update! id->db-component)
             (validate-image-on-update! id->db-component)
             (model-service/ensure-valid-fields-many! ctx id->db-component)
             (coerce-components redacting-component-service)
             (maybe-run-locally-derived-field-transformations ctx skip-field-transformations?)
             (entity/update-many! redacting-component-service ctx id->db-component)
             (component-deps/assoc-deps! ctx component-deps/default-deps)
             (hook-service/run-hooks! hook-service/hooks ctx ::hook-service/components-updated)
             doall)))))

(defn bulk-update!
  [{:keys [event-service] :as component-service} ctx components & [opts]]
  (->> (bulk-update-sans-events! component-service ctx components opts)
       ;; events for different subscribers have different confidential field redaction
       ;; requirements, so we can't use redacted components here
       (event-service/publish-events! event-service ctx :update)
       (field-permission-service/redact-confidential-fields! ctx)
       (graph-updated! ctx)))

(defn update! [component-service ctx component]
  (first (bulk-update! component-service ctx [component])))

(defn- chunked-bulk-delete*! [{:keys [reference-service] :as component-service} ctx deletable-ids]
  (let [[deleted-components
         deleted-references] (trace-service/with-span! ::chunked-bulk-delete*!-delete-by-query
                                                       {:to-delete-count (count deletable-ids)}
                               [(entity/delete-by-query! component-service ctx (pq/by-ids deletable-ids))
                                (->> deletable-ids
                                     (reference-repo/to-component-ids)
                                     (entity/delete-by-query! reference-service ctx))])]
    {:deleted-components deleted-components
     :deleted-references deleted-references}))

(defn- chunked-bulk-delete! [component-service ctx components]
  (->> (component-service-hierarchy/descendant-ids! ctx (core/id-set components))
       (partition-all pq/max-param-size)
       (map (partial chunked-bulk-delete*! component-service ctx))
       (apply merge-with into)))

(defn bulk-delete-sans-events!
  [{:keys [tag-service] :as component-service}
   {:keys [client-request-id] :as ctx}
   components]
  (trace-service/with-span! ::bulk-delete*! {:count-components (count components)}
    (postgres/with-transaction-on-org ctx
      (let [{:keys [deleted-components deleted-references]} (chunked-bulk-delete! component-service ctx components)
            deleted-ids (set/union (core/id-set deleted-components)
                                   (core/id-set deleted-references))
            updated-tags (tag-service/untag-many! tag-service ctx deleted-ids)
            summary {:clientRequestId client-request-id
                     :componentIds (map core/id deleted-components)
                     :referenceIds (map core/id deleted-references)
                     :updatedTags updated-tags}]
        (hook-service/run-hooks! hook-service/hooks
                                 ctx
                                 ::hook-service/components-deleted
                                 (set/project deleted-components [:_id :component-key]))
        (components-deleted-metric ctx)
        {:summary summary
         :components components
         :deleted-components deleted-components
         :deleted-references deleted-references
         :updated-tags updated-tags}))))

(defn bulk-delete*!
  [{:keys [event-service] :as component-service} ctx components]
  (let [result (bulk-delete-sans-events! component-service ctx components)]
    (->> (event-service/create-bulk-delete-event ctx :component
                                                 (:deleted-components result)
                                                 (:deleted-references result)
                                                 (:updated-tags result))
         (event-service/emit-many! event-service))
    (graph-updated! ctx (:deleted-components result))
    (select-keys result [:summary :components])))

(defn bulk-delete! [component-service ctx components]
  (:components (bulk-delete*! component-service ctx components)))

(defn delete! [component-service ctx components]
  (first (bulk-delete! component-service ctx [components])))

(defn on-workspace-deleted! [component-service ctx workspace-id]
  (->> (repeatedly #(entity/delete-by-query! component-service ctx
                                             [:in :_id (component-repo/delete-by-workspace-id-chunk-query workspace-id)]))
       (take-while not-empty)
       (mapcat identity)
       (doall)))

(defn copy [copy-ctx component new-workspace-key]
  (-> component
      (update :component-key #(str/replace-first % workspace-key-util/regex new-workspace-key))
      (medley/update-existing :image asset-copy-util/update-link copy-ctx)))

(defmethod asset-copy-util/copy-entity :component
  [{:keys [source-data workspace-key-map] :as copy-ctx}
   {:keys [rootWorkspace] :as component}]
  (let [{:keys [workspace-key] :as source-workspace} (->> (:workspace source-data)
                                                          (core/find-by-id rootWorkspace))
        new-workspace-key (get workspace-key-map workspace-key)]
    (copy copy-ctx component new-workspace-key)))

(defn descendant-ids-and-incident-reference-ids!
  "Given a component id set, find the descendant subtree ids and reference ids incident on those components

  NOTE: Returns incidence information _including_ the start set
  NOTE: Some of these ids may be ones the user can't see, they should either be filtered or obfuscated (e.g. a count)"
  [ctx component-ids]
  (let [descendant-id-set (set/union (component-service-hierarchy/descendant-ids! ctx component-ids)
                                     (set component-ids))
        reference-id-set-incident-on-descendants
        (->> (reference-repo/to-component-ids descendant-id-set)
             (entity/query! reference-repo/config ctx)
             core/id-set)]
    {:descendant-ids descendant-id-set
     :incident-reference-ids reference-id-set-incident-on-descendants}))

(defn subsumed-components-authorized?
  "True iff every id in `subsumed-component-ids` resolves under `ctx` AND every resolved
  component is one the caller can :merge-components. Unresolvable ids return false — we cannot
  authorize what we cannot see."
  [component-service ctx subsumed-component-ids]
  (let [distinct-ids (distinct subsumed-component-ids)
        resolved (->> (pq/by-ids distinct-ids)
                      (entity/query! component-repo/unredacted-config ctx))]
    (and (= (count distinct-ids) (count resolved))
         (authorization-service/every-authorized? component-service ctx :merge-components resolved))))

(defn ->merge-components-payload [merged-component-data subsumed-components]
  {:merged-component-data merged-component-data
   :subsumed-components subsumed-components})

(defn merge-components
  [{:keys [tag-service reference-service] :as component-service}
   ctx
   {:keys [subsumed-components merged-component-data] :as payload}]
  (let [component-ids-to-be-deleted (core/id-set subsumed-components)
        id-of-combined-component (core/id merged-component-data)
        tags-to-be-added (->> (tag-repo/by-components subsumed-components)
                              (entity/query! tag-repo/config ctx))
        children-that-need-adopting (->> (component-deps/children-by-parent!
                                          ctx component-ids-to-be-deleted)
                                         vals
                                         (apply concat))
        references-that-need-moving (-> (graph/->subgraph ctx component-ids-to-be-deleted)
                                        (subgraph/incident-edges)
                                        (subgraph/realize-edges!))
        redirected-references (->> references-that-need-moving
                                   (medley/distinct-by core/id)
                                   (map (fn [{:keys [source target] :as ref}]
                                          (cond-> ref
                                            (component-ids-to-be-deleted (str source))
                                            (assoc :source id-of-combined-component)

                                            (component-ids-to-be-deleted (str target))
                                            (assoc :target id-of-combined-component)))))
        combined-component-original-data
        (entity/query-one! component-repo/unredacted-config ctx (pq/by-id id-of-combined-component))]
    {:updated-references (if (seq redirected-references)
                           ;; need to use crud-service here to avoid circular deps
                           (crud-service/bulk-update! reference-service ctx redirected-references)
                           [])
     :new-parents (if (seq children-that-need-adopting)
                    (->> (pq/by-ids children-that-need-adopting)
                         (entity/query! component-service ctx)
                         (map #(assoc % :parent id-of-combined-component))
                         (bulk-update! component-service ctx)
                         (core/index-by core/id #(select-keys % [:parent :_version])))
                    {})
     :updated-component (update! component-service ctx (merge combined-component-original-data merged-component-data))
     :deleted-component-ids (do (bulk-delete! component-service ctx subsumed-components)
                                (core/id-set subsumed-components))
     ;; We tag last, because the delete step above will modify the same tags during delete. If we
     ;; did it before the delete step, the versions of the tags we return here will already be stale.
     :updated-tags (if (seq tags-to-be-added)
                     (tag-service/tag! tag-service ctx (core/id-set tags-to-be-added) :component id-of-combined-component)
                     [])}))

(defn preceding-versions! [ctx components]
  (query-service/preceding-versions! (redacted-repo-config ctx) ctx components))

(defn query!
  ([ctx q]
   (query! ctx component-deps/default-deps q))
  ([ctx deps-opts q]
   (let [redacted-repo-conf (redacted-repo-config ctx)]
     (->> (entity/query! redacted-repo-conf ctx q)
          (component-deps/assoc-deps! ctx deps-opts)))))

(defn query-one!
  ([ctx q]
   (query-one! ctx component-deps/default-deps q))
  ([ctx deps-opts q]
   (first (query! ctx deps-opts q))))

(defn count-by-type-in-workspace!
  "Counts the components rooted in `workspace-id`, grouped by `typeId`. Returns
   a `typeId->count` map; a type with no components is simply absent."
  [ctx workspace-id]
  (->> (component-repo/count-by-type-in-workspace workspace-id)
       (repo/execute! component-repo/unredacted-config ctx)
       (core/index-by :typeId :count)))

(defn ->workspace-id+type-id->count!
  [ctx workspace-id+type-id-pairs]
  (->> (repo/execute! component-repo/unredacted-config
                      ctx
                      (component-repo/count-by-workspace-id-and-type-id workspace-id+type-id-pairs))
       (core/index-by (juxt :rootWorkspace :typeId) :count)))

(defmethod query-service/query-one! :component-service [_ ctx q]
  (query-one! ctx q))

(defmethod query-service/query! :component-service [_ ctx q]
  (query! ctx q))

(defn query-simple!
  "Similar to `query!` but doesn't assoc deps with children,
  external docs or counts."
  ([ctx q]
   (query-simple! ctx q nil))
  ([ctx q fields]
   (let [redacted-repo-conf (redacted-repo-config ctx)]
     (->> (if fields
            (entity/query! redacted-repo-conf ctx q fields)
            (entity/query! redacted-repo-conf ctx q))
          (component-deps/assoc-deps! ctx {:types true})))))

(defn query-one-simple! [ctx q]
  (first (query-simple! ctx q)))

(defn- update-many! [component-service ctx id->db-component components]
  (let [redacting-component-service (with-open-cf-reads component-service ctx)]
    (->> (entity/update-many! redacting-component-service ctx id->db-component components)
         (component-deps/assoc-deps! ctx component-deps/default-deps))))

(defn- record-recalculation-time [time component]
  (assoc-in component [core/ardoq-field-name :persistent :last-recalculation-time] time))

(defn- ->field-values-with-derived-fields*
  [field new-values comp-id->field-value-overrides reactive-fields db-components]
  (let [comp-id->single-field->value (field-util/coerce-field-values field new-values)
        comp-id->field-value-overrides-updated
        (merge-with merge comp-id->field-value-overrides comp-id->single-field->value)
        updated-components (->> db-components
                                (field-util/merge-updates comp-id->field-value-overrides-updated)
                                (locally-derived-field-service/run-transformations-for-all reactive-fields))
        comp-id->original-component (core/by-id db-components)]
    (for [updated-component updated-components
          :let [comp-id (core/id updated-component)
                original-component (get comp-id->original-component comp-id)]]
      {:changed-fields (not-empty (util/map-difference updated-component original-component))
       :updated-component updated-component})))

(defn ->field-values-with-derived-fields!
  "Takes similar inputs as [[set-field-values!]] and returns
  `{:changed-fields {<field|_id> <value>}, :updated-component <whole comp.>}`, where changed-fields include any
  reactive fields that have a new value (i.e. depend on the changed value of `field`).

  It does not produce any side effects."
  [branch-ctx field new-values comp-id->field-overrides]
  (let [mainline-ctx (branch-context/->mainline-ctx branch-ctx)
        db-components (->> (pq/by-ids (map :entity-id new-values))
                           (query! mainline-ctx))
        reactive-fields (field-query-service/locally-derived-fields-applicable-to-components!
                         mainline-ctx db-components)]
    (->field-values-with-derived-fields* field new-values comp-id->field-overrides
                                         reactive-fields db-components)))

(defn set-field-values! [{:keys [event-service] :as component-service} ctx field new-values]
  (trace-service/with-span! ::set-component-field-values (count new-values)
    (let [comp-id->partial (field-util/coerce-field-values field new-values)
          ;; Read the current rows UNREDACTED. Recalculation may run as a user who cannot see
          ;; some confidential fields (e.g. an integration service account), but the recompute
          ;; must be independent of who triggered it: locally-derived fields have to be computed
          ;; from the real values (not CF-nils), and these originals are the source
          ;; `gather-custom-fields` uses to restore the confidential values the redacted write
          ;; path strips. A redacted read here would miscompute derived fields and wipe CF values.
          raw-db-components (entity/query! component-repo/unredacted-config ctx (pq/by-ids (keys comp-id->partial)))
          id->db-component (medley/index-by core/id raw-db-components)
          ;; NOTE: we have kept `assoc-deps` for backwards compatibility, but it's unlikely that
          ;; the downstream consumers rely on it. A problem for another day
          db-components (component-deps/assoc-deps! ctx component-deps/default-deps raw-db-components)]
      (->> db-components
           (field-util/merge-updates comp-id->partial)
           (maybe-run-locally-derived-field-transformations ctx false)
           (map (partial record-recalculation-time (:user-time ctx)))
           (update-many! component-service (repo/calculated-field-ctx ctx) id->db-component)
           (event-service/publish-events! event-service ctx :update)
           (hook-service/run-hooks! hook-service/hooks ctx ::hook-service/components-updated)
           count))))

(defn with-custom-field
  "Return a map from component _id to custom field value for the given `field`.

  (Faster than fetching the whole row.)"
  [ctx workspace-id component-types global-field]
  (when (seq component-types)
    (->> (entity/query! component-repo/unredacted-config ctx
                        (component-repo/by-workspace-id-and-type-ids
                         workspace-id component-types)
                        [:_id (pq/select-only-custom-field-name
                               (:name global-field) :custom-field)])
         (core/index-by core/id :custom-field))))

(defn id->type-name
  "Given a component-id, return its type name"
  [ctx component-id]
  (let [{:keys [typeId model]} (query-one! ctx (pq/by-id component-id))]
    (:name (component-type-service/query-one!
            ctx
            (component-type-repo/by-model-id-and-type-id model typeId)))))

(defmethod query-service/query-one-simple! :component-service [_ ctx q]
  (query-one-simple! ctx q))

(defmethod query-service/query-simple! :component-service [_ ctx q]
  (query-simple! ctx q))

(defn rename-custom-field!
  [component-service ctx old-name new-name]
  (->> (component-repo/rename-custom-field-query old-name new-name)
       (entity/execute! component-service ctx)))

(defn convert-custom-field-values!
  "When this runs, the `global-field` and all its instances have been updated in the DB.
   Updates the value of the field in all components according to the `old-value->new-value` fn."
  [component-service ctx global-field old-value->new-value]
  (let [attribute (-> global-field :name keyword)
        components-with-field (query! ctx (component-repo/has-field-with-some-value global-field))]
    (->> components-with-field
         (mapv #(update % attribute old-value->new-value))
         (entity/update-many! component-service ctx))))

(defrecord ComponentService [reference-service job-service]
  crud-service/ICrud
  (create! [service ctx entity]
    (create! service ctx entity))
  (update! [service ctx entity]
    (update! service ctx entity))
  (delete! [service ctx entity]
    (delete! service ctx entity))
  crud-service/IBulkCrud
  (bulk-create! [service ctx entity]
    (bulk-create! service ctx entity))
  (bulk-update! [service ctx entity]
    (bulk-update! service ctx entity))
  (bulk-delete! [service ctx entity]
    (bulk-delete! service ctx entity))
  query-service/IQuery
  (revisions! [_ ctx entity revisions]
    (query-service/default-revisions! (redacted-repo-config ctx) ctx entity revisions)))

(defn component-service [config]
  (map->ComponentService service-config))

(def ^:private allowed-searchable-reserved-fields
  ;; This is a map from component attribute name, to the parse fn and failure
  ;; error that converts a string to the corresponding value that is searchable in
  ;; the database
  {:name {:parse-fn pq/->sanitized-regex-query
          :failure-error ::client-utils/bad-type-value-in-component-search}
   :typeId {:parse-fn pq/->sanitized-regex-query
            :failure-error ::client-utils/bad-type-value-in-component-search}
   :parent {:parse-fn pq/->sanitized-regex-query
            :failure-error ::client-utils/bad-type-value-in-component-search}
   :model {:parse-fn pq/->sanitized-regex-query
           :failure-error ::client-utils/bad-type-value-in-component-search}})

(defn search [context workspace field-name value]
  (let [field-type (->> (global-field-repo/by-name (name field-name))
                        (global-field-service/query-one! context)
                        :type)]
    (->> (field-repo/->search-query allowed-searchable-reserved-fields field-name value field-type)
         (component-repo/by-field-value-in-workspace workspace)
         (query! context))))

(defn fix-component-images-post-copy! [ctx source-org-id target-org-id]
  (doseq [component (entity/query! component-repo/unredacted-config ctx pq/all)]
    (when-let [fixed-image (attachment-util/source->target-image
                            (:image component)
                            source-org-id
                            target-org-id)]
      (util/with-suppressed-errors
        (repo/execute! component-repo/unredacted-config ctx
                       (component-repo/set-image (core/id component) fixed-image))))))

(defn update-image-in-workspace-components! [ctx workspace-id old-image->new-image]
  (when (seq old-image->new-image)
    (repo/execute! component-repo/unredacted-config ctx
                   (component-repo/update-image-in-workspace-components workspace-id old-image->new-image))))

371	                                          (workspace-repo/by-model-id
372	                                           (core/id new-model)))]
373	    (let [ws-id (core/id workspace)
374	          id->old-image (into {}
375	                              (map (juxt :id :image))
376	                              (model-util/component-entries old-model))
377	          changed-to-foreign?
378	          (fn [{:keys [id image]}]
379	            (and (some? image)
380	                 (not= image (id->old-image id))
381	                 (image-references-foreign-workspace? ws-id image)))
382	          foreign (->> (model-util/component-entries new-model)
383	                       (filter changed-to-foreign?))]
384	      (when (seq foreign)
385	        (client-utils/throw
386	         ::client-utils/component-type-image-references-foreign-workspace
387	         {:typeName (->> foreign (map :name)
388	                         (str/join ", "))})))))
389	
390	(defn update! [{:keys [event-service] :as model-service} ctx model]
391	  (pg/with-transaction-on-org ctx
392	    (let [old-model (->> (pq/by-id (core/id model))
393	                         (entity/query-one! model-repo/config ctx))
394	          errors (verify-valid-model-change ctx old-model model)]
395	      (when (seq errors) (client-utils/throw ::client-utils/invalid-model nil {:errors errors}))
396	      (model-util/validate-model model)
397	      (validate-component-type-images! ctx old-model model)
398	      (hook-service/run-hooks! hook-service/hooks ctx ::hook-service/model-updated model)
399	      (->> model
400	           (util/prune-keys ::model-repo/model)
401	           (crud-service/default-update! service-config ctx)
402	           (trigger-after-model-but-before-types-updated-hook! ctx old-model)
403	           (trigger-after-model-updated-hook! ctx old-model)
404	           (event-service/publish-event! event-service ctx :update)))))
405	
406	(defn delete! [{:keys [event-service] :as model-service} ctx model]
407	  (when (and (branch-context/on-master? ctx)
408	             (not (model-util/template? model)))
409	    (log/error (Exception.) "Models shouldn't be deleted on their own."))
410	  (let [workspaces (->> model
411	                        core/id
412	                        workspace-repo/by-model-id
413	                        (entity/count! workspace-repo/config ctx))]
414	    (when (and (branch-context/on-master? ctx)
415	               (not (zero? workspaces)))
416	      (client-utils/throw
417	       ::client-utils/conflict [(str "Model is in use by workspace(s): " workspaces)]))
418	    (hook-service/run-hooks! hook-service/hooks ctx ::hook-service/model-deleted model)
419	    (crud-service/default-delete! model-service ctx model)
420	    (when (model-util/template? model)
421	      (entity/delete! model-template-repo/config ctx (core/id model)))
422	    (hook-service/run-hooks! hook-service/hooks ctx ::hook-service/after-model-deleted model)
423	    (event-service/publish-event! event-service ctx :delete model)))

430	                                 (if-let [[image image-link] (and (attachment? node) node)]
431	                                   [image (asset-copy-util/update-link image-link copy-ctx)]
432	                                   node))

(ns ardoq.service.model-service
  (:require
   [ardoq.client.client-utils :as client-utils]
   [ardoq.core :as core]
   [ardoq.logger :as log]
   [ardoq.persistence.component-repo :as component-repo]
   [ardoq.persistence.component-type-repo :as component-type-repo]
   [ardoq.persistence.field-repo :as field-repo]
   [ardoq.persistence.global-field-repo :as global-field-repo]
   [ardoq.persistence.model-repo :as model-repo]
   [ardoq.persistence.model-template-repo :as model-template-repo]
   [ardoq.persistence.postgres-entity :as entity]
   [ardoq.persistence.postgres-repo :as repo]
   [ardoq.persistence.postgres.branch.context :as branch-context]
   [ardoq.persistence.postgres.postgres :as pg]
   [ardoq.persistence.postgres.postgres-query :as pq]
   [ardoq.persistence.reference-repo :as reference-repo]
   [ardoq.persistence.reference-type-repo :as reference-type-repo]
   [ardoq.persistence.workspace-repo :as workspace-repo]
   [ardoq.service.authorization-service :as authorization-service]
   [ardoq.service.crud-service :as crud-service]
   [ardoq.service.event-service :as event-service]
   [ardoq.service.field-query-service :as field-query-service]
   [ardoq.service.global-field-service :as global-field-service]
   [ardoq.service.hook-service :as hook-service]
   [ardoq.service.model-query-service :as model-query-service]
   [ardoq.service.query-service :as query-service]
   [ardoq.service.trace-service :as trace-service]
   [ardoq.utils :as util]
   [ardoq.utils.asset-copy-util :as asset-copy-util]
   [ardoq.utils.attachment-utils :as attachment-util]
   [ardoq.utils.field-utils :as field-util]
   [ardoq.utils.model-adapter :as model-adapter]
   [ardoq.utils.model-utils :as model-util]
   [ardoq.utils.org-utils :as org-util]
   [clojure.set :as set]
   [clojure.walk :as walk]
   [medley.core :as medley]
   [superstring.core :as str]))

(defn by-workspace-ids [ws-ids]
  [:in :_id (workspace-repo/select-model-by-workspace-ids ws-ids)])

(defn- model->workspace-id-fn
  "Given a set of models, returns a new function which maps a
  model to its corresponding workspace id"
  [ctx entities]
  (let [related-workspaces (entity/query! workspace-repo/config
                                          ctx
                                          (workspace-repo/by-models (core/id-set entities))
                                          [:componentModel])
        model-id->ws-id (core/index-by :componentModel core/id related-workspaces)]
    (fn model->workspace-id [model]
      (get model-id->ws-id (core/id model)))))

(def service-config
  (merge model-repo/config
         {:service :model-service
          ::authorization-service/permission-holder-mapping-fn model->workspace-id-fn
          ::authorization-service/policy
          {:create authorization-service/writer+
           :read {::authorization-service/action-policy authorization-service/admin-or-custom
                  ::authorization-service/permission {:action :read}}
           :update {::authorization-service/action-policy authorization-service/admin
                    ::authorization-service/permission {:action :admin}}
           :delete {::authorization-service/action-policy authorization-service/admin
                    ::authorization-service/permission {:action :admin}}
           :admin {::authorization-service/action-policy authorization-service/admin
                   ::authorization-service/permission {:action :admin}}}}))

(defmethod authorization-service/action-authorized? [:model-service :read]
  [_model-service {:keys [org user] :as ctx} {:keys [entity] :as op}]
  (and (model-util/template? entity)
       (org-util/writer+? org user)))

(defn query-and-add-org-templates! [ctx q]
  (model-query-service/query-and-add-org-templates! ctx q))

(defn query-and-add-common-templates! [ctx q]
  (model-query-service/query-and-add-common-templates! ctx q))

(defn query-one-model-or-org-template! [ctx q]
  (model-query-service/query-one-model-or-org-template! ctx q))

(defmethod query-service/query! :model-service [_ ctx q]
  (model-query-service/query-and-add-common-templates! ctx q))

(defmethod query-service/query-one! :model-service [_ ctx q]
  (model-query-service/query-one-model-or-org-template! ctx q))

(defn- removed-comp-types [new-model old-model]
  (letfn [(comp-types [model] (set (keys (model-util/to-component-type-map model))))]
    (->> (set/difference
          (comp-types old-model)
          (comp-types new-model))
         (map name)
         set)))

(defn- ->model-id [ctx entity]
  (util/ensure!
   (:model entity)
   (str "Failed to find model on " (util/pp entity))))

(defn- ->workspace-id [entity]
  (util/ensure!
   (:rootWorkspace entity)
   (str "Failed to find workspace on " (util/pp entity))))

(defn- check-existing-instance-of-removed-comp-types [ctx new-model removed-type-ids]
  (for [type-id removed-type-ids
        :let [used-by (->> (component-repo/by-model-id-and-type-id (core/id new-model) type-id)
                           (entity/query! component-repo/unredacted-config ctx))]
        :when (seq used-by)]
    [(keyword type-id) {:type "cannot-delete"
                        :message "Unable to delete types that are already used by components"
                        :used-by (map core/id used-by)}]))

(defn- verify-valid-model-change [ctx old-model updated-model]
  (let [illegal-type-ids (removed-comp-types updated-model old-model)
        delete-used-type-errors (check-existing-instance-of-removed-comp-types
                                 ctx updated-model illegal-type-ids)]
    (some->> delete-used-type-errors
             (group-by first)
             (map (fn [[k v]]
                    {:type-id k :validation-errors (map second v)})))))

(defn model-usage [ctx model]
  (let [workspace (->> (workspace-repo/by-model-id (core/id model))
                       (entity/query-one! workspace-repo/config ctx))
        page-types (model-util/to-component-type-map model)]
    {:workspaces [(select-keys workspace [:_id :name])]
     :page-types
     (for [type-id (keys page-types)
           :let [used-by (entity/count! component-repo/unredacted-config ctx
                                        (component-repo/by-model-id-and-type-id (core/id model) type-id))]]
       {:id type-id
        :used-by-components used-by})}))

(defn extract-component-ids
  "Extracts all ids from a models component tree"
  [root]
  (if-not root
    []
    (mapcat (fn [[k v]] (conj (extract-component-ids (:children v)) k)) root)))

(defn- ensure-valid-fields!* [fields comp-or-ref]
  (field-util/ensure-valid-fields!
   (filter #(field-util/applicable? % comp-or-ref) fields)
   comp-or-ref))

(defn entity->read-only-field-kws! [ctx comp-or-ref]
  (let [workspace (entity/query-one! workspace-repo/config ctx (pq/by-id (->workspace-id comp-or-ref)))]
    (->> (global-field-service/query! ctx (global-field-repo/read-only-fields-for-workspace workspace))
         (map :name)
         (map keyword)
         (set))))

(defn- entities->fields-by-model-id! [ctx entities]
  (->> (map (partial ->model-id ctx) entities)
       (field-repo/by-model-ids)
       (field-query-service/query! ctx)
       (group-by :model)))

(defn ensure-valid-fields-many! [ctx id->old-entity entities]
  (trace-service/with-span! ::ensure-valid-fields-many! (count entities)
    (let [model-id->fields (entities->fields-by-model-id! ctx entities)]
      (doall
       (map
        (fn [entity]
          (let [fields (get model-id->fields (->model-id ctx entity))
                entity (field-util/ensure-read-only-fields-don't-change!
                        fields entity (get id->old-entity (core/id entity)))]
            (ensure-valid-fields!* fields entity)))
        entities)))))

(defn- components->models-by-id!
  [ctx components]
  (->> (pq/by-ids (map :model components))
       (entity/query! model-repo/config ctx)
       (map model-adapter/transmute)
       (medley/index-by core/id)))

(defn resolve-component-types!
  [ctx parents components]
  (let [model-id->model (components->models-by-id! ctx components)]
    (model-util/resolve-component-types model-id->model parents components)))

(defn reference-types-in-use
  [ctx model]
  {:model-id (core/id model)
   :types-in-use (->> (core/id model)
                      (reference-repo/by-model-id)
                      (entity/query! reference-repo/config ctx)
                      (map :type))})

(defn reference-types-to-be-removed-but-in-use
  [ctx model new-model]
  (let [types-in-use (set (:types-in-use (reference-types-in-use ctx model)))
        cur-ref-types (set (keys (:referenceTypes model)))
        new-ref-types (set (keys (:referenceTypes new-model)))
        types-to-remove (set (map #(Integer/parseInt (name %)) (set/difference cur-ref-types new-ref-types)))]
    (set/intersection types-in-use types-to-remove)))

(defn- validate-removal-of-reference-types
  [ctx model new-model]
  (if-let [types (seq (reference-types-to-be-removed-but-in-use ctx model new-model))]
    (client-utils/error ::client-utils/reference-types-can't-be-removed {:referenceTypes (pr-str types)})
    new-model))

;;todo: This validation should be considered a temporary fix until the handling of reference type keys
;;will be done on the backend.
(defn- validate-adding-reference-type
  [old-model {:keys [referenceTypes maxReferenceTypeKey] :as new-model}]
  (let [reference-type-add?
        (< (count (model-util/custom-ref-types old-model)) (count (model-util/custom-ref-types new-model)))]
    (if (not-empty referenceTypes) ; Ignore empty referenceTypes
      (let [new-reference-type-key (model-util/max-id-in-referenceTypes new-model)
            largest-reference-type-key maxReferenceTypeKey]
        (if (and reference-type-add? (not= new-reference-type-key largest-reference-type-key))
          (client-utils/error ::client-utils/reference-type-can't-be-added
                              {:newKey (str new-reference-type-key)
                               :largestKey (str largest-reference-type-key)})
          new-model))
      new-model)))

(defn validate-flexibility
  [ctx old-model new-model]
  (if (and (:flexible old-model)
           (not (:flexible new-model)))
    (let [transmuted-model (model-adapter/transmute new-model)
          workspace (->> (workspace-repo/by-model-id (core/id transmuted-model))
                         (entity/query-one! workspace-repo/config ctx))
          components (->> (component-repo/by-workspace workspace)
                          (entity/query! component-repo/unredacted-config ctx))
          violations (model-util/component-hierarchy-violations transmuted-model components)]
      (if (seq violations)
        (client-utils/error ::client-utils/model-cannot-be-converted-to-rigid
                            {:workspaceName (:name workspace)}
                            {:errors (map ::client-utils/errors violations)})
        new-model))
    new-model))

(defn- validate-consistent-type-ids [{:keys [referenceTypes root] :as model}]
  (or (reduce (fn check-id-consistency [_ [outer-id ref-spec]]
                (when (not= (parse-long (name outer-id)) (:id ref-spec))
                  (reduced (client-utils/error ::client-utils/inconsistent-use-of-id-in-model))))
              nil
              referenceTypes)
      (loop [todo (medley/queue (map vector (keys root)))]
        (if (empty? todo)
          nil
          (let [path (peek todo)
                current-id (name (last path))]
            (if (not= current-id (get-in root (conj path :id)))
              (client-utils/error ::client-utils/inconsistent-use-of-id-in-model)
              (let [children (keys (get-in root (conj path :children)))]
                (recur (into (pop todo)
                             (map (comp
                                   vec
                                   (partial concat path)
                                   (partial conj [:children]))
                                  children))))))))
      model))

(defn fix-images-in-model-post-copy! [ctx source-org-id target-org-id]
  (doseq [model (entity/query! model-repo/config ctx pq/all)]
    (let [link-update-fn (partial model-util/maybe-update-component-type-image
                                  source-org-id
                                  target-org-id)
          updated-model (model-util/update-component-types model link-update-fn)]
      (when (not= model updated-model)
        (util/with-suppressed-errors
          (pg/with-transaction-on-org ctx
            (repo/system-update! model-repo/config
                                 ctx
                                 (pq/by-id (core/id model))
                                 (model-repo/set-root (:root updated-model)))
            (hook-service/run-hooks! hook-service/hooks
                                     (repo/non-versioning-ctx ctx)
                                     ::hook-service/after-model-but-before-types-updated
                                     {:old-model model
                                      :new-model updated-model})))))))

(defn update-image-in-model-and-component-types!
  [ctx workspace-id old-image->new-image]
  (let [model (entity/query-one! model-repo/config ctx (model-repo/by-workspace-id workspace-id))
        image-update-fn (fn [{:keys [image] :as component-type}]
                          (if-let [new-image (old-image->new-image image)]
                            (assoc component-type :image new-image)
                            component-type))
        updated-model (model-util/update-component-types model image-update-fn)]
    (when (not= model updated-model)
      (pg/with-transaction-on-org ctx
        (repo/system-update! model-repo/config
                             ctx
                             (pq/by-id (core/id model))
                             (model-repo/set-root (:root updated-model)))
        (hook-service/run-hooks! hook-service/hooks
                                 (repo/non-versioning-ctx ctx)
                                 ::hook-service/after-model-but-before-types-updated
                                 {:old-model model
                                  :new-model updated-model})))))

(defmethod crud-service/processable? :model-service
  [model-service ctx {:keys [action entity new-entity] :as op}]
  (cond
    (= :update action)
    (client-utils/throw-if-error
     (util/pred->> (complement client-utils/error?) new-entity
       (validate-flexibility ctx entity)
       (validate-removal-of-reference-types ctx entity)
       (validate-adding-reference-type entity)
       (validate-consistent-type-ids)))
    (= :delete action)
    (do
      (when-not (model-util/template? entity)
        (log/error "Models shouldn't be deleted on their own"))
      entity)
    :else entity))

(defn gen-id [document]
  ;; we possibly need to set both id and version, but we'll only set version
  ;; when both :_id and :_version are nil, eg on a newly created doc
  (crud-service/maybe-gen-id (if (and (nil? (:_version document))
                                      (nil? (:_id document)))
                               (assoc document :_version 1)
                               document)))

(defn- trigger-after-model-but-before-types-created-hook! [ctx model]
  (hook-service/run-hooks! hook-service/hooks
                           ctx
                           ::hook-service/after-model-but-before-types-created
                           model)
  model)

(defn create! [{:keys [event-service] :as model-service} ctx model]
  (model-util/validate-model model)
  (pg/with-transaction-on-org ctx
    (->> model
         (util/prune-keys ::model-repo/model)
         (crud-service/default-create! service-config ctx)
         (trigger-after-model-but-before-types-created-hook! ctx)
         (event-service/publish-event! event-service ctx :create)
         (hook-service/run-hooks! hook-service/hooks ctx ::hook-service/model-created))))

(defmethod crud-service/gen-id! :model-service [model-service document]
  (gen-id document))

(defn create-and-add-id [model-service ctx data]
  (create! model-service ctx (gen-id data)))

(defn- trigger-after-model-but-before-types-updated-hook! [ctx old-model new-model]
  (hook-service/run-hooks! hook-service/hooks ctx ::hook-service/after-model-but-before-types-updated
                           {:old-model old-model :new-model new-model})
  new-model)

(defn- trigger-after-model-updated-hook! [ctx old-model new-model]
  (hook-service/run-hooks! hook-service/hooks ctx ::hook-service/after-model-updated
                           {:old-model old-model :new-model new-model})
  new-model)

(defn- image-references-foreign-workspace?
  [workspace-id image]
  (when-let [{:keys [resource-type resource-id]}
             (attachment-util/parse-image-uri image)]
    (and (= resource-type "workspace")
         (not= resource-id workspace-id))))

(defn- validate-component-type-images! [ctx old-model new-model]
  (when-let [workspace (entity/query-one! workspace-repo/config ctx
                                          (workspace-repo/by-model-id
                                           (core/id new-model)))]
    (let [ws-id (core/id workspace)
          id->old-image (into {}
                              (map (juxt :id :image))
                              (model-util/component-entries old-model))
          changed-to-foreign?
          (fn [{:keys [id image]}]
            (and (some? image)
                 (not= image (id->old-image id))
                 (image-references-foreign-workspace? ws-id image)))
          foreign (->> (model-util/component-entries new-model)
                       (filter changed-to-foreign?))]
      (when (seq foreign)
        (client-utils/throw
         ::client-utils/component-type-image-references-foreign-workspace
         {:typeName (->> foreign (map :name)
                         (str/join ", "))})))))

(defn update! [{:keys [event-service] :as model-service} ctx model]
  (pg/with-transaction-on-org ctx
    (let [old-model (->> (pq/by-id (core/id model))
                         (entity/query-one! model-repo/config ctx))
          errors (verify-valid-model-change ctx old-model model)]
      (when (seq errors) (client-utils/throw ::client-utils/invalid-model nil {:errors errors}))
      (model-util/validate-model model)
      (validate-component-type-images! ctx old-model model)
      (hook-service/run-hooks! hook-service/hooks ctx ::hook-service/model-updated model)
      (->> model
           (util/prune-keys ::model-repo/model)
           (crud-service/default-update! service-config ctx)
           (trigger-after-model-but-before-types-updated-hook! ctx old-model)
           (trigger-after-model-updated-hook! ctx old-model)
           (event-service/publish-event! event-service ctx :update)))))

(defn delete! [{:keys [event-service] :as model-service} ctx model]
  (when (and (branch-context/on-master? ctx)
             (not (model-util/template? model)))
    (log/error (Exception.) "Models shouldn't be deleted on their own."))
  (let [workspaces (->> model
                        core/id
                        workspace-repo/by-model-id
                        (entity/count! workspace-repo/config ctx))]
    (when (and (branch-context/on-master? ctx)
               (not (zero? workspaces)))
      (client-utils/throw
       ::client-utils/conflict [(str "Model is in use by workspace(s): " workspaces)]))
    (hook-service/run-hooks! hook-service/hooks ctx ::hook-service/model-deleted model)
    (crud-service/default-delete! model-service ctx model)
    (when (model-util/template? model)
      (entity/delete! model-template-repo/config ctx (core/id model)))
    (hook-service/run-hooks! hook-service/hooks ctx ::hook-service/after-model-deleted model)
    (event-service/publish-event! event-service ctx :delete model)))

(defn copy [model copy-ctx]
  (let [attachment? (fn [node] (and (coll? node)
                                    (= (first node) :image)
                                    (not (nil? (second node)))))
        update-attachment-link (fn [node]
                                 (if-let [[image image-link] (and (attachment? node) node)]
                                   [image (asset-copy-util/update-link image-link copy-ctx)]
                                   node))
        update-attachment-links (fn [model-root] (walk/postwalk update-attachment-link model-root))]
    (update model :root update-attachment-links)))
