517	                             :componentTypeIds (->> illegal-comp-types (map :id))})))))
518	
519	(defn legal-hierarchy-error
520	  "Returns boolean | client-utils/error"
521	  [transmuted-model parent component]
522	  (let [type-id (:typeId component)
523	        component-data {:component-id (core/id component)
524	                        :component-name (:name component)}]
525	    (if parent
526	      (let [parent-type (:typeId parent)]
527	        (cond
528	          (self-parent? component)
529	          (client-utils/error ::client-utils/model-violation-self-as-parent [] {:components component-data})
530	
531	          (not (legal-type? transmuted-model parent-type))
532	          (client-utils/error ::client-utils/model-violation-parent-not-in-hierarchy [] {:components component-data})
533	
534	          (not (legal-hierarchy? transmuted-model parent-type type-id))
535	          (client-utils/error ::client-utils/model-violation-parent-child-relationship
536	                              {:componentType (or type-id "no type id")
537	                               :parentType parent-type}
538	                              {:components component-data})
539	
540	          :else true))
541	      (or (legal-hierarchy? transmuted-model "root" type-id)
542	          (client-utils/error ::client-utils/model-violation-top-level-component-type [type-id] {:components component-data})))))
543	
544	(defn component-hierarchy-violations
545	  "Takes a model and a collection of components and checks that each component conforms to the model hierarchy.
546	   Assumes that the collection includes all parents.
547	   Returns a seq of client-utils/error, which is empty if no errors are found"
548	  [transmuted-model components]
549	  (let [id->parents (->> components
550	                         (map (comp str :parent))
551	                         (select-keys (medley/index-by core/id components)))]
552	    (->> components
553	         (map (fn [component]
554	                (let [parent (get id->parents (-> component :parent str))]
555	                  (legal-hierarchy-error transmuted-model parent component))))
556	         (filter client-utils/error?))))
557	
558	(defn ->comparator [children]
559	  ;; Closes over the children at this level in the model
560	  (fn [type-id-1 type-id-2]
561	    (let [comp-type-1 (get children type-id-1)
562	          comp-type-2 (get children type-id-2)]
563	      (if (and comp-type-1 comp-type-2)
564	        (compare (:name comp-type-1) (:name comp-type-2))
565	        Integer/MIN_VALUE))))
566	
567	(defn- order-component-types* [children]
568	  (into (sorted-map-by (->comparator children))
569	        (reduce-kv (fn [acc comp-id {:keys [children] :as comp-type}]
570	                     (let [maybe-updated (if (seq children)
571	                                           (update comp-type :children order-component-types*)
572	                                           comp-type)]
573	                       (assoc acc comp-id maybe-updated)))
574	                   {} children)))
575	
576	(defn order-component-types
577	  "Recursively orders model types by name rather than key hash"
578	  [model]
579	  (update model :root order-component-types*))
580	
581	(defn update-component-types
582	  "Recursively applies `f` on each component-type entry in the model"
583	  [{:keys [root] :as model} f]
584	  (letfn [(step [{:keys [children] :as comp-type}]
585	            (when comp-type
586	              (merge (f comp-type)
587	                     {:children (update-vals children step)})))]
588	    (assoc model :root (update-vals root step))))
589	
590	(defn maybe-update-component-type-image [source-org-id target-org-id component-type]
591	  (if-let [migrated-link (attachment-util/source->target-image (:image component-type)
592	                                                               source-org-id
593	                                                               target-org-id)]
594	    (assoc component-type :image migrated-link)
595	    component-type))
596	
597	(defn- type-name-delta [old-types new-types]
598	  (let [id->old-type (medley/index-by :id old-types)
599	        id->new-type (medley/index-by :id new-types)
600	        [deleted new retained] (data/diff (util/key-set id->old-type)
601	                                          (util/key-set id->new-type))]
602	    (->> retained
603	         (reduce (fn [acc type-id]
604	                   (let [old-name (get-in id->old-type [type-id :name])
605	                         new-name (get-in id->new-type [type-id :name])]
606	                     (if (= old-name new-name)
607	                       (update acc :unchanged conj new-name)
608	                       (-> acc
609	                           (update :changed conj old-name)
610	                           (update :old-name->new-name assoc old-name new-name)))))
611	                 {:unchanged #{}
612	                  :changed #{}
613	                  :old-name->new-name {}})
614	         (merge {:new (util/fn-set (comp :name id->new-type) new)
615	                 :deleted (util/fn-set (comp :name id->old-type) deleted)}))))
616	
617	(defn component-type-name-delta
618	  "Given an old and new version of the same model, return a diff of the component type names.
619	
620	   Delta is a map containing new, deleted, unchanged, and changed (old) names, and a map from
621	   old-name->new-name"
622	  [old-model new-model]
623	  (type-name-delta (component-entries old-model)
624	                   (component-entries new-model)))
625	
626	(defn reference-type-name-delta
627	  "Given an old and new version of the same model, return a diff of the component type names.
628	
629	   Delta is a map containing new, deleted, unchanged, and changed (old) names, and a map from
630	   old-name->new-name"
631	  [old-model new-model]
632	  (type-name-delta (reference-entries old-model)
633	                   (reference-entries new-model)))
634	
635	(defn type-names [model]
636	  {:component-type-names (component-type-names model)
637	   :reference-type-names (reference-type-names model)})
638	
639	(defn ->type-info [models]
640	  (merge (apply merge-with into {:component-type-names #{}
641	                                 :reference-type-names #{}} (map type-names models))
642	         {:type-name->types (->type-name->types models)
643	          :type-name->models (->type-name->models models)}))
644	
645	(defn- component-type->entry [ct]
646	  ;; needs to be in sync with `:ardoq.spec/component-entry`
647	  (-> ct
648	      (select-keys component-type-as-entry-keys)
649	      (assoc :children {})))
650	
651	(defn- reference-type->entry [rt]
652	  ;; needs to be in sync with `:ardoq.spec/reference-entry`
653	  (let [required (select-keys rt required-reference-type-as-entry-keys)
654	        optional (select-keys rt optional-reference-type-as-entry-keys)]
655	    (merge required
656	           (medley/remove-kv (fn [_k v] (nil? v)) optional))))
657	
658	(defn- recreate-root-from-component-types [component-types]
659	  (let [as-map-id (fn [ct] (-> ct :id str keyword))
660	        lookup (->> component-types
661	                    (map (fn [ct] [(:parent ct) (component-type->entry ct)]))
662	                    (reduce (fn [m [parent ct]]
663	                              (update m (some-> parent keyword) merge (hash-map (as-map-id ct) ct)))
664	                            {}))
665	        place-children (fn place-children [root]
666	                         (reduce (fn [new-root parent]
667	                                   (update-in new-root
668	                                              [(as-map-id parent) :children]
669	                                              merge
670	                                              (place-children (lookup (as-map-id parent) {}))))
671	                                 root
672	                                 (vals root)))]
673	    (place-children (get lookup nil {}))))
674	
675	(defn- recreate-referenceTypes-from-reference-types [reference-types]
676	  (zipmap (map (comp keyword str :id) reference-types)
677	          (map reference-type->entry reference-types)))
678	
679	(defn recreate-root
680	  "Create `root` from `component-types`.
681	
682	  Not fully optimized. Stack consuming proportional to the hierarchy depth!"
683	  [model component-types]
684	  (assoc model :root (recreate-root-from-component-types component-types)))
685	
686	(defn recreate-referenceTypes [model reference-types]
687	  (assoc model :referenceTypes (recreate-referenceTypes-from-reference-types reference-types)))
688	
689	(defn applies-to-type? [entity-type type-id field]
690	  (case entity-type
691	    :reference ((set (:referenceType field)) (str type-id)) ; ref. types are numbers
692	    :component ((set (:componentType field)) type-id)))
693	
694	(defn max-id-in-referenceTypes [{:keys [referenceTypes] :as model}]
695	  (if (seq referenceTypes)
696	    (apply max (map #(Integer/parseInt (name %)) (keys referenceTypes)))
697	    1))
698	
699	(defn helpfully-update-max-ref-types [{:keys [referenceTypes maxReferenceTypeKey] :as new-model}]
700	  (if (not-empty referenceTypes) ; Ignore empty referenceTypes
701	    (let [new-reference-type-key (max-id-in-referenceTypes new-model)]
702	      (cond-> new-model
703	        (> new-reference-type-key maxReferenceTypeKey) (assoc :maxReferenceTypeKey new-reference-type-key)))
704	    new-model))
705	
706	(defn helpfully-create-max-ref-types [{:keys [referenceTypes maxReferenceTypeKey] :as new-model}]
707	  (if (and (not-empty referenceTypes) (not maxReferenceTypeKey)) ; Ignore empty referenceTypes, don't set if already set
708	    (let [new-reference-type-key (max-id-in-referenceTypes new-model)]
709	      (assoc new-model :maxReferenceTypeKey new-reference-type-key))
710	    new-model))
711	
712	(defn force-max-ref-types-when-empty [{:keys [referenceTypes] :as new-model}]
713	  (if (empty? referenceTypes)
714	    (assoc new-model :maxReferenceTypeKey 2)
715	    new-model))
716	
717	(defn upsert-reference-types
718	  "Insert or update reference types in a model, by reference type id.
719	  Ensures that the model's :referenceTypes is a map of
720	  ids as keywords to normalized reference type entries.
721	
722	  For example,
723	
724	  {:5
725	   {:id 5
726	    :line 'dotted'
727	    :name 'Foo'
728	    :color 'black'
729	    :svgStyle 'stroke: magenta;stroke-dasharray:2'
730	    :lineEnding 'bottom'
731	    :returnsValue true}}
732	  "
733	  [model reference-types]
734	  (let [new-ref-type-entries (->> reference-types
735	                                  (map reference-type-util/->model-entry)
736	                                  (medley/index-by :id)
737	                                  (medley/map-keys #(-> % str keyword)))]
738	    (-> model
739	        (update :referenceTypes #(merge % new-ref-type-entries))
740	        (helpfully-update-max-ref-types))))

742	(defn delete-reference-types

744	  [model reference-types]

746	                                (util/fn-set :id)

(ns ardoq.utils.model-utils
  {:team "core"}
  (:require
   [ardoq.client.client-utils :as client-utils]
   [ardoq.core :as core]
   [ardoq.logger :as log]
   [ardoq.specs :as specs]
   [ardoq.utils :as util]
   [ardoq.utils.attachment-utils :as attachment-util]
   [ardoq.utils.model-adapter :as model-adapter]
   [ardoq.utils.reference-type-util :as reference-type-util]
   [clj-time.coerce :as coerce]
   [clj-time.core :as t]
   [clojure.data :as data]
   [clojure.edn :as edn]
   [clojure.walk :as walk]
   [medley.core :as medley]
   [superstring.core :as str]))

(def implicit-ref-type-id 2)
(def implicit-ref-type-key "2")
(def implicit-ref-type-name "Implicit")

(def is-parent-of-type-id 1)
(def is-parent-of-type-name "Is Parent Of")

(def is-parent-of-style {:color "black"
                         :line "solid"
                         :lineEnding "bothFilled"
                         :svgStyle "stroke: black;"})

(def is-parent-of-type (merge {:type is-parent-of-type-id
                               :name is-parent-of-type-name}
                              is-parent-of-style))

(def default-reference-style {:color nil
                              :lineEnding "both"
                              :lineBeginning "none"
                              :svgStyle "stroke;black;"
                              :line "solid"})

(def default-component-style {:color nil
                              :icon nil
                              :image nil
                              :shape nil})

(def required-component-type-as-entry-keys
  [:id
   :name
   :index
   :level])

(def optional-component-type-as-entry-keys
  [:icon
   :color
   :image
   :shape
   :standard
   :returnsValue
   :description])

(def component-type-as-entry-keys
  (into required-component-type-as-entry-keys
        optional-component-type-as-entry-keys))

(def required-reference-type-as-entry-keys
  [:id
   :name
   :line
   :color
   :lineEnding
   :returnsValue
   :svgStyle])

(def optional-reference-type-as-entry-keys
  [:lineBeginning
   :hasCardinality
   :index
   :standard])

(defn template? [model] (:useAsTemplate model))

(defn to-component-type-map
  "Returns a typeId->component-entry map.

  NOTE: This function changes the :children key of each component-entry to be a
  seq of component types, instead of the original map of typeId->component-entry
  for each child."
  [model]
  (when model
    (letfn [(flatten-model [nodes res]
              (if (empty? nodes)
                res
                (let [{id :id children :children :as node} (first nodes)
                      r (assoc res (keyword id)
                               (update-in node [:children]
                                          #(vec (map (comp name first) %))))
                      updated-children (map (fn [[_ i]] (assoc i :parent id))
                                            children)]
                  (flatten-model (concat (rest nodes) updated-children) r))))]
      (flatten-model (map (fn [[_ i]] (assoc i :parent nil)) (:root model)) {}))))

(defn component-type-maps
  "Returns a map of component id to that component's model type id to type name
   map."
  [models]
  (core/index-by core/id to-component-type-map models))

(defn to-reference-type-map [{:keys [referenceTypes] :as model}]
  referenceTypes)

(defn reference-type-maps
  [models]
  (core/index-by core/id to-reference-type-map models))

(defn model->type-maps
  [models]
  (merge-with merge
              (component-type-maps models)
              (reference-type-maps models)))

(defn custom-reference-type? [{:keys [id] :as reference-type}]
  (not= id implicit-ref-type-id))

(defn custom-ref-types [{:keys [referenceTypes] :as model}]
  (->> (vals referenceTypes)
       (filter custom-reference-type?)))

(defn gen-comp-id []
  (str "p"
       (+ (coerce/to-long (t/now))
          (rand-int Integer/MAX_VALUE))))

(defn entry-id
  "Get the id of a component or reference type.

  NB: Reference type ids are stored as ints, but will be returned as string
  for consistency"
  [entity]
  (util/str-some (:id entity)))

(defn name-and-id? [v]
  (and (map? v)
       (string? (:name v))
       (not (str/blank? (:name v)))
       (specs/component-type? (:id v))))

(defn name->reference-type [{:keys [referenceTypes] :as model} reference-type-name]
  (first (filter #(= (:name %) reference-type-name) (vals referenceTypes))))

(defn component-entries
  "Returns a set of all component entries found in `model`."
  [{:keys [root] :as model}]
  (loop [todo (vec (vals root))
         component-entries #{}]
    (if-let [{:keys [children] :as component-entry} (peek todo)]
      (recur (into (pop todo) (vals children)) (conj component-entries component-entry))
      component-entries)))

(defn model-entry
  "Get the entry in the model that describes `entity`.

  An `entity` can be either a component or a reference."
  [model entity]
  (if (contains? entity :source)
    (get-in model [:referenceTypes (util/->keyword (:type entity))])
    (core/find-kv :id (:typeId entity) (component-entries model))))

(defn ensure-type!
  "Return the type for the given entity. If not found will throw an IllegalStateException."
  [model entity]
  (or (model-entry model entity)
      (let [error-message (str "No type found for entity: " (util/pp entity))]
        (log/error error-message)
        (throw (IllegalStateException. error-message)))))

(defn type-name? [s]
  (and (keyword s)
       (re-matches (re-pattern "^p[0-9]+$") (name s))))

(defn ensure-id-and-key-are-equal [[k v]]
  (if (and (not= (name k) (:id v))
           (type-name? (keyword (:id v))))
    [(keyword (:id v)) v]
    [k v]))

(defn fixup-component-types [model]
  (update model :root
          #(walk/postwalk (fn [v]
                            (if (map-entry? v)
                              (let [k (key v)]
                                (if (type-name? k)
                                  (ensure-id-and-key-are-equal v)
                                  v))
                              v)) %)))

(defn bad-type-hierarchy?
  [model]
  (let [entries (volatile! #{})]
    (walk/postwalk (fn collect-entries [n]
                     (if (map-entry? n)
                       (let [[k v] n]
                         (if (and (type-name? k)
                                  (not= (keyword (:id v)) k))
                           (do (vswap! entries conj v)
                               n)
                           n))
                       n))
                   (:root model))
    (seq @entries)))

(defn root-component-entries
  [model]
  (->> (:root model)
       vals
       (filter name-and-id?)
       set))

(defn component-ids
  [model]
  (->> model component-entries (keep :id) set))

(defn root-component-ids
  [model]
  (->> model root-component-entries (keep :id) set))

(defn component-type-names [model]
  (->> model component-entries (keep :name) set))

(defn reference-entries [model]
  (set (vals (:referenceTypes model))))

(defn reference-ids [model]
  (->> model reference-entries (keep :id) set))

(defn reference-type-names [model]
  (->> model reference-entries (keep :name) set))

(defn type-entries [model]
  (concat (component-entries model)
          (reference-entries model)))

(defn ->comp-type-id->type
  "Flatten component hierarchy into a map.

  Maintains `id` as a string."
  [model]
  (medley/index-by :id (component-entries model)))

(defn ->ref-type-id->type
  "Index reference types by `id` (numeric value)."
  [model]
  (medley/index-by :id (reference-entries model)))

(defn ->comp-child-id->parent-id
  "Map of component child-id -> parent-id.

  Maintains `id` as a string."
  [model]
  (->> model
       (->comp-type-id->type)
       (medley/filter-vals #(seq (:children %)))
       (mapcat (fn [[parent-id type-map]]
                 (for [[child-id] (:children type-map)]
                   [(name child-id) parent-id])))
       (into {})))

(defn ->type-name->model+types [models]
  (->> models
       (mapcat (fn [m]
                 (for [e (type-entries m)]
                   [m e])))
       (group-by (comp :name second))))

(defn ->type-name->models [models]
  (medley/map-vals #(map first %) (->type-name->model+types models)))

(defn ->type-name->types [models]
  (medley/map-vals #(map second %) (->type-name->model+types models)))

(defn flexible?
  "`true` when `model` is flexible, `false` when it's strict.

A strict model does validation (on links, possible children etc), a
flexible model only provides metadata affecting appearance."
  [model]
  (boolean (:flexible model)))

(def strict?
  "`true` when `model` is strict, `false` when it's flexible."
  (complement flexible?))

(defn affords-reference?
  "`true` when `model` already has the ability to display `reference`
  in a similar manner to `reference-model`."
  [model reference-model reference]
  (core/find-by-name
   (:name (model-entry reference-model reference)) (vals (:referenceTypes model))))

(defn extend-with-reference
  "Extend `model` with the model data from `reference-model`
  associated with `reference`."
  [model reference-model reference]
  {:pre [(and (model-entry reference-model reference)
              "Model matches reference")]
   :post [(and (affords-reference? % reference-model reference)
               "Model updated")]}
  (let [reference-type (get (:referenceTypes reference-model)
                            (util/->keyword (:type reference)))]
    (if (affords-reference? model reference-model reference)
      model
      (let [id (->> (keys (:referenceTypes model))
                    (map (comp edn/read-string name))
                    (reduce max (max implicit-ref-type-id
                                     (or (:maxReferenceTypeKey model) 0)))
                    inc)]
        (-> model
            (assoc-in [:referenceTypes (util/->keyword id)]
                      (assoc reference-type :id id))
            (assoc :maxReferenceTypeKey id))))))

(defn- duplicate-component-type
  "Return the first duplicate component type found in model"
  [model]
  (loop [todo (medley/queue (vals (:root model)))
         ctypes #{}]
    (let [next-entry (peek todo)
          ctype (util/->keyword (:id next-entry))]
      (cond
        (empty? todo) nil

        (contains? ctypes ctype) ctype

        :else (recur (into (pop todo) (vals (:children next-entry)))
                     (conj ctypes ctype))))))

(defn- drop-least-specific-entry [model component-type]
  (loop [paths (medley/queue (map #(vector :root %) (keys (:root model))))]
    (let [path (peek paths)]
      (if (= (util/->keyword (:id (get-in model path))) component-type)
        ;; medley's dissoc-in removes the map if it contains no keys,
        ;; but the model expects :children {} to indicate no children.
        (let [res (medley/dissoc-in model path)]
          (if (and (some #{:children} path)
                   (empty? (get-in res (butlast path))))
            (assoc-in res (butlast path) {})
            res))
        (recur (into (pop paths)
                     (map #(conj path :children %)
                          (keys (:children (get-in model path))))))))))

(defn- prune-component-entries
  "A component type can only appear in one place in the hierarchy.  If
  a conflict appears, we favor the more specific entry (the one
  appearing deeper in the hierarchy.)."
  [model]
  (loop [model model
         dupe? (duplicate-component-type model)]
    (if dupe?
      (let [updated-model (drop-least-specific-entry model dupe?)]
        (recur updated-model (duplicate-component-type updated-model)))
      model)))

(defn replace-component-types
  [component-model-entry
   old->new-types]
  (let [old->new-types (medley/map-kv (fn strings [k v]
                                        [(name k) (name v)])
                                      old->new-types)
        old->new-types (merge old->new-types
                              (medley/map-kv (fn keywords [k v]
                                               [(keyword k) (keyword v)])
                                             old->new-types))]
    (walk/postwalk-replace old->new-types component-model-entry)))

(defn extend-with-component-model-entry
  "Extend `model` with `component-model-entry`"
  [model
   component-model-entry]
  (let [component-type (keyword (:id component-model-entry))]
    (->> component-model-entry
         (assoc-in model [:root component-type])
         prune-component-entries)))

(defn component-type-name->type-id
  [model
   type-name]
  (:id (first (get (group-by :name (component-entries model)) type-name))))

(defn reference-type-name->type-id
  [model
   type-name]
  (let [lower-cased-type-names #{(util/lower-case-some type-name)}]
    (->> (reference-entries model)
         (medley/find-first (comp lower-cased-type-names util/lower-case-some :name))
         :id)))

(defn legal-model? [model component]
  (= (core/id model) (:model component)))

(defn legal-type? [transmuted-model type]
  (some? (get-in transmuted-model [:metadata type])))

(defn- available-types
  [{:keys [component-hierarchy flexible] :as transmuted-model} parent-type-id]
  (if-let [strict-available (get component-hierarchy (or parent-type-id "root"))]
    strict-available
    (when flexible
      (get component-hierarchy "root"))))

(defn- resolve-component-type
  [{type-id :typeId :as component}
   {parent-type-id :typeId :as parent}
   {:keys [metadata] :as transmuted-model}]
  (when-let [resolved-type-id (if type-id
                                (-> metadata keys set (get type-id))
                                (if-let [available-types (seq (available-types transmuted-model parent-type-id))]
                                  (let [type-id (first available-types)]
                                    (when (not= 1 (count available-types))
                                      (log/warn "Assigning random type to component:" type-id ", choosing first from " (util/pp available-types)))
                                    type-id)
                                  (client-utils/throw ::client-utils/no-available-child-type
                                                      {:componentType (:name (get metadata parent-type-id))})))]
    {:typeId resolved-type-id
     :type (get-in metadata [resolved-type-id :name])}))

(defn resolve-component-types [model-id->model parents components]
  (let [parent-id->parent (medley/index-by core/id parents)]
    (map
     (fn [component]
       (let [parent (get parent-id->parent (:parent component))
             model (get model-id->model (:model component))]
         (util/ensure! model (str "Model not found for component: " (some-> component (select-keys [:_id :rootWorkspace :typeId :model])) "Known models:" (keys model-id->model)))
         (merge component (util/ensure! (resolve-component-type component parent model)))))
     components)))

(defn legal-hierarchy?
  [transmuted-model parent-type-id component-type-id]
  (boolean (if (:flexible transmuted-model)
             (or (not component-type-id) (legal-type? transmuted-model component-type-id))
             (let [available? (available-types transmuted-model parent-type-id)]
               (when (seq available?)
                 (or (not component-type-id)
                     (available? component-type-id)))))))

(defn self-parent? [component]
  (if-let [parent-id (:parent component)]
    (= parent-id (core/id component))
    false))

(defn validate-component-hierarchy
  "If `model` is strict, ensure that either `component` can be a child of
  `maybe-parent` or that `component` is allowed at top-level."
  [model maybe-parent component]
  (if (flexible? model)
    []
    (let [parent-type-id (or (:typeId maybe-parent) "root")
          component-type-id (:typeId component)
          model-adapter (model-adapter/transmute model)
          metadata (:metadata model-adapter)
          parent-type-name (get-in metadata [parent-type-id :name])
          component-type-name (get-in metadata [component-type-id :name])
          not-legal-type? (not (legal-hierarchy? model-adapter parent-type-id component-type-id))]
      (cond-> []
        (not (legal-model? model component))
        (conj (client-utils/error ::client-utils/wrong-model-for-component))

        (self-parent? component)
        (conj (client-utils/error ::client-utils/model-violation-self-as-parent))

        (and not-legal-type? maybe-parent)
        (conj (client-utils/error ::client-utils/model-violation-parent-child-relationship
                                  {:componentType component-type-name
                                   :parentType parent-type-name}))

        (and not-legal-type? (not maybe-parent))
        (conj (client-utils/error ::client-utils/model-violation-top-level-component-type [component-type-name]))))))

(defn ensure-valid-component-hierarchy!
  "If `model` is strict, ensure that either `component` can be a child of
  `maybe-parent` or that `component` is allowed at top-level."
  [model maybe-parent component]
  (-> (validate-component-hierarchy model maybe-parent component)
      (client-utils/throw-if-present! ::client-utils/wrong-model-for-component)
      (client-utils/throw-if-present! ::client-utils/model-violation-self-as-parent)
      (client-utils/throw-if-present! ::client-utils/model-violation-parent-child-relationship)
      (client-utils/throw-if-present! ::client-utils/model-violation-top-level-component-type)))

(defn validate-model [model]
  (let [comp-entries-with-blank-names (->> model (component-entries) (filter (comp str/blank? :name)))
        ref-entries-with-blank-names (->> model (reference-entries) (filter (comp str/blank? :name)))]
    (when (seq comp-entries-with-blank-names)
      (client-utils/throw ::client-utils/model-component-type-name-not-blank
                          {:typeIds (->> comp-entries-with-blank-names
                                         (util/fn-set :id)
                                         (map name)
                                         (sort)
                                         (str/join ", "))}
                          {:componentTypeIds (->> comp-entries-with-blank-names (map :id))}))
    (when (seq ref-entries-with-blank-names)
      (client-utils/throw ::client-utils/model-reference-type-name-not-blank
                          {:typeIds (->> ref-entries-with-blank-names
                                         (util/fn-set :id)
                                         (sort)
                                         (str/join ", "))}
                          {:referenceTypeIds (->> ref-entries-with-blank-names (map :id))}))
    (let [illegal-ref-types (->> (reference-entries model) (filter #(str/starts-with? (get % :name "") "~")) seq)
          illegal-comp-types (->> (component-entries model) (filter #(str/starts-with? (get % :name "") "~")) seq)]
      ;; ARD-23989: Gremlin does not support "labels" starting with "~", as these are considered internal/hidden
      (when (or illegal-ref-types illegal-comp-types)
        (client-utils/throw ::client-utils/model-type-name-not-tilde-at-start
                            {:typeNames (->> (concat illegal-ref-types illegal-comp-types)
                                             (util/fn-set :name)
                                             (sort)
                                             (str/join ", "))}
                            {:referenceTypeIds (->> illegal-ref-types (map :id))
                             :componentTypeIds (->> illegal-comp-types (map :id))})))))

(defn legal-hierarchy-error
  "Returns boolean | client-utils/error"
  [transmuted-model parent component]
  (let [type-id (:typeId component)
        component-data {:component-id (core/id component)
                        :component-name (:name component)}]
    (if parent
      (let [parent-type (:typeId parent)]
        (cond
          (self-parent? component)
          (client-utils/error ::client-utils/model-violation-self-as-parent [] {:components component-data})

          (not (legal-type? transmuted-model parent-type))
          (client-utils/error ::client-utils/model-violation-parent-not-in-hierarchy [] {:components component-data})

          (not (legal-hierarchy? transmuted-model parent-type type-id))
          (client-utils/error ::client-utils/model-violation-parent-child-relationship
                              {:componentType (or type-id "no type id")
                               :parentType parent-type}
                              {:components component-data})

          :else true))
      (or (legal-hierarchy? transmuted-model "root" type-id)
          (client-utils/error ::client-utils/model-violation-top-level-component-type [type-id] {:components component-data})))))

(defn component-hierarchy-violations
  "Takes a model and a collection of components and checks that each component conforms to the model hierarchy.
   Assumes that the collection includes all parents.
   Returns a seq of client-utils/error, which is empty if no errors are found"
  [transmuted-model components]
  (let [id->parents (->> components
                         (map (comp str :parent))
                         (select-keys (medley/index-by core/id components)))]
    (->> components
         (map (fn [component]
                (let [parent (get id->parents (-> component :parent str))]
                  (legal-hierarchy-error transmuted-model parent component))))
         (filter client-utils/error?))))

(defn ->comparator [children]
  ;; Closes over the children at this level in the model
  (fn [type-id-1 type-id-2]
    (let [comp-type-1 (get children type-id-1)
          comp-type-2 (get children type-id-2)]
      (if (and comp-type-1 comp-type-2)
        (compare (:name comp-type-1) (:name comp-type-2))
        Integer/MIN_VALUE))))

(defn- order-component-types* [children]
  (into (sorted-map-by (->comparator children))
        (reduce-kv (fn [acc comp-id {:keys [children] :as comp-type}]
                     (let [maybe-updated (if (seq children)
                                           (update comp-type :children order-component-types*)
                                           comp-type)]
                       (assoc acc comp-id maybe-updated)))
                   {} children)))

(defn order-component-types
  "Recursively orders model types by name rather than key hash"
  [model]
  (update model :root order-component-types*))

(defn update-component-types
  "Recursively applies `f` on each component-type entry in the model"
  [{:keys [root] :as model} f]
  (letfn [(step [{:keys [children] :as comp-type}]
            (when comp-type
              (merge (f comp-type)
                     {:children (update-vals children step)})))]
    (assoc model :root (update-vals root step))))

(defn maybe-update-component-type-image [source-org-id target-org-id component-type]
  (if-let [migrated-link (attachment-util/source->target-image (:image component-type)
                                                               source-org-id
                                                               target-org-id)]
    (assoc component-type :image migrated-link)
    component-type))

(defn- type-name-delta [old-types new-types]
  (let [id->old-type (medley/index-by :id old-types)
        id->new-type (medley/index-by :id new-types)
        [deleted new retained] (data/diff (util/key-set id->old-type)
                                          (util/key-set id->new-type))]
    (->> retained
         (reduce (fn [acc type-id]
                   (let [old-name (get-in id->old-type [type-id :name])
                         new-name (get-in id->new-type [type-id :name])]
                     (if (= old-name new-name)
                       (update acc :unchanged conj new-name)
                       (-> acc
                           (update :changed conj old-name)
                           (update :old-name->new-name assoc old-name new-name)))))
                 {:unchanged #{}
                  :changed #{}
                  :old-name->new-name {}})
         (merge {:new (util/fn-set (comp :name id->new-type) new)
                 :deleted (util/fn-set (comp :name id->old-type) deleted)}))))

(defn component-type-name-delta
  "Given an old and new version of the same model, return a diff of the component type names.

   Delta is a map containing new, deleted, unchanged, and changed (old) names, and a map from
   old-name->new-name"
  [old-model new-model]
  (type-name-delta (component-entries old-model)
                   (component-entries new-model)))

(defn reference-type-name-delta
  "Given an old and new version of the same model, return a diff of the component type names.

   Delta is a map containing new, deleted, unchanged, and changed (old) names, and a map from
   old-name->new-name"
  [old-model new-model]
  (type-name-delta (reference-entries old-model)
                   (reference-entries new-model)))

(defn type-names [model]
  {:component-type-names (component-type-names model)
   :reference-type-names (reference-type-names model)})

(defn ->type-info [models]
  (merge (apply merge-with into {:component-type-names #{}
                                 :reference-type-names #{}} (map type-names models))
         {:type-name->types (->type-name->types models)
          :type-name->models (->type-name->models models)}))

(defn- component-type->entry [ct]
  ;; needs to be in sync with `:ardoq.spec/component-entry`
  (-> ct
      (select-keys component-type-as-entry-keys)
      (assoc :children {})))

(defn- reference-type->entry [rt]
  ;; needs to be in sync with `:ardoq.spec/reference-entry`
  (let [required (select-keys rt required-reference-type-as-entry-keys)
        optional (select-keys rt optional-reference-type-as-entry-keys)]
    (merge required
           (medley/remove-kv (fn [_k v] (nil? v)) optional))))

(defn- recreate-root-from-component-types [component-types]
  (let [as-map-id (fn [ct] (-> ct :id str keyword))
        lookup (->> component-types
                    (map (fn [ct] [(:parent ct) (component-type->entry ct)]))
                    (reduce (fn [m [parent ct]]
                              (update m (some-> parent keyword) merge (hash-map (as-map-id ct) ct)))
                            {}))
        place-children (fn place-children [root]
                         (reduce (fn [new-root parent]
                                   (update-in new-root
                                              [(as-map-id parent) :children]
                                              merge
                                              (place-children (lookup (as-map-id parent) {}))))
                                 root
                                 (vals root)))]
    (place-children (get lookup nil {}))))

(defn- recreate-referenceTypes-from-reference-types [reference-types]
  (zipmap (map (comp keyword str :id) reference-types)
          (map reference-type->entry reference-types)))

(defn recreate-root
  "Create `root` from `component-types`.

  Not fully optimized. Stack consuming proportional to the hierarchy depth!"
  [model component-types]
  (assoc model :root (recreate-root-from-component-types component-types)))

(defn recreate-referenceTypes [model reference-types]
  (assoc model :referenceTypes (recreate-referenceTypes-from-reference-types reference-types)))

(defn applies-to-type? [entity-type type-id field]
  (case entity-type
    :reference ((set (:referenceType field)) (str type-id)) ; ref. types are numbers
    :component ((set (:componentType field)) type-id)))

(defn max-id-in-referenceTypes [{:keys [referenceTypes] :as model}]
  (if (seq referenceTypes)
    (apply max (map #(Integer/parseInt (name %)) (keys referenceTypes)))
    1))

(defn helpfully-update-max-ref-types [{:keys [referenceTypes maxReferenceTypeKey] :as new-model}]
  (if (not-empty referenceTypes) ; Ignore empty referenceTypes
    (let [new-reference-type-key (max-id-in-referenceTypes new-model)]
      (cond-> new-model
        (> new-reference-type-key maxReferenceTypeKey) (assoc :maxReferenceTypeKey new-reference-type-key)))
    new-model))

(defn helpfully-create-max-ref-types [{:keys [referenceTypes maxReferenceTypeKey] :as new-model}]
  (if (and (not-empty referenceTypes) (not maxReferenceTypeKey)) ; Ignore empty referenceTypes, don't set if already set
    (let [new-reference-type-key (max-id-in-referenceTypes new-model)]
      (assoc new-model :maxReferenceTypeKey new-reference-type-key))
    new-model))

(defn force-max-ref-types-when-empty [{:keys [referenceTypes] :as new-model}]
  (if (empty? referenceTypes)
    (assoc new-model :maxReferenceTypeKey 2)
    new-model))

(defn upsert-reference-types
  "Insert or update reference types in a model, by reference type id.
  Ensures that the model's :referenceTypes is a map of
  ids as keywords to normalized reference type entries.

  For example,

  {:5
   {:id 5
    :line 'dotted'
    :name 'Foo'
    :color 'black'
    :svgStyle 'stroke: magenta;stroke-dasharray:2'
    :lineEnding 'bottom'
    :returnsValue true}}
  "
  [model reference-types]
  (let [new-ref-type-entries (->> reference-types
                                  (map reference-type-util/->model-entry)
                                  (medley/index-by :id)
                                  (medley/map-keys #(-> % str keyword)))]
    (-> model
        (update :referenceTypes #(merge % new-ref-type-entries))
        (helpfully-update-max-ref-types))))

(defn delete-reference-types
  "Delete reference types from model, by reference type id."
  [model reference-types]
  (let [reference-type-ids (->> reference-types
                                (util/fn-set :id)
                                (map util/->keyword))]
    (-> model
        (update :referenceTypes #(reduce dissoc % reference-type-ids))
        (helpfully-update-max-ref-types))))

(ns ardoq.service.crud-service
  "CRUD operations on an arbitrary entity.

  If you know the entity's type, prefer to use its corresponding service directly
  (e.g. `(component-service/create! ...)`). Only use this in a polymorphic contexts.

  Prefer to use the bulk operations (e.g. [[bulk-delete!]]) over repeated use of the single operations ([[delete!]])."
  (:require [ardoq.client.client-utils :as client-util]
            [ardoq.core :as core]
            [ardoq.persistence.postgres-entity :as entity]
            [ardoq.service.event-service :as event-service]
            [ardoq.service.metadata-service :as metadata-service]
            [ardoq.service.trace-service :as trace-service]
            [ardoq.utils :as util]
            [cheshire.core :as json]
            [clojure.spec.alpha :as spec]
            [clojure.walk :as walk]
            [superstring.core :as str]))

(defn maybe-gen-id [document]
  (cond-> document
    (nil? (core/id document)) (assoc :_id (core/gen-id!))))

(defn response-unprocessable?
  "Evaluates a response from `processable?`"
  [error-or-boolean-or-op]
  (or (false? error-or-boolean-or-op)
      (client-util/error? error-or-boolean-or-op)))

(defn unprocessable-response
  "Returns the `processable?` response if it indicates unprocessable, otherwise nil"
  [error-or-boolean-or-op]
  (when (response-unprocessable? error-or-boolean-or-op)
    error-or-boolean-or-op))

(defprotocol ICrud
  (create! [service ctx entity])
  (update! [service ctx entity])
  (delete! [service ctx entity])
  (rename! [service ctx id version new-name]))

(defprotocol IBulkCrud
  (bulk-create! [service ctx entities])
  (bulk-update! [service ctx entities])
  (bulk-delete! [service ctx entities]))

(defmulti gen-id! util/service->keyword)

;; service -> context -> op:map -> boolean | op | client-utils/error
;; dispatch function uses the service argument
(defmulti processable? util/service->keyword)

(defmethod processable? :default [service ctx operation]
  operation)

(defmulti every-processable? util/service->keyword)

(defmethod every-processable? :default
  [service ctx operations]
  (reduce (fn [acc operation]
            (if-let [unprocessable (unprocessable-response (processable? service ctx operation))]
              (reduced unprocessable)
              acc))
          true
          operations))

(def ^:private ^:const max-spec-err-str 1024)

(defn- truncate-strs [x]
  (walk/prewalk #(if (and (string? %) (> (count %) max-spec-err-str))
                   (format "%s...[%d chars more]"
                           (str/substring % 0 max-spec-err-str)
                           (- (count %) max-spec-err-str))
                   %)
                x))

(defn coerce! [spec entity]
  (let [coerced (spec/conform spec entity)]
    (if (= ::spec/invalid coerced)
      (let [error (spec/explain-data spec entity)
            error' (cond-> error
                     (> (count (str error)) max-spec-err-str)
                     (truncate-strs))]
        (client-util/throw ::client-util/malformed [(json/encode (str error'))] error'))
      coerced)))

(defmethod gen-id! :default [service document]
  (maybe-gen-id document))

(defn pre-create-default! [service-config _ document]
  (coerce! (:spec service-config) document))

(defn pre-bulk-create-default! [service-config ctx entities]
  (trace-service/with-span! ::pre-bulk-create-default! (count entities)
    (mapv (partial pre-create-default! service-config ctx) entities)))

(defn pre-update-default! [service-config _ document]
  (->> (-> document
           (update :_id str)
           (metadata-service/without-metadata))
       (coerce! (:spec service-config))))

(defn default-create!
  "Executes the default create, *only* using the postgres repo functions. This should
  be the default going forwards!"
  [service ctx entity]
  (->> entity
       (pre-create-default! service ctx)
       (entity/create! service ctx)))

(defn default-update!
  "Executes the default update, *only* using the postgres repo functions. This should
  be the default going forwards!"
  [service ctx entity]
  (->> entity
       (pre-update-default! service ctx)
       (entity/update! service ctx)))

(defn default-delete!
  "Executes the default delete, *only* using the postgres repo functions. This should
  be the default going forwards!"
  [service ctx entity]
  (->> (core/id entity)
       (entity/delete! service ctx)))

(defn default-rename! [{:keys [event-service] :as service} ctx id version new-name]
  (cond->> (entity/rename! service ctx id version new-name)
    event-service (event-service/publish-event! event-service ctx :update)))

;; TODO(ARD-10019): Implement for PSQL
(defn bulk-create-default! [service ctx entities]
  (mapv (partial create! service ctx) entities))

(defn bulk-update-default! [service ctx entities]
  (mapv (partial update! service ctx) entities))

(defn bulk-delete-default! [service ctx entities]
  (doall (filter some? (map (partial delete! service ctx) entities))))

(extend-protocol ICrud
  Object
  (create! [service ctx entity]
    (default-create! service ctx entity))
  (update! [service ctx entity]
    (default-update! service ctx entity))
  (delete! [service ctx entity]
    (default-delete! service ctx entity)))

(extend-protocol IBulkCrud
  Object
  (bulk-create! [service ctx entities]
    (bulk-create-default! service ctx entities))
  (bulk-update! [service ctx entities]
    (bulk-update-default! service ctx entities))
  (bulk-delete! [service ctx entities]
    (bulk-delete-default! service ctx entities)))

(ns ardoq.utils.model-adapter
  (:require [ardoq.persistence.model-repo :as model-repo]
            [ardoq.specs :as specs]
            [ardoq.utils :as util]
            [clojure.set :as set]
            [clojure.spec.alpha :as spec]
            [medley.core :as medley]
            [spec-tools.core :as st]))

(defn transmogrify
  "Turn a new model into an old one."
  ;; See the corresponding test namespace for an example of what this new model looks like.
  [{:keys [component-hierarchy metadata styles] :as adapted-model}]
  (letfn [(inline-styles-and-meta [styles metadata]
            (util/deep-merge styles metadata))
          (parent-id [{:keys [component-hierarchy] :as idealized-model} type-id]
            (reduce (fn child? [found? [parent-id children]]
                      (or found?
                          (when (contains? (set children) type-id)
                            parent-id)))
                    nil
                    component-hierarchy))
          (component-path [model type-id]
            (loop [path (list)
                   current type-id]
              (if-let [parent-id (parent-id model current)]
                (let [path (if (= parent-id "root")
                             path
                             (conj path :children))]
                  (recur (conj path parent-id) parent-id))
                (map keyword (conj (vec path) type-id)))))
          (create-component-hierarchy [model components-by-type-id component-hierarchy]
            (let [topologically-sorted-todo
                  (loop [result (medley/queue)
                         todo (medley/queue ["root"])]
                    (if-let [current (peek todo)]
                      (recur (into result (get component-hierarchy current))
                             (into (pop todo) (get component-hierarchy current)))
                      result))]
              (merge
               model
               (reduce (fn add-component-to-hierarchy [hierarchy type-id]
                         (let [component-path (component-path model type-id)
                               level (->> component-path
                                          (remove #{:children})
                                          count
                                          dec)
                               component (-> components-by-type-id
                                             (get type-id)
                                             (assoc :level level :children {} :id type-id))]
                           (assoc-in hierarchy component-path component)))
                       {}
                       topologically-sorted-todo))))
          (reference-type-id? [type-id] (and (string? type-id)
                                             (number? (util/ignore-errors
                                                        (Long/parseLong type-id)))))
          (add-reference-types [model reference-entries]
            (assoc model :referenceTypes
                   (reduce (fn add-reference-type [acc [id reference-entry]]
                             (let [id (Integer/parseInt id)
                                   reference-entry (assoc reference-entry :id id)]
                               (assoc acc (util/->keyword id) reference-entry)))
                           {}
                           reference-entries)))]
    (let [denormalized-entities-by-type-id (inline-styles-and-meta styles metadata)
          reference-entries (medley/filter-keys
                             reference-type-id? denormalized-entities-by-type-id)]
      (-> adapted-model
          (create-component-hierarchy denormalized-entities-by-type-id component-hierarchy)
          (add-reference-types reference-entries)
          (dissoc :styles :component-hierarchy :metadata)))))

(spec/def ::component-metadata
  (st/spec (spec/keys :req-un [::specs/name
                               ::model-repo/returnsValue
                               ::model-repo/index
                               ::model-repo/standard])))
(spec/def ::reference-metadata
  (st/spec (spec/keys :req-un [::specs/name
                               ::model-repo/returnsValue]
                      :opt-un [::model-repo/index])))
(spec/def ::component-styles
  (st/spec (spec/keys :req-un [::specs/color
                               ::model-repo/icon
                               ::model-repo/image
                               ::model-repo/shape]
                      :opt-un [::specs/description])))
(spec/def ::reference-styles
  (st/spec (spec/keys :req-un [::model-repo/line
                               ::specs/color
                               ::model-repo/lineEnding
                               ::model-repo/svgStyle]
                      :opt-un [::model-repo/lineBeginning
                               ::model-repo/hasCardinality
                               ::specs/description])))

(defn transmute
  "Turn an old model into a new one"
  [model]
  (letfn [(flatten-component-hierarchy [model]
            (loop [todo (medley/queue (map (partial conj [:root]) (keys (:root model))))
                   model (assoc-in model
                                   [:component-hierarchy "root"]
                                   (set (mapv name (keys (:root model)))))]
              (if-let [path (peek todo)]
                (let [component-entry (get-in model path)
                      type-id (name (last path))
                      child-types (some->> component-entry
                                           :children
                                           seq
                                           keys
                                           (map name)
                                           set)
                      child-paths (mapv (partial conj (conj path :children))
                                        (map keyword child-types))]
                  (recur
                   (into (pop todo) child-paths)
                   (-> model
                       (util/assoc-some-in [:component-hierarchy type-id] child-types)
                       (assoc-in [:metadata type-id]
                                 (util/prune-keys ::component-metadata component-entry))
                       (assoc-in [:styles type-id]
                                 (util/prune-keys ::component-styles component-entry)))))
                model)))
          (normalize-reference-entries [model]
            (reduce (fn decomplect-styles-and-meta [model reference-entry]
                      (let [type-id (str (:id reference-entry))
                            styles (util/prune-keys ::reference-styles reference-entry)
                            metadata (util/prune-keys ::reference-metadata reference-entry)]
                        (-> model
                            (assoc-in [:styles type-id] styles)
                            (assoc-in [:metadata type-id] metadata))))
                    model
                    (vals (:referenceTypes model))))]
    (-> model
        flatten-component-hierarchy
        normalize-reference-entries
        (dissoc :root :referenceTypes))))

(defn- component-types [{:keys [component-hierarchy] :as adapted-model}]
  (set (into (keys component-hierarchy) (util/concat-vals component-hierarchy))))

(defn reference-type-name->id-map [adapted-model]
  (->> adapted-model
       :metadata
       (medley/remove-keys (component-types adapted-model))
       (util/map-kv-with util/parse-long! :name)
       (set/map-invert)))

(defn component-type-name->id-map [adapted-model]
  (->> adapted-model
       :metadata
       (medley/filter-keys (component-types adapted-model))
       (medley/map-vals :name)
       (set/map-invert)))

(defn component-type-id->parent-type-id
  "Returns a reversed component hierarchy, useful for finding the parent type
  of a component type id."
  [adapted-model]
  (->> adapted-model
       :component-hierarchy
       (reduce-kv (fn [acc parent-id child-ids]
                    (reduce (fn [acc child-id]
                              (assoc acc child-id parent-id)) acc child-ids))
                  {})))

(defn model->types-by-name
  "Return two maps: `component-type-name->style` and `reference-type-name->style`."
  [{:keys [styles] :as adapted-model}]
  {:component-type-name->style (-> (component-type-name->id-map adapted-model)
                                   (update-vals styles)
                                   (update-vals #(dissoc % :image)))
   :reference-type-name->style (-> (reference-type-name->id-map adapted-model)
                                   (update-vals #(styles (str %)))
                                   (update-vals #(dissoc % :image)))})

64	(defn- initialize-copy-context [context {:keys [componentIds parent targetWorkspace]}]
65	  ;; NOTE: For copying, it's essential that full unredacted components are loaded here
66	  (let [components (entity/query! component-repo/unredacted-config context (pq/by-ids componentIds))
67	        root-workspace-id (:rootWorkspace (first components))
68	        target-workspace-id (or targetWorkspace root-workspace-id)
69	        field-access-context (field-permission-service/resolve-user-field-access-context context)]
70	    {::components components
71	     ::parent (when parent
72	                (entity/query-one! component-repo/unredacted-config context (pq/by-id parent)))
73	     ::target-workspace (->> (pq/by-id target-workspace-id)
74	                             (entity/query-one! workspace-repo/config context))
75	     ::source-workspace (->> (pq/by-id root-workspace-id)

77	     ::field-access-context field-access-context}))

79	(defn copy-component-handler
80	  [{{copy-component-request :body} :parameters
81	    {:keys [component-copy-service component-service] :as system} :system
82	    context :ctx
83	    :as req}]
84	  (->> {:initialize-context (fn [_] (initialize-copy-context context copy-component-request))
85	        :processable? (fn [{:keys [::components]}]
86	                        (crud-api/processable? component-service
87	                                               context
88	                                               {:action :copy-components
89	                                                :entity components}))
90	        :allowed? (fn [{:keys [::source-workspace ::target-workspace ::field-access-context]}]
91	                    (and (crud-api/allowed? workspace-service/service-config context :read source-workspace)
92	                         (crud-api/allowed? component-service/service-config
93	                                            context
94	                                            :create
95	                                            {:rootWorkspace (core/id target-workspace)})
96	                         (workspace-overview/user-can-copy-with-confidential-fields? context
97	                                                                                     field-access-context
98	                                                                                     source-workspace)))
99	        :exists? (fn [{:keys [::parent ::target-workspace ::components] :as ctx}]
100	                   (let [parent? (:parent copy-component-request)
101	                         parent-exists? (if parent? parent true)
102	                         all-components-exist? (= (set (:componentIds copy-component-request))
103	                                                  (core/id-set components))]
104	                     (and parent-exists? all-components-exist? target-workspace)))
105	        :can-post-to-missing? false
106	        :post! (fn copy-component-post! [{:keys [::components ::target-workspace ::parent] :as ctx}]
107	                 {::result (component-copy-service/copy-components!
108	                            component-copy-service
109	                            context
110	                            target-workspace
111	                            components
112	                            parent
113	                            (some-> (:attachmentStrategies copy-component-request)
114	                                    (update-keys name)))})
115	        :handle-created (fn [{:keys [::result] :as ctx}]
116	                          (deliberator-util/ring-response
117	                           {:status 201
118	                            :body (liberator/serialize-json result ctx)
119	                            :headers {"Content-Type" "application/json"}}))
120	        :available-media-types ["application/json"]
121	        :respond-with-entity? true}
122	       (merge crud-api/resource-defaults)
123	       (liberator/run-resource req)))

167	(defn bulk-delete
168	  [component-service ctx component-ids req]
169	  (->> {:allowed? (fn [_]
170	                    (let [components (component-service/query! ctx (pq/by-ids component-ids))]
171	                      (when (authorization-service/every-authorized? component-service/service-config
172	                                                                     ctx
173	                                                                     :delete
174	                                                                     components)
175	                        {::crud-api/instance components})))
176	        :exists? (fn [{:keys [::crud-api/instance]}]
177	                   (let [nonexistent-components (set/difference
178	                                                 (set component-ids)
179	                                                 (set (map core/id instance)))]
180	                     (or (empty? nonexistent-components)
181	                         [false {:message (str "The following components do not exist:"
182	                                               (str/join ", " nonexistent-components))}])))
183	        :delete! (fn [{:keys [::crud-api/instance]}]
184	                   {::crud-api/instance (:summary (component-service/bulk-delete*! component-service ctx instance))})
185	        :respond-with-entity? true
186	        :handle-ok ::crud-api/instance}
187	       (merge crud-api/resource-defaults)
188	       (liberator/run-resource req)))

331	                          {:keys [component-service]} :system

336	        :allowed? (fn [_]
337	                    ;; Merging across workspaces is rejected in `:processable?` (the survivor

339	                    (when-let [surviving-allowed (crud-api/action-on-query-one-allowed?

348	                                         (component-service/query! ctx))]

353	                                            :entity {:merged-component-data merged-component-data

356	                                                     :subsumed-component-ids subsumed-component-ids

358	                                                     (model-service/entity->read-only-field-kws!
359	                                                      ctx merged-component-data)}}))
360	              {:subsumed-components subsumed-components})))
361	        :handle-ok (fn [{:keys [subsumed-components]}]
362	                     (component-service/merge-components component-service
363	                                                         ctx

365	                                                          merged-component-data

395	  "True when the request is a my_data request and the permissions prototype feature is on.
396	   Used as the `allow-readers-or-contributors?` route gate so the middleware write cap is
397	   only lifted when both conditions hold."
398	  [req]
399	  (and (my-data-request? req)
400	       (feature-service/enabled-in-org? (get-in req [:ctx :org])
401	                                        ::feature-service/access_tmp_person-in-graph-permissions-prototype)))
402	
403	(defn- my-data-update-allowed?
404	  "Whether a mode=my_data update is authorized: the caller may edit only
405	  owner-editable fields, and only on a component they own."
406	  [ctx traversal-service id partial-updates]
407	  (and (feature-service/enabled-in-org? (:org ctx) ::feature-service/access_tmp_person-in-graph-prototype)
408	       (my/partial-updates-allowed? traversal-service ctx id partial-updates)
409	       (crud-api/action-on-query-one-allowed? component-service/service-config ctx :read (pq/by-id id))))
410	
411	(defn- my-data-bulk-update-allowed?
412	  "Whether a mode=my_data bulk update is authorized: the caller may edit
413	  only owner-editable fields, and only on components they
414	  own. All-or-nothing — one disallowed component or field rejects the
415	  whole batch."
416	  [ctx traversal-service partial-bulk-updates query]
417	  (and (feature-service/enabled-in-org? (:org ctx) ::feature-service/access_tmp_person-in-graph-prototype)
418	       (when-let [components (seq (query-service/query! component-service/service-config ctx query))]
419	         (when (and (my/partial-bulk-updates-allowed? traversal-service ctx partial-bulk-updates)
420	                    (authorization-service/every-permission? ctx :read (util/fn-set :rootWorkspace components)))
421	           {::crud-api/instance components}))))
422	
423	(defn- partial-update
424	  [{{{:keys [id]} :path
425	     {:keys [mode]} :query
426	     partial-updates :body} :parameters
427	    {:keys [component-service traversal-service]} :system
428	    :keys [ctx]
429	    :as req}]
430	  (->> {:allowed? (fn [_] (if (= my-data-mode mode)
431	                            (my-data-update-allowed? ctx traversal-service id partial-updates)
432	                            (crud-api/action-on-query-one-allowed? component-service/service-config
433	                                                                   ctx
434	                                                                   :update
435	                                                                   (pq/by-id id))))
436	        :processable? (fn [{:keys [::crud-api/instance]}]
437	                        (let [new-component (component-util/apply-partial-updates instance partial-updates)
438	                              operation (authorization-service/->op :update instance new-component)]
439	                          (crud-api/processable? component-service ctx operation)))
440	        :conflict? (fn [{:keys [::crud-api/instance]}]
441	                     (if-let [error (component-util/partial-update-conflict? instance partial-updates)]
442	                       [true {::conflict error}]
443	                       [false {::component instance}]))
444	        :new? false
445	        :respond-with-entity? true
446	        :handle-conflict ::conflict
447	        :can-put-to-missing? false
448	        :handle-ok (fn [{:keys [::component]}]
449	                     (let [component-to-update (component-util/apply-partial-updates component partial-updates)
450	                           updated-component (component-service/update! component-service ctx component-to-update)
451	                           scope-data (viewpoint-scope/construct-component-scopedata! ctx [updated-component] [])]
452	                       {:component updated-component
453	                        :scopeData scope-data}))}
454	       (merge crud-api/resource-defaults)
455	       (liberator/run-resource req)))
456	
457	(defn- partial-bulk-update
458	  [{{{partial-bulk-updates :updates} :body
459	     {:keys [mode]} :query} :parameters
460	    {:keys [component-service traversal-service]} :system
461	    :keys [ctx]
462	    :as req}]
463	  (->> {:allowed? (fn [_] (let [ids (util/fn-set :componentId partial-bulk-updates)
464	                                query (pq/by-ids ids)]
465	                            (if (= my-data-mode mode)
466	                              (my-data-bulk-update-allowed? ctx traversal-service partial-bulk-updates query)
467	                              (crud-api/action-on-query-allowed? component-service/service-config
468	                                                                 ctx
469	                                                                 :partial-bulk-update
470	                                                                 query))))
471	        :processable? (fn [{:keys [::crud-api/instance]}]
472	                        (let [new-components (component-util/apply-partial-bulk-updates instance partial-bulk-updates)
473	                              old-component->new-component (let [id->new-component (core/by-id new-components)]
474	                                                             (reduce
475	                                                              (fn [acc old-component]
476	                                                                (assoc acc
477	                                                                       old-component
478	                                                                       (id->new-component (core/id old-component))))
479	                                                              {}
480	                                                              instance))
481	                              operations (map (fn [[old-component new-component]]
482	                                                (authorization-service/->op :update old-component new-component))
483	                                              old-component->new-component)
484	                              result (crud-service/every-processable? component-service ctx operations)]
485	                          (if (client-util/error? result)
486	                            [false result]
487	                            result)))
488	        :conflict? (fn [{:keys [::crud-api/instance]}]
489	                     (if-let [error (component-util/partial-bulk-update-conflict? instance partial-bulk-updates)]
490	                       [true {::conflict error}]
491	                       [false {::components instance}]))
492	        :new? false
493	        :respond-with-entity? true
494	        :handle-conflict ::conflict
495	        :can-put-to-missing? false
496	        :handle-ok (fn [{:keys [::components]}]
497	                     (let [components-to-update (component-util/apply-partial-bulk-updates components
498	                                                                                           partial-bulk-updates)
499	                           updated-components (component-service/bulk-update! component-service
500	                                                                              ctx
501	                                                                              components-to-update)
502	                           scope-data (viewpoint-scope/construct-component-scopedata! ctx updated-components [])]
503	                       {:components updated-components
504	                        :scopeData scope-data}))}
505	       (merge crud-api/resource-defaults)
506	       (liberator/run-resource req)))
507	
508	(s/def ::component-ids ::specs/ids)
509	(specs/sdef ::include-attachments boolean?)
510	(s/def ::component-scope-body (s/keys :req-un [::component-ids]
511	                                      :opt-un [::include-attachments]))
512	
513	(defn- components-scopedata
514	  [{_ :system
515	    {{:keys [component-ids include-attachments]} :body} :parameters
516	    context :ctx
517	    :as req}]
518	  (->> {:can-post-to-missing? false
519	        :new? false
520	        :respond-with-entity? true
521	        :handle-ok (fn [{:keys [::crud-api/instance]}]
522	                     (->> (viewpoint-scope/construct-component-scopedata! context instance [])
523	                          (viewpoint-scope/add-attachments! context include-attachments)))}
524	       (merge (crud-api/query-defaults component-service/service-config context
525	                                       (pq/by-ids component-ids)))
526	       (liberator/run-resource req)))
527	
528	(defn- reference-summary
529	  [{{{:keys [id]} :path} :parameters context :ctx :as req}]
530	  (->> {:handle-ok
531	        (fn [{:keys [::crud-api/instance]}]
532	          (let [readable-ws-ids (workspace-service/workspace-ids-with-read-permission context)
533	                subgraph
534	                (->> (graph-interface/component-ids->one-degree-subgraph context
535	                                                                         [(core/id instance)]
536	                                                                         {:readable-workspace-ids readable-ws-ids
537	                                                                          :include-parent-relationships? true})
538	                     (graph-interface/apply-field-permissions! context))]
539	            (->> (scope-resolver/resolve-for-references! context subgraph)
540	                 (subgraph-util/ensure-realized)
541	                 (viewpoint-scope/with-minimal-component-fields)
542	                 (viewpoint-scope/with-minimal-reference-fields)
543	                 (#(assoc % :componentId (core/id instance) :permissions [])))))}
544	       (merge (crud-api/query-one-defaults component-service/service-config context (pq/by-id id)))
545	       (liberator/run-resource req)))
546	
547	(defn- preview-scope
548	  [{{{:keys [id]} :path} :parameters context :ctx :as req}]
549	  (->> {:handle-ok (fn [{:keys [::crud-api/instance]}]
550	                     (component-preview-service/preview-scope! context instance))}
551	       (merge (crud-api/query-one-defaults component-service/service-config context (pq/by-id id)))
552	       (liberator/run-resource req)))
553	
554	(def component-api-reitit
555	  (ring/router
556	   [["/scopedata" {:post {:name ::component-scopedata
557	                          :parameters {:body ::component-scope-body}
558	                          :handler components-scopedata
559	                          :allow-impersonation? true
560	                          :allow-readers-or-contributors? true}
561	                   :swagger {:public false}
562	                   :conflicting true}]
563	    ["/search" {:get {:name ::search
564	                      :conflicting true
565	                      :parameters {:query ::search-query-params}
566	                      :summary "Search for components by fieldname and value in a given workspace"
567	                      :description "This endpoint lets you search for components in a workspace when you know the value of a specific field. If `field` is not supplied, `name` will be used, and the value should be passed in `name`. If `field` is supplied, the value should be supplied in `value`"
568	                      :responses {200 {:description "Components that matched the search"
569	                                       :body ::components}}
570	                      :handler component-search-get}
571	                :post {:name ::search
572	                       :conflicting true
573	                       :parameters {:body ::search-body-params}
574	                       :summary "Search for components by fieldname and value in a given workspace"
575	                       :description "This endpoint lets you search for components in a workspace when you know the value of a specific field. If `field` is not supplied, `name` will be used, and the value should be passed in `name`. If `field` is supplied, the value should be supplied in `value`"
576	                       :responses {200 {:description "Components that matched the search"
577	                                        :body ::components}}
578	                       :handler component-search-post
579	                       :allow-impersonation? true
580	                       :allow-readers-or-contributors? true}
581	                :conflicting true}]
582	    ["/fieldsearch" {:get {:name ::fieldsearch
583	                           :parameters {:query ::fieldsearch-query-params}
584	                           :handler field-search}
585	                     :swagger {:public false}
586	                     :conflicting true}]
587	    ["/subtree-info" {:post {:name ::deletion-impact
588	                             :parameters {:body ::subtree-info-payload}
589	                             :handler subtree-info
590	                             :swagger {:public false}}
591	                      :conflicting true}]
592	    ["/autocomplete/description" {:post {:name ::autocomplete-description
593	                                         :swagger {:public false}
594	                                         :parameters {:body ::component-repo/autocomplete-payload}
595	                                         :handler autocomplete-component-description-handler
596	                                         :required-features [::feature-service/autocomplete-openai]
597	                                         :allow-impersonation? true
598	                                         :allow-readers-or-contributors? true}}]
599	    ["/copy" {:post {:name ::copy
