(ns ardoq.api.component-api
  (:require
   [ardoq.api.component-api.revision-spec :as-alias revision]
   [ardoq.api.crud-api-v2 :as crud-api]
   [ardoq.api.crud-api-v3 :as crud-v3]
   [ardoq.api.deliberator :as liberator]
   [ardoq.client.client-utils :as client-util]
   [ardoq.core :as core]
   [ardoq.graph.tmp.graph-interface :as graph-interface]
   [ardoq.permission.field.field-permission-service :as field-permission-service]
   [ardoq.permission.field.workspace-overview :as workspace-overview]
   [ardoq.persistence.component-repo :as component-repo]
   [ardoq.persistence.postgres-entity :as entity]
   [ardoq.persistence.postgres.postgres-query :as pq]
   [ardoq.persistence.reference-repo :as reference-repo]
   [ardoq.persistence.workspace-repo :as workspace-repo]
   [ardoq.personalization.my :as my]
   [ardoq.router :as router]
   [ardoq.scenarios.scenario-service :as scenario-service]
   [ardoq.service.authorization-service :as authorization-service]
   [ardoq.service.autocomplete-service :as autocomplete-service]
   [ardoq.service.component-copy-service :as component-copy-service]
   [ardoq.service.component-preview-service :as component-preview-service]
   [ardoq.service.component-service :as component-service]
   [ardoq.service.crud-service :as crud-service]
   [ardoq.service.feature-service :as feature-service]
   [ardoq.service.model-service :as model-service]
   [ardoq.service.query-service :as query-service]
   [ardoq.service.scope-resolver :as scope-resolver]
   [ardoq.service.viewpoint-service.scope :as viewpoint-scope]
   [ardoq.service.workspace-service :as workspace-service]
   [ardoq.specs :as specs]
   [ardoq.utils :as util]
   [ardoq.utils.component-utils :as component-util]
   [ardoq.utils.deliberator-util :as deliberator-util]
   [ardoq.utils.subgraph-utils :as subgraph-util]
   [clojure.set :as set]
   [clojure.spec.alpha :as s]
   [reitit.core :as r]
   [reitit.ring :as ring]
   [superstring.core :as str]))

(s/def ::componentIds ::specs/ids)
(s/def ::parent ::specs/id)
(s/def ::targetWorkspace ::specs/id)
(s/def ::attachment-strategy #{"strip" "duplicate" "promote"})
(s/def ::attachmentStrategies (s/map-of keyword? ::attachment-strategy))

(s/def ::copy-component-request (s/keys :req-un [::componentIds]
                                        :opt-un [::parent ::targetWorkspace
                                                 ::attachmentStrategies]))

(s/def ::component-with-metadata (s/merge ::component-repo/component ::crud-api/metadata))
(s/def ::components (s/coll-of ::component-with-metadata))

(s/def ::revision/_id ::specs/_id)
(s/def ::revision/revision (s/keys :req-un [::revision/_id]))
(s/def ::revision/component (s/merge ::component-repo/entity ::crud-api/metadata ::revision/revision))

(defmethod crud-api/pre-create! :component-service [component-service ctx component]
  (->> (dissoc component :component-key)
       (crud-api/pre-create-default component-service ctx)))

(defn- initialize-copy-context [context {:keys [componentIds parent targetWorkspace]}]
  ;; NOTE: For copying, it's essential that full unredacted components are loaded here
  (let [components (entity/query! component-repo/unredacted-config context (pq/by-ids componentIds))
        root-workspace-id (:rootWorkspace (first components))
        target-workspace-id (or targetWorkspace root-workspace-id)
        field-access-context (field-permission-service/resolve-user-field-access-context context)]
    {::components components
     ::parent (when parent
                (entity/query-one! component-repo/unredacted-config context (pq/by-id parent)))
     ::target-workspace (->> (pq/by-id target-workspace-id)
                             (entity/query-one! workspace-repo/config context))
     ::source-workspace (->> (pq/by-id root-workspace-id)
                             (entity/query-one! workspace-repo/config context))
     ::field-access-context field-access-context}))

(defn copy-component-handler
  [{{copy-component-request :body} :parameters
    {:keys [component-copy-service component-service] :as system} :system
    context :ctx
    :as req}]
  (->> {:initialize-context (fn [_] (initialize-copy-context context copy-component-request))
        :processable? (fn [{:keys [::components]}]
                        (crud-api/processable? component-service
                                               context
                                               {:action :copy-components
                                                :entity components}))
        :allowed? (fn [{:keys [::source-workspace ::target-workspace ::field-access-context]}]
                    (and (crud-api/allowed? workspace-service/service-config context :read source-workspace)
                         (crud-api/allowed? component-service/service-config
                                            context
                                            :create
                                            {:rootWorkspace (core/id target-workspace)})
                         (workspace-overview/user-can-copy-with-confidential-fields? context
                                                                                     field-access-context
                                                                                     source-workspace)))
        :exists? (fn [{:keys [::parent ::target-workspace ::components] :as ctx}]
                   (let [parent? (:parent copy-component-request)
                         parent-exists? (if parent? parent true)
                         all-components-exist? (= (set (:componentIds copy-component-request))
                                                  (core/id-set components))]
                     (and parent-exists? all-components-exist? target-workspace)))
        :can-post-to-missing? false
        :post! (fn copy-component-post! [{:keys [::components ::target-workspace ::parent] :as ctx}]
                 {::result (component-copy-service/copy-components!
                            component-copy-service
                            context
                            target-workspace
                            components
                            parent
                            (some-> (:attachmentStrategies copy-component-request)
                                    (update-keys name)))})
        :handle-created (fn [{:keys [::result] :as ctx}]
                          (deliberator-util/ring-response
                           {:status 201
                            :body (liberator/serialize-json result ctx)
                            :headers {"Content-Type" "application/json"}}))
        :available-media-types ["application/json"]
        :respond-with-entity? true}
       (merge crud-api/resource-defaults)
       (liberator/run-resource req)))

(defn autocomplete-component-description-handler
  [{{:keys [lite-llm-service]} :system
    {{:keys [name type description workspaceName]} :body} :parameters :as req}]
  (->> {:handle-created (fn [_]
                          (autocomplete-service/llm-completion-with-template!
                           lite-llm-service
                           :completion-claude
                           :autocomplete-component-description
                           {:name name
                            :type type
                            :description description
                            :workspace-name workspaceName}))}
       (merge crud-api/resource-defaults)
       (liberator/run-resource req)))

(def spec-swaggers
  {::workspace {:swagger/type "string"
                :swagger/title "Workspace ID"
                :swagger/description "ID of the workspace that you want to search for components in."
                :swagger/example :generate}
   ::name {:swagger/title "Component Name"
           :swagger/description "Name of component you want to search for"}
   ::field {:swagger/title "Field Name"
            :swagger/description "Name of the component field you want to use as a filter. Must be used with the `value` parameter."}
   ::value {:swagger/title "Field Value"
            :swagger/description "Value of the component field you want to use as a filter. Must be used with the `field` parameter"}

   ::componentIds {:swagger/title "List of Component IDs"
                   :swagger/description "Specifies the list of component IDs you want to aggregate"
                   :swagger/example :generate}})

(specs/sdef ::workspace ::specs/id)
(specs/sdef ::field ::specs/non-empty-string)
(specs/sdef ::value ::specs/non-empty-string)
(specs/sdef ::name ::specs/non-empty-string)
(specs/sdef ::search-query-params (s/keys :req-un [::workspace]
                                          :opt-un [::field ::name ::value]))
(specs/sdef ::search-body-params (s/keys :req-un [::workspace]
                                         :opt-un [::field ::name ::value]))

(specs/sdef ::componentIds ::specs/ids)

(defn bulk-delete
  [component-service ctx component-ids req]
  (->> {:allowed? (fn [_]
                    (let [components (component-service/query! ctx (pq/by-ids component-ids))]
                      (when (authorization-service/every-authorized? component-service/service-config
                                                                     ctx
                                                                     :delete
                                                                     components)
                        {::crud-api/instance components})))
        :exists? (fn [{:keys [::crud-api/instance]}]
                   (let [nonexistent-components (set/difference
                                                 (set component-ids)
                                                 (set (map core/id instance)))]
                     (or (empty? nonexistent-components)
                         [false {:message (str "The following components do not exist:"
                                               (str/join ", " nonexistent-components))}])))
        :delete! (fn [{:keys [::crud-api/instance]}]
                   {::crud-api/instance (:summary (component-service/bulk-delete*! component-service ctx instance))})
        :respond-with-entity? true
        :handle-ok ::crud-api/instance}
       (merge crud-api/resource-defaults)
       (liberator/run-resource req)))

(defn bulk-delete-resources
  [{{{component-ids :componentIds :as json-body} :body} :parameters
    context :ctx
    {:keys [component-service] :as system} :system
    :as req}]
  (bulk-delete component-service context component-ids req))

(defn delete-resources
  [{{{:keys [branchId]} :query
     {component-ids :componentIds :as json-body} :body} :parameters
    ctx :ctx
    {:keys [component-service] :as system} :system
    :as req}]
  (let [context (if branchId
                  (let [{:keys [scope-id]} (scenario-service/query-one-by-branch-id! ctx branchId)]
                    (assoc ctx :branch branchId :scope scope-id))
                  ctx)]
    (bulk-delete component-service context component-ids req)))

(defn component-search-get [{{{:keys [workspace name field value]} :query} :parameters
                             context :ctx
                             {:keys [workspace-service component-service] :as system} :system :as req}]
  (->> {:handle-ok (fn [_]
                     (let [[field value] (if field [field value] [:name name])]
                       (->> (component-service/search context workspace field value)
                            (map (partial crud-api/post-read! component-service context)))))}
       (merge (crud-api/query-one-defaults workspace-service context (pq/by-id workspace)))
       (liberator/run-resource req)))

(defn component-search-post [{{{:keys [workspace name field value]} :body} :parameters
                              context :ctx
                              {:keys [workspace-service component-service] :as system} :system :as req}]
  (->> {:new? false
        :respond-with-entity? true
        :can-post-to-missing? false
        :handle-ok (fn [_]
                     (let [[field value] (if field [field value] [:name name])]
                       (->> (component-service/search context workspace field value)

         (liberator/run-resource req))))

(defn- merge-components [{{{component-id :id} :path
                           {:keys [merged-component-data subsumed-component-ids] :as payload} :body} :parameters
                          {:keys [component-service]} :system
                          :keys [ctx] :as req}]
  (->> {:new? false
        :respond-with-entity? true
        :malformed? (fn [_] (not= component-id (core/id (:merged-component-data payload))))
        :allowed? (fn [_]
                    ;; Merging across workspaces is rejected in `:processable?` (the survivor
                    ;; cannot be relocated), so only the survivor's own workspace is authorized here.
                    (when-let [surviving-allowed (crud-api/action-on-query-one-allowed?
                                                  component-service ctx :merge-components
                                                  (pq/by-id component-id))]
                      (when (component-service/subsumed-components-authorized?
                             component-service ctx subsumed-component-ids)
                        surviving-allowed)))
        :processable?
        (fn [{:keys [::crud-api/instance]}]
          (let [subsumed-components (->> (pq/by-ids subsumed-component-ids)
                                         (component-service/query! ctx))]
            (when
             (first (crud-api/processable? component-service
                                           ctx
                                           {:action :merge-components
                                            :entity {:merged-component-data merged-component-data
                                                     :stored-merged-component instance
                                                     :subsumed-components subsumed-components
                                                     :subsumed-component-ids subsumed-component-ids
                                                     :affected-read-only-field-kws
                                                     (model-service/entity->read-only-field-kws!
                                                      ctx merged-component-data)}}))
              {:subsumed-components subsumed-components})))
        :handle-ok (fn [{:keys [subsumed-components]}]
                     (component-service/merge-components component-service
                                                         ctx
                                                         (component-service/->merge-components-payload
                                                          merged-component-data
                                                          subsumed-components)))}

       (liberator/run-resource req)))

(def ^:private my-data-mode "my_data")

(s/def ::mode #{my-data-mode})

(defn- my-data-request?
  "True when a request opts into owner self-service via `?mode=my_data`."
  [req]
  (= my-data-mode (get-in req [:query-params "mode"])))

(defn- my-data-permissions-allowed?
  "True when the request is a my_data request and the permissions prototype feature is on.
   Used as the `allow-readers-or-contributors?` route gate so the middleware write cap is
   only lifted when both conditions hold."
  [req]
  (and (my-data-request? req)
       (feature-service/enabled-in-org? (get-in req [:ctx :org])
                                        ::feature-service/access_tmp_person-in-graph-permissions-prototype)))

(defn- my-data-update-allowed?
  "Whether a mode=my_data update is authorized: the caller may edit only
  owner-editable fields, and only on a component they own."
  [ctx traversal-service id partial-updates]
  (and (feature-service/enabled-in-org? (:org ctx) ::feature-service/access_tmp_person-in-graph-prototype)
       (my/partial-updates-allowed? traversal-service ctx id partial-updates)
       (crud-api/action-on-query-one-allowed? component-service/service-config ctx :read (pq/by-id id))))

(defn- my-data-bulk-update-allowed?
  "Whether a mode=my_data bulk update is authorized: the caller may edit
  only owner-editable fields, and only on components they
  own. All-or-nothing — one disallowed component or field rejects the
  whole batch."
  [ctx traversal-service partial-bulk-updates query]
  (and (feature-service/enabled-in-org? (:org ctx) ::feature-service/access_tmp_person-in-graph-prototype)
       (when-let [components (seq (query-service/query! component-service/service-config ctx query))]
         (when (and (my/partial-bulk-updates-allowed? traversal-service ctx partial-bulk-updates)
                    (authorization-service/every-permission? ctx :read (util/fn-set :rootWorkspace components)))
           {::crud-api/instance components}))))

(defn- partial-update
  [{{{:keys [id]} :path
     {:keys [mode]} :query
     partial-updates :body} :parameters
    {:keys [component-service traversal-service]} :system
    :keys [ctx]
    :as req}]
  (->> {:allowed? (fn [_] (if (= my-data-mode mode)
                            (my-data-update-allowed? ctx traversal-service id partial-updates)
                            (crud-api/action-on-query-one-allowed? component-service/service-config
                                                                   ctx
                                                                   :update
                                                                   (pq/by-id id))))
        :processable? (fn [{:keys [::crud-api/instance]}]
                        (let [new-component (component-util/apply-partial-updates instance partial-updates)
                              operation (authorization-service/->op :update instance new-component)]
                          (crud-api/processable? component-service ctx operation)))
        :conflict? (fn [{:keys [::crud-api/instance]}]
                     (if-let [error (component-util/partial-update-conflict? instance partial-updates)]
                       [true {::conflict error}]
                       [false {::component instance}]))
        :new? false
        :respond-with-entity? true
        :handle-conflict ::conflict
        :can-put-to-missing? false
        :handle-ok (fn [{:keys [::component]}]
                     (let [component-to-update (component-util/apply-partial-updates component partial-updates)
                           updated-component (component-service/update! component-service ctx component-to-update)
                           scope-data (viewpoint-scope/construct-component-scopedata! ctx [updated-component] [])]
                       {:component updated-component
                        :scopeData scope-data}))}
       (merge crud-api/resource-defaults)
       (liberator/run-resource req)))

(defn- partial-bulk-update
  [{{{partial-bulk-updates :updates} :body
     {:keys [mode]} :query} :parameters
    {:keys [component-service traversal-service]} :system
    :keys [ctx]
    :as req}]
  (->> {:allowed? (fn [_] (let [ids (util/fn-set :componentId partial-bulk-updates)
                                query (pq/by-ids ids)]
                            (if (= my-data-mode mode)
                              (my-data-bulk-update-allowed? ctx traversal-service partial-bulk-updates query)
                              (crud-api/action-on-query-allowed? component-service/service-config
                                                                 ctx
                                                                 :partial-bulk-update
                                                                 query))))
        :processable? (fn [{:keys [::crud-api/instance]}]
                        (let [new-components (component-util/apply-partial-bulk-updates instance partial-bulk-updates)
                              old-component->new-component (let [id->new-component (core/by-id new-components)]
                                                             (reduce
                                                              (fn [acc old-component]
                                                                (assoc acc
                                                                       old-component
                                                                       (id->new-component (core/id old-component))))
                                                              {}
                                                              instance))
                              operations (map (fn [[old-component new-component]]
                                                (authorization-service/->op :update old-component new-component))
                                              old-component->new-component)
                              result (crud-service/every-processable? component-service ctx operations)]
                          (if (client-util/error? result)
                            [false result]
                            result)))
        :conflict? (fn [{:keys [::crud-api/instance]}]
                     (if-let [error (component-util/partial-bulk-update-conflict? instance partial-bulk-updates)]
                       [true {::conflict error}]
                       [false {::components instance}]))
        :new? false
        :respond-with-entity? true
        :handle-conflict ::conflict
        :can-put-to-missing? false
        :handle-ok (fn [{:keys [::components]}]
                     (let [components-to-update (component-util/apply-partial-bulk-updates components
                                                                                           partial-bulk-updates)
                           updated-components (component-service/bulk-update! component-service
                                                                              ctx
                                                                              components-to-update)
                           scope-data (viewpoint-scope/construct-component-scopedata! ctx updated-components [])]
                       {:components updated-components
                        :scopeData scope-data}))}
       (merge crud-api/resource-defaults)
       (liberator/run-resource req)))

(defmulti post-read! util/service->keyword)

(defmulti post-read-many! util/service->keyword)

(defmulti post-create! util/service->keyword)

(defmulti post-update! util/service->keyword)

(defmulti pre-create! util/service->keyword)

(defmulti pre-update! util/service->keyword)

(defmulti pre-patch! util/service->keyword)

(defmethod camelize-keys :default [service-config document]
  (util/camelize-entity-type document))

(defmethod lispy-keys :default [service-config document]
  document)

(defn post-read-default [service-config _ctx document]
  (camelize-keys service-config document))

(defmethod post-read! :default [service-config ctx document]
  (post-read-default service-config ctx document))

(defmethod post-read-many! :default [service-config ctx documents]
  (map (partial post-read! service-config ctx) documents))

(defmethod post-create! :default [service ctx document]
  (post-read! service ctx document))

(defmethod post-update! :default [service ctx document]
  (post-read! service ctx document))

(defn pre-create-default [service ctx document]
  (->> (dissoc document core/ardoq-persistent-field-name core/ardoq-field-name)
       metadata-service/without-metadata
       (lispy-keys service)
       (crud-service/gen-id! service)))

(defmethod pre-create! :default [service ctx document]
  (pre-create-default service ctx document))

(defn- remove-more-metadata [doc]
  (dissoc doc :created :created-by :last-updated :last-modified-by))

(defn pre-update-default [service ctx document]
  (->> (dissoc document core/ardoq-persistent-field-name core/ardoq-field-name)
       (lispy-keys service)
       metadata-service/without-lispy-metadata
       metadata-service/without-metadata
       remove-more-metadata
       (crud-service/gen-id! service)))

(defmethod pre-update! :default [service ctx document]
  (pre-update-default service ctx document))

(defn pre-patch-default [service ctx document]
  (let [processed (->> (dissoc document core/ardoq-persistent-field-name core/ardoq-field-name)
                       (lispy-keys service)
                       metadata-service/without-lispy-metadata
                       metadata-service/without-metadata
                       remove-more-metadata)]
    (if-let [type-hints (:prop->column-type-hint service)]
      (postgres/read-coerce processed type-hints)
      processed)))

(defmethod pre-patch! :default [service ctx document]
  (pre-patch-default service ctx document))

(defn location [{:keys [request] :as liberator-ctx} instance]
  (str (request-util/base-url-from-header request)
       (:uri request) "/" (core/id instance)))

(defn redirect-to-created [liberator-ctx instance]
  (deliberator-util/ring-response
   {:status 201
    :body (liberator/serialize-json instance liberator-ctx)
    :headers {"Location" (location liberator-ctx instance)
              "Content-Type" "application/json"}}))

(defn redirect-to-ok [liberator-ctx instance]
  (deliberator-util/ring-response
   {:status 200
    :body (liberator/serialize-json instance liberator-ctx)
    :headers {"Location" (location liberator-ctx instance)
              "Content-Type" "application/json"}}))

(def exists? (comp some? ::instance))

(defn malformed?
  "Returns `{:errors {:message ...}}` saying why `value` fails `spec`, or `nil` when it conforms. The
  message (from `ardoq.specs.explain/message`) is safe to log and return, never a submitted value."
  [spec value]
  (when-let [message (explain/message spec value)]
    {:errors {:message message}}))

(defn allowed?
  ([service-config context action]
   (allowed? service-config context action true true))
  ([service-config context action entity]
   (allowed? service-config context action entity entity))
  ([service-config context action result entity]
   (if entity
     (if (authorization-service/authorized? service-config context (authorization-service/->op action entity))
       {::instance result}
       false)
     true)))

(defn allowed-many? [service-config context action entities]
  {::instance (authorization-service/filter-authorized service-config context action entities)})

(defn query-one-allowed? [service-config context query]
  (allowed? service-config context :read (query-service/query-one! service-config context query)))

(defn query-allowed? [service-config context query]
  (allowed-many? service-config context :read (query-service/query! service-config context query)))

(defn action-on-query-one-allowed? [service-config context action query]
  (allowed? service-config context action (query-service/query-one! service-config context query)))

(defn action-on-query-allowed? [service-config context action query]
  (allowed? service-config context action (query-service/query! service-config context query)))

(defn allowed-update? [service context old-entity new-entity]
  (if old-entity
    (if (authorization-service/authorized? service context (authorization-service/->op :update old-entity new-entity))
      {::instance old-entity}
      false)
    true))

(defn allowed-rename? [service context old-entity new-entity]
  (if old-entity
    ;; NOTE: Currently, permission documents only store 5 "levels" (create, update, ...) so we can't add the :rename
    ;; we'd like; alternatively, every service would need to map the rename action to the update privilege =>
    ;; less error-prone to just go with update here
    (if (authorization-service/authorized? service context (authorization-service/->op :update old-entity new-entity))
      {::instance old-entity}
      false)
    true))

(defn ensure-cas [document instance]
  (let [v (:_version instance)
        v' (:_version document)]
    (cond (and v (not v'))
          (client-utils/throw ::client-utils/missing-version)
          (and v v' (< v' v))
          [true {::conflict (client-utils/ring-response-json ::client-utils/conflict
                                                             ["A newer version already exists!"])}]
          :else false)))

(defn validate-no-id
  "returns an error `map` or `nil`"
  [document]
  (when (some? (:_id document))
    {:message "Document contains _id" :data document}))

(defn handle-not-implemented

(deliberator-util/ring-response
   {:status 400
    :headers {"Content-Type" "application/json"}
    :body (json/write-str errors)}))

(defn processable? [service context op]
  (let [op-or-error (crud-service/processable? service context op)]
    [(not (client-utils/error? op-or-error)) op-or-error]))

(def resource-defaults
  {:available-media-types ["application/json"]

   :handle-forbidden (fn [_]
                       (log/warn "Forbidden")
                       (deliberator-util/ring-response {:status 403}))
   :handle-malformed handle-malformed
   :handle-not-found (fn [liberator-ctx]
                       (log/warn "Not found"
                                 (if-let [id (-> liberator-ctx :request :path-params :id)]
                                   (str "resource with id " id) ""))
                       (deliberator-util/ring-response
                        {:status 404
                         :headers {"Content-Type" "application/json"}
                         :body (json/write-str (select-keys liberator-ctx [:message]))}))
   :handle-unprocessable-entity
   (fn [{:keys [::client-utils/errors]}]
     (log/warn "Unprocessable: " (:message errors))
     (deliberator-util/ring-response
      {:status (or (:status errors) 422)
       :headers {"Content-Type" "application/json"}
       :body (json/write-str errors)}))
   :exists? exists?})

(def command-defaults
  "Liberator defaults for POST endpoints that execute a command rather than create
  an entity. Returns 200 instead of 201. Callers should override :handle-ok or
  store their result in ::result via :post!."
  (merge resource-defaults
         {:exists? (constantly true)
          :can-post-to-missing? false
          :new? false
          :respond-with-entity? true
          :handle-ok ::result}))

(defn query-one-defaults [service-config context q]
  (merge resource-defaults
         {:allowed? (fn [_] (query-one-allowed? service-config context q))
          :handle-ok (fn [{:keys [::instance]}]
                       (post-read! service-config context instance))}))

(defn query-defaults [service-config context q]
  (merge resource-defaults
         {:allowed? (fn [_] (query-allowed? service-config context q))
          :handle-ok (fn [{:keys [::instance]}]
                       (cond-> (post-read-many! service-config context instance)
                         (metadata-service/flat? service-config) metadata-service/flat))}))

(defn create-defaults [service context document]
  {:malformed? (fn [_]
                 (if-not (map? document)
                   true
                   (let [entity (pre-create! service context document)
                         input-error (validate-no-id document)]
                     (if-let [errors (and input-error {:errors input-error})]
                       [true errors]
                       [false {::entity entity}]))))
   :allowed? (fn [{:keys [::entity]}]
               (authorization-service/authorized? service context (authorization-service/->op :create entity)))
   :processable? (fn [{:keys [::entity]}]
                   (processable? service context {:action :create :entity entity}))
   :post! (fn [{:keys [::entity]}] {::instance (->> entity
                                                    (crud-service/create! service context)
                                                    (post-create! service context))})
   :new? exists?
   :handle-created (fn [{:keys [::instance] :as liberator-ctx}]
                     (redirect-to-created liberator-ctx instance))})

(defn create* [service context document]
  (fn [request]
    (->> (create-defaults service context document)
         (merge resource-defaults)
         (liberator/run-resource request))))

(defn- do-post-create [service ctx entity-type entity]
  (let [entity-service (get service (util/entity-type->service-kw entity-type))]
    [entity-type (post-create! entity-service ctx entity)]))

(defn create-with-extra-return-from-instance-meta [service context document]
  (->> (assoc (create-defaults service context document) :post!
              (fn [{:keys [::entity]}]
                (let [instance (->> entity
                                    (crud-service/create! service context)
                                    (post-create! service context))
                      instance-meta (meta (metadata-service/clear-skip-metadata instance))]
                  {::instance (merge {(:entity-type service) instance}
                                     (medley/map-kv (partial do-post-create service context)
                                                    instance-meta))})))
       (merge resource-defaults)))

(defn update-defaults [service context id document]
  {:malformed? (fn [_]
                 (let [entity (pre-update! service context document)]
                   (if-let [errors (or (malformed? ::specs/id id)
                                       (malformed? ::specs/identifiable document)
                                       (not= id (core/id document)))]
                     [true errors]
                     [false {::entity entity}])))
   :allowed? (fn [{:keys [::entity] :as liberator-ctx}]
               (let [existing-entity (query-service/query-one! service context (pq/by-id id))]
                 (allowed-update? service context existing-entity entity)))
   :processable? (fn [{:keys [::entity ::instance] :as liberator-ctx}]
                   (if instance
                     (processable? service context {:action :update :entity instance :new-entity entity})
                     true))
   :conflict? (fn [{:keys [::instance] :as liberator-ctx}]
                (ensure-cas document instance))
   :new? false
   :respond-with-entity? true
   :handle-conflict ::conflict
   :can-put-to-missing? false
   :put! (fn [{:keys [::entity]}]
           {::result (->> entity
                          (crud-service/update! service context)
                          (post-update! service context))})
   :handle-ok ::result
   :handle-not-implemented (fn [_] (handle-not-implemented))})

(defn update* [service context id document]
  (fn [request]
    (->> (merge resource-defaults
                (update-defaults service context id document))
         (liberator/run-resource request))))

(defn patch* [service context id patch]
  (fn [request]
    (->> (merge resource-defaults
                {:malformed? (fn [_]
                               (if-let [errors (malformed? ::specs/id id)]
                                 [true errors]
                                 [false]))
                 :allowed? (fn [_]
                             (let [existing-entity (query-service/query-one! service context (pq/by-id id))
                                   new-entity (merge existing-entity (pre-patch! service context patch))
                                   instance (allowed-update? service context existing-entity new-entity)]
                               (if (map? instance)
                                 [true (assoc instance ::new-entity new-entity)]
                                 true)))
                 :processable? (fn [{:keys [::instance ::new-entity] :as liberator-ctx}]
                                 (if instance
                                   (let [merged (merge instance new-entity)
                                         errors (or (malformed? (:spec service) merged)
                                                    (and (core/id patch) (not= id (core/id patch))))]
                                     (if errors
                                       [false {::client-utils/errors (:errors errors)}]
                                       (let [[processable? op-or-error]
                                             (processable? service context {:action :update
                                                                            :entity instance
                                                                            :new-entity merged})]
                                         (if processable?
                                           [true {::merged-entity merged}]
                                           [false (select-keys op-or-error [::client-utils/errors])]))))
                                   true))
                 :new? false
                 :respond-with-entity? true
                 :can-put-to-missing? false
                 :patch! (fn [{:keys [::merged-entity]}]
                           {::result (->> merged-entity
                                          (crud-service/update! service context)
                                          (post-update! service context))})
                 :handle-ok ::result
                 :handle-not-implemented (fn [_] (handle-not-implemented))})
         (liberator/run-resource request))))

(defn rename* [service context id rename-request]
  (fn [request]
    (->> (merge resource-defaults
                {:malformed? (fn [_]
                               (if-let [errors (malformed? ::specs/id id)]
                                 [true errors]
                                 false))
                 :allowed? (fn [_]
                             (let [existing-entity (query-service/query-one! service context (pq/by-id id))
                                   new-entity (merge existing-entity
                                                     (pre-patch! service context
                                                                 (select-keys rename-request [:_version :name])))
                                   instance (allowed-rename? service context existing-entity new-entity)]
                               (if (map? instance)
                                 [true (assoc instance ::new-entity new-entity)]
                                 true)))
                 :processable? (fn [{:keys [::new-entity ::instance] :as liberator-ctx}]
                                 (if instance
                                   (let [merged (merge instance new-entity)
                                         errors (malformed? (:spec service) merged)]
                                     (if errors
                                       [false {::client-utils/errors (:errors errors)}]
                                       (let [[processable? op-or-error]
                                             (processable? service context {:action :update
                                                                            :entity instance
                                                                            :new-entity merged})]
                                         (if processable?
                                           [true {::merged-entity merged}]
                                           [false (select-keys op-or-error [::client-utils/errors])]))))
                                   true))
                 :exists? (fn [{:keys [::merged-entity] :as liberator-ctx}]
                            (some? merged-entity))
                 :new? false
                 :respond-with-entity? true
                 :can-put-to-missing? false
                 :patch! (fn [{{:keys [_id _version name]} ::merged-entity}]
                           {::result (crud-service/rename! service context _id _version name)})
                 :handle-ok ::result
                 :handle-not-implemented (fn [_] (handle-not-implemented))})
         (liberator/run-resource request))))

(defn delete-defaults [service context id]
  (merge resource-defaults
         {:allowed? (fn [_]
                      (action-on-query-one-allowed? service context :delete (pq/by-id id)))
          :processable? (fn [{:keys [::instance]}]
                          (processable? service context {:action :delete :entity instance}))
          :delete! (fn [{:keys [::instance]}]
                     {::result (crud-service/delete! service context instance)})
          :delete-enacted? exists?
          :handle-ok (fn [{:keys [::result]}]
                       (camelize-keys service result))}))

(defn revisions-defaults [service-config context id revisions]
  (merge resource-defaults
         {:initialize-context (fn [_] {::revisions revisions})
          :allowed? (fn [_] (query-one-allowed? service-config context (pq/by-id id)))
          :handle-ok (fn [{:keys [::instance ::revisions]}]
                       (->> revisions
                            (query-service/revisions! service-config context instance)
                            (map (partial post-read! service-config context))))}))

(defn split-multivalue-param
  "Split a query parameter that has multiple comma-separated values into the individual parts"
  ;; we have not 100% agreed on how to pass such params; HTTP allows repeating the param
  [string]
  (some-> string (str/split #",")))

170	(def text-like-types
171	  "Field types that are textual, e.g. for the purpose of sorting (notice that some of these contain IDs while you
172	  likely want to sort by the corresponding label, e.g. for a User)"
173	  #{"Url" "Text" "TextArea" "List" "Email" "User" "File"})
174	
175	(defn textual? [field]
176	  (text-like-types (:type field)))
177	
178	(defn- type-id-set [field type-key]
179	  (some->> field type-key seq (map str) set))
180	
181	(defn applicable-type-ids
182	  "The type ids `applicable?` tests a field against, to extract once and pass to
183	   `applicable-to-type-ids?` when looping over many entities."
184	  [field]
185	  {:component-types (type-id-set field :componentType)
186	   :reference-types (type-id-set field :referenceType)})
187	
188	(defn applicable-to-type-ids?
189	  "`applicable?` against ids already extracted by `applicable-type-ids`."
190	  [{:keys [component-types reference-types]} entity]
191	  (if-let [type-id (some-> (:typeId entity) str)]
192	    (contains? component-types type-id)
193	    (contains? reference-types (str (:type entity)))))

(def text-like-types
  "Field types that are textual, e.g. for the purpose of sorting (notice that some of these contain IDs while you
  likely want to sort by the corresponding label, e.g. for a User)"
  #{"Url" "Text" "TextArea" "List" "Email" "User" "File"})

(defn textual? [field]
  (text-like-types (:type field)))

(defn- type-id-set [field type-key]
  (some->> field type-key seq (map str) set))

(defn applicable-type-ids
  "The type ids `applicable?` tests a field against, to extract once and pass to
   `applicable-to-type-ids?` when looping over many entities."
  [field]
  {:component-types (type-id-set field :componentType)
   :reference-types (type-id-set field :referenceType)})

(defn applicable-to-type-ids?
  "`applicable?` against ids already extracted by `applicable-type-ids`."
  [{:keys [component-types reference-types]} entity]
  (if-let [type-id (some-> (:typeId entity) str)]
    (contains? component-types type-id)
    (contains? reference-types (str (:type entity)))))

(defn applicable?
  "`true` when `field` is in use for `entity`.

Use the arity requiring a `workspace` and a `model` when more than one
workspace is being juggled. "
  ([field
    entity]
   (if-let [type-id (some-> (:typeId entity) str)]
     (contains? (type-id-set field :componentType) type-id)
     (contains? (type-id-set field :referenceType) (str (:type entity)))))
  ([field
    workspace
    model
    entity]
   ;; Ensure that all of these things belong together
   {:pre [(= (str (:componentModel workspace))
             (core/id model))]}
   ;; When a reference spans workspaces the source workspace is where
   ;; the field resides.  For components this test is a no-op.
   (and (= (str (:rootWorkspace entity))
           (core/id workspace))
        ;; If the model is different, then the workspace is different,
        ;; so the field can't apply
        (= (str (:model field))
           (core/id model))
        (applicable? field entity))))

(defn applies-to-reference? [{:keys [referenceType] field-model :model :as field}
                             {:keys [type] ref-model :model :as reference}]
  (and (= field-model ref-model)
       (some #{(str type)} referenceType)))

(defn applies-to-component? [{:keys [componentType] field-model :model :as field}
                             {:keys [typeId] comp-model :model :as component}]
  (and (= field-model comp-model)
       (some #{typeId} componentType)))

(defn applies-to?
  "Returns a truthy value if the field applies to the given component or reference,
   and a falsey value otherwise.

   Duplicates the functionality of `applicable?` but the implementation of that seems
   overly defensive/cautious. TODO: investigate replacing `applicable?` with this
   function."
  [field comp-or-ref]
  (case (core/entity-type comp-or-ref)
    :component (applies-to-component? field comp-or-ref)
    :reference (applies-to-reference? field comp-or-ref)
    false))

(defn- existing-component-type-ids [component-type-ids model]
  (filter (util/fn-set model-util/entry-id (model-util/component-entries model))
          component-type-ids))

(defn- existing-reference-type-ids [reference-type-ids model]
  (filter (util/fn-set model-util/entry-id (model-util/reference-entries model))
          reference-type-ids))

(defn remove-non-existing-type-ids [model field]
  (-> field
      (update :componentType existing-component-type-ids model)
      (update :referenceType existing-reference-type-ids model)))

(defn inapplicable
  "After calling inapplicable on a field no entities are `applicable?`"
  [field]
  (assoc
   field :referenceType [] :componentType [] :global false :globalref false))

(defn extend
  "Update `field` so it is `applicable?` to entities of the same type as
  `entity`."
  [field
   entity]
  (if (applicable? field entity)
    field
    (if-let [type-id (some-> (:typeId entity) str)]
      (update field :componentType
              (fn [component-types]
                (-> component-types
                    (into #{type-id})
                    vec)))
      (update field :referenceType
              (fn [reference-types]
                (-> reference-types
                    (into #{(str (:type entity))})
                    vec))))))

(defn add-type-ids
  [field new-component-type-ids new-reference-type-ids]
  (-> field
      (update :componentType #(vec (set/union (set %) new-component-type-ids)))
      (update :referenceType #(vec (set/union (set %) new-reference-type-ids)))))

(defn remove-type-ids
  [field component-type-ids-to-remove reference-type-ids-to-remove]
  (-> field
      (update :componentType #(vec (set/difference (set %) component-type-ids-to-remove)))
      (update :referenceType #(vec (set/difference (set %) reference-type-ids-to-remove)))))

(defn checkbox-type?
  "`true` when `field` describes an attribute specifying a boolean
  checkbox value."
  [field]
  (= (:type field) "Checkbox"))

                              :allowedOptions (:defaultValue field)
                              :value (cond->> v (sequential? v) (str/join ","))
                              :rawValue (pr-str v)}

          (client-util/throw ::client-util/invalid-attribute
                             {:fieldName k
                              :expectedType (:type field)
                              :value (pr-str v)}
                             {k v})))))

;; Avoid creating empty string with (str nil) to conform
;; with other coercion functions
(def ^:private coerce-string (util/fif some? str))

(defn- coerce-list-field-value [field value]
  (let [opts (get-options field)
        lower-case-value (str/lower-case value)]
    (or
     (some #(when (= lower-case-value (str/lower-case %))
              %)
           opts)
     ;; Return the existing value, so typecheck! can throw
     value)))

(defn coerced-field-value [field value]
  (try
    (case (:type field)

      "Text" (coerce-string value)
      "TextArea" (coerce-string value)

      "Number" (or (coerce-util/->number value)
                   ;; Since the the above function returns `nil`instead of an error we have to
                   ;; explicitly replace `nil` with `value` `value` will then fail the subsequent
                   ;; typecheck and we can return a nice error to the frontend.
                   value)

      "Date" (cond
               (string? value) (time-fmt/parse-local-date (:local-date time-fmt/formatters) value)
               (instance? LocalDate value) value
               (instance? DateTime value) (t/local-date (t/year value)
                                                        (t/month value)
                                                        (t/day value)))

      "DateTime" (cond
                   (string? value) (time-fmt/parse value)
                   (instance? DateTime value) (t/to-time-zone value t/utc))

      "Checkbox" (if-some [bool (coerce-util/->boolean value)]
                   bool
                   value)

      "List" (cond
               (sequential? value) (map #(coerce-list-field-value field (str/trim %)) value)
               (some? value) (->> value
                                  str
                                  (coerce-list-field-value field)))

      "SelectMultipleList"
      (if (sequential? value)
        ; coerce `[]` to `nil` to return to initial value
        (seq (map #(coerce-list-field-value field (str/trim %)) value))
        (coerce-list-field-value field value))

      value)
    (catch Exception _
      value)))

(defn- coerce-field [entity {attribute-name :name :as field}]
  ;; Only coerce field when field actually exists on entity. Otherwise
  ;; coerce-field doubles as an implicit "initialize-missing-fields"
  (if (contains? entity (keyword attribute-name))
    (let [original-value (value field entity)
          coerced-value (coerced-field-value field original-value)]
      (set-val field entity coerced-value))
    entity))

(defn ^:private coerce
  "Coerce values to the right datatype according to `fields`, when
  necessary."
  [fields
   entity]
  (reduce coerce-field entity fields))

(defn typecheck!
  "Check that every non-static kv pair on `entity` has the correct
  type, according to `fields`."
  [fields
   entity]
  (when-let [fields-by-name (not-empty (update-vals (group-by :name fields) first))]
    (doseq [[k v] entity
            :let [field (get fields-by-name (name k))]
            :when field
            :when (some? v)]
      (-typecheck! field entity)))
  entity)

(defn default-value-for-field
  [{default-value :defaultValue
    :as field}]
  (cond
    (list-type? field) nil
    :else default-value))

(defn- initialize-missing-fields
  "If a field is missing, initialize it with the default value,
  provided it is not a list field.

  Ensures data consistency/clarity, and simplifies API usage.
  Also frees frontend from having to dig up default values for
  fields in surveys and similar use-cases."
  ;; https://github.com/ardoq/ardoq-api/issues/419
  ;; https://ardoqcom.atlassian.net/browse/ARD-552
  [fields entity]
  (reduce (fn initialize-fields [entity-with-fields field]
            (let [field-name (keyword (:name field))]
              (if (contains? entity field-name)
                entity-with-fields
                (assoc entity-with-fields field-name (default-value-for-field field)))))
          entity
          fields))

(defmulti field-value= (fn [field a b] (:type field)))

(defmethod field-value= "DateTime" [field a b]
  (let [coerced-a (coerced-field-value field a)
        coerced-b (coerced-field-value field b)]
    (if (nil? coerced-a)
      (= coerced-a coerced-b)
      ;; equal? cannot accept nil as the first argument
      (t/equal? coerced-a coerced-b))))

(defmethod field-value= "Date" [field a b]
  (let [coerced-a (coerced-field-value field a)
        coerced-b (coerced-field-value field b)]
    (if (and (instance? ReadablePartial coerced-a)
             (instance? ReadablePartial coerced-b))
      (t/equal? coerced-a coerced-b)
      (= coerced-a coerced-b))))

(defmethod field-value= :default [field a b]
  (= (coerced-field-value field a) (coerced-field-value field b)))

(defmethod field-value= "Number" [field a b]
  (if (every? number? [a b])
    (== a b)
    (= a b)))

(defn stored-query-id
  "Returns the id of the stored query backing a calculated field, or nil."
  [field]
  (-> field :calculatedFieldSettings :storedQueryId))

(defn calculated-field? [field]
  (some? (stored-query-id field)))

(defn calculated-field-kw [field]
  (when (calculated-field? field)
    (-> field :name keyword)))

(defn locally-derived-field? [{:keys [calculatedFieldSettings] :as field}]
  (some? (:locallyDerived calculatedFieldSettings)))

(defn locally-derived-transformations [field]
  (when (locally-derived-field? field)
    (-> field :calculatedFieldSettings :locallyDerived)))

(defn readonly-field?
  "Returns true if the field is read-only (either calculated or derived)."
  [field]
  (or (calculated-field? field)
      (locally-derived-field? field)))

(defn locally-derived-dependencies [field]
  (-> (locally-derived-transformations field)
      first
      :config
      :additionalFields))

(defn names-read-by-reactive-field
  "The set of field names `field` reads, from each of its transformations' `:additionalFields`."
  [field]
  (into #{}
        (mapcat (comp :additionalFields :config))
        (locally-derived-transformations field)))

(defn ensure-read-only-fields-don't-change!
  [fields new-entity old-entity]
  (let [field-names (keep calculated-field-kw fields)]
    (merge new-entity (select-keys old-entity field-names))))

(defn ensure-valid-field [field value]
  (let [coerced (coerced-field-value field value)]
    (if (checker field coerced)
      coerced
      ::invalid)))

(defn- ensure-every-entity-field-name-is-valid!
  [entity]
  (if-some [fields-that-will-break-postgres
            (->> (keys entity)
                 (keep (comp (partial re-matches #".*\..*") name))
                 (seq))]
    (client-util/throw ::client-util/malformed
                       [(str "Fields may not contain '.'. The following fields do: "
                             (str/join ", " fields-that-will-break-postgres))])
    entity))

(defn ensure-valid-fields!
  "Ensure `entity`, which is an entity that is about to be
  created or updated, conforms to any applicable fields.

  Add any missing fields to `entity`, initialized to the field's
  default value (provided it is not a list type field).

  Throw if `entity` doesn't typecheck."
  [fields
   entity]
  (->> entity
       (ensure-every-entity-field-name-is-valid!)
       (coerce fields)
       (typecheck! fields)
       (initialize-missing-fields fields)))

439	  missing or unauthorized. Pass a scenario-ctx for branch merges so branch-only
440	  references resolve. Used by PUT /api/reference/:id/merge and its scenario counterpart
441	  in scenario-api."

449	  [{:keys [tag-service] :as reference-service}
450	   ctx
451	   {:keys [subsumed-reference-ids merged-reference-data] :as payload}]
452	  (let [reference-ids-to-be-deleted (set subsumed-reference-ids)
453	        id-of-combined-reference (core/id merged-reference-data)
454	        references-to-be-deleted (->> (pq/by-ids reference-ids-to-be-deleted)
455	                                      (entity/query! reference-repo/config ctx))
456	        tags-to-be-added (->> (tag-repo/by-references references-to-be-deleted)
457	                              (entity/query! tag-repo/config ctx))
458	        combined-reference-original-data (->> (pq/by-id id-of-combined-reference)
459	                                              (entity/query-one! reference-repo/config ctx))]
460	    {:updated-reference (update! reference-service ctx (merge combined-reference-original-data merged-reference-data))
461	     :deleted-reference-ids (core/id-set (bulk-delete! reference-service ctx references-to-be-deleted))
462	     ;; We tag last, because the delete step above will modify the same tags during delete. If we
463	     ;; did it before the delete step, the versions of the tags we return here will already be stale.
464	     :updated-tags (if (seq tags-to-be-added)
465	                     (tag-service/tag! tag-service ctx (core/id-set tags-to-be-added) :reference id-of-combined-reference)
466	                     [])}))

525	   ctx

535	                                                         (entity/query-one! component-type-repo/config ctx)))
536	                                                  [source-comp target-comp])

541	                                                (:usedInWorkspaceIds %))

545	                                     {:sourceComponentType (:name source-comp-type)
546	                                      :referenceType (:name ref-type)
