(ns ardoq.service.reference-service
  (:require
   [ardoq.client.client-utils :as client-utils]
   [ardoq.core :as core]
   [ardoq.logger :as log]
   [ardoq.persistence.component-repo :as component-repo]
   [ardoq.persistence.component-type-repo :as component-type-repo]
   [ardoq.persistence.field-repo :as field-repo]
   [ardoq.persistence.global-field-repo :as global-field-repo]
   [ardoq.persistence.model-repo :as model-repo]
   [ardoq.persistence.postgres-entity :as entity]
   [ardoq.persistence.postgres-repo :as repo]
   [ardoq.persistence.postgres.branch.context :as branch-context]
   [ardoq.persistence.postgres.postgres :as postgres]
   [ardoq.persistence.postgres.postgres-query :as pq]
   [ardoq.persistence.reference-repo :as reference-repo]
   [ardoq.persistence.reference-type-repo :as reference-type-repo]
   [ardoq.persistence.tag-repo :as tag-repo]
   [ardoq.persistence.workspace-repo :as workspace-repo]
   [ardoq.scenarios.scenario-repo :as scenario-repo]
   [ardoq.service.authorization-service :as authorization-service]
   [ardoq.service.component-authorization :as component-auth]
   [ardoq.service.crud-service :as crud-service]
   [ardoq.service.event-service :as event-service]
   [ardoq.service.field-query-service :as field-query-service]
   [ardoq.service.global-field-service :as global-field-service]
   [ardoq.service.hook-service :as hook-service]
   [ardoq.service.locally-derived-field-service
    :as locally-derived-field-service]
   [ardoq.service.metadata-service :as metadata-service]
   [ardoq.service.metamodel-service-v2 :as metamodel-service-v2]
   [ardoq.service.metrics-service :as metrics-service]
   [ardoq.service.model-query-service :as model-query-service]
   [ardoq.service.model-service :as model-service]
   [ardoq.service.query-service :as query-service]
   [ardoq.service.tag-service :as tag-service]
   [ardoq.service.trace-service :as trace-service]
   [ardoq.utils :as util]
   [ardoq.utils.field-utils :as field-util]
   [ardoq.utils.model-utils :as model-util]
   [medley.core :as medley]))

(defn post-read [reference]
  (reference-repo/common-post-read reference))

(defn ->reference [source target type-id]
  {:source (core/id source)
   :target (core/id target)
   :rootWorkspace (:rootWorkspace source)
   :targetWorkspace (:rootWorkspace target)
   :type type-id})

(defn- reference->permission-holder
  "Either we return a mapping to the current scenario id (which is the permission holder
  in a scenario context), or we simply return the reference's rootWorkspace"
  [ctx _entities]
  (if-let [scenario-id (and (branch-context/branched-ctx ctx)
                            (->> (scenario-repo/by-branch-id (:branch ctx))
                                 (entity/query-one! scenario-repo/config ctx)
                                 core/id))]
    (fn [_entity]
      scenario-id)
    (fn [entity]
      (:rootWorkspace entity))))

(def service-config (merge reference-repo/config
                           {:service :reference-service
                            ::authorization-service/permission-holder-mapping-fn reference->permission-holder
                            ::authorization-service/policy
                            {:create {::authorization-service/action-policy authorization-service/custom}
                             :read {::authorization-service/action-policy authorization-service/admin
                                    ::authorization-service/permission {:action :read}}
                             :update {::authorization-service/action-policy authorization-service/custom}
                             :delete {::authorization-service/action-policy authorization-service/admin
                                      ::authorization-service/permission {:action :delete}}
                             :merge-references {::authorization-service/permission {:action :delete}
                                                ::authorization-service/action-policy authorization-service/admin}}}))

(defn- ensure-source-workspace [{:keys [rootWorkspace model] :as source} ref]
  (assoc ref :rootWorkspace rootWorkspace :model model))

(defn- ensure-target-workspace [{:keys [rootWorkspace] :as target} ref]
  (assoc ref :targetWorkspace rootWorkspace))

(defn- has-access-to-target-component? [ctx target-id]
  (let [target (entity/query-one! component-repo/unredacted-config ctx (pq/by-id target-id))]
    (authorization-service/authorized? component-auth/authorization-policy
                                       ctx (authorization-service/->op :read target))))

(defn- validate-source-and-target-comps
  [source-component target-component {:keys [source target rootWorkspace targetWorkspace] :as ref}]
  (cond
    (not (and source-component target-component))
    (let [missing-end (if source-component :target :source)
          msg (str (when-not source-component (str "Source id " (log/quote source) " doesn't exist. "))
                   (when-not target-component (str "Target id " (log/quote target) " doesn't exist.")))]
      (client-utils/throw ::client-utils/reference-endpoint-missing {:details msg}
                          (assoc (select-keys ref [:source :target :rootWorkspace :targetWorkspace])
                                 :missing-end missing-end)))

    ;; TODO this is quite incredibly hacky -- `rootWorkspace` _seems_ like it should be
    ;; required (in order to perform the auth check), but actually if you're an admin you'll
    ;; bypass the auth check and get the correct `rootWorkspace` in `ensure-source-workspace`.
    ;; Which means we can't enforce presence of `rootWorkspace` (which means that all callers of
    ;; reference create could possibly be introducing a bug by not repeating this check here and
    ;; simply passing a `source` & `target`...
    (and rootWorkspace
         (not= (:rootWorkspace source-component) rootWorkspace))
    (client-utils/throw ::client-utils/bad-reference-root-workspace
                        {:referenceWorkspaceId rootWorkspace
                         :sourceWorkspaceId (:rootWorkspace source-component)})

    ;; But not necessarily the targetWorkspace
    (and targetWorkspace
         (not= (:rootWorkspace target-component) targetWorkspace))
    (client-utils/throw ::client-utils/bad-reference-target-workspace
                        {:referenceWorkspaceId targetWorkspace
                         :targetWorkspaceId (:rootWorkspace target-component)}))

  ref)

(defn- validate-many [ctx references]
  (let [components (->> (pq/by-ids (mapcat (juxt :source :target) references))
                        (entity/query! component-repo/unredacted-config ctx)
                        (medley/index-by core/id))]
    (map (fn [{:keys [source target] :as reference}]
           (->> reference
                (validate-source-and-target-comps (get components (str source)) (get components (str target)))
                (ensure-source-workspace (get components (str source)))
                (ensure-target-workspace (get components (str target)))))
         references)))

(defn- add-model-many [ctx references]
  (let [workspaces (->> (pq/by-ids (map :rootWorkspace references))
                        (entity/query! workspace-repo/config ctx)
                        (medley/index-by core/id))]
    (map (fn [{ws-id :rootWorkspace :as reference}]
           (if-let [{model :componentModel} (get workspaces (str ws-id))]
             (assoc reference :model (str model))
             (client-utils/throw ::client-utils/reference-workspace-missing
                                 {:details (str "Workspace <" ws-id "> doesn't exist!")}
                                 (assoc (select-keys reference [:source :target :rootWorkspace :targetWorkspace])
                                        :missing-end :rootWorkspace))))
         references)))

(defn add-type-names*
  [models workspaces references]
  (let [id->model (core/by-id models)
        id->workspace (core/by-id workspaces)]
    (map (fn [{:keys [rootWorkspace] :as reference}]
           (if-let [model (->> (get id->workspace rootWorkspace) :componentModel (get id->model))]
             (core/add-transient reference :typeName (:name (model-util/model-entry model reference)))
             reference))
         references)))

(defn add-type-names! [ctx references]
  (let [workspaces (some->> (keep :rootWorkspace references)
                            not-empty
                            pq/by-ids
                            (entity/query! workspace-repo/config ctx))
        models (some->> workspaces
                        not-empty
                        model-repo/by-workspaces
                        (model-query-service/query! ctx))]
    (add-type-names* models workspaces references)))

(defn- references-created-metric [ctx references]
  (metrics-service/prometheus-org-metrics ctx)
  references)
(defn- references-deleted-metric [ctx]
  (metrics-service/prometheus-org-metrics ctx))

(defn- maybe-run-locally-derived-field-transformations
  [ctx transformations-done-by-someone-else? references]
  (if transformations-done-by-someone-else?
    references
    (let [fields (field-query-service/locally-derived-fields-applicable-to-references! ctx references)]
      (locally-derived-field-service/run-transformations-for-all fields references))))

(defn bulk-create-sans-events! [reference-service ctx references]
  (trace-service/with-span! ::bulk-create! {:count-references (count references)}
    (->> references
         (map #(merge {:order 1} %))
         (crud-service/pre-bulk-create-default! service-config ctx)
         (validate-many ctx)
         (add-model-many ctx)
         (model-service/ensure-valid-fields-many! ctx nil)
         (maybe-run-locally-derived-field-transformations ctx false)
         (entity/create-many! reference-service ctx)
         (add-type-names! ctx)
         (hook-service/run-hooks! hook-service/hooks ctx ::hook-service/references-created)
         (references-created-metric ctx)
         doall)))

(defn- graph-updated!
  "Announce committed graph changes, returning `entities`. Quiet inside a transaction -
  the writes aren't committed yet, so its owner announces them instead."
  [ctx entities]
  (when (and (seq entities) (not (postgres/in-transaction? ctx)))
    (hook-service/run-hooks! hook-service/hooks ctx ::hook-service/graph-updated nil))
  entities)

(defn bulk-create! [{:keys [event-service] :as reference-service} ctx references]
  (->> references
       (bulk-create-sans-events! reference-service ctx)
       (event-service/publish-events! event-service ctx :create)
       (graph-updated! ctx)))

(defn create! [reference-service ctx reference]
  (first (bulk-create! reference-service ctx [reference])))

(defn bulk-update-sans-events!
  [reference-service ctx references & [{:keys [skip-field-transformations?]}]]
  (trace-service/with-span! ::bulk-update! {:count-references (count references)}
    (if (empty? references)
      references
      (let [id->db-reference (->> (pq/by-ids (core/id-set references))
                                  (entity/query! reference-repo/config ctx)
                                  (medley/index-by core/id))]
        (->> references
             (map #(merge {:order 1} %))
             (map #(->> (-> %
                            (update :_id str)
                            (metadata-service/without-metadata))
                        (crud-service/coerce! (:spec reference-service))))
             (validate-many ctx)
             (model-service/ensure-valid-fields-many! ctx id->db-reference)
             (maybe-run-locally-derived-field-transformations ctx skip-field-transformations?)
             (entity/update-many! reference-service ctx id->db-reference)
             (add-type-names! ctx)
             (hook-service/run-hooks! hook-service/hooks ctx ::hook-service/references-updated)
             doall)))))

(defn bulk-update!
  [{:keys [event-service] :as reference-service} ctx references & [opts]]
  (->> (bulk-update-sans-events! reference-service ctx references opts)
       (event-service/publish-events! event-service ctx :update)
       (graph-updated! ctx)))

(defn update! [reference-service ctx reference]
  (first (bulk-update! reference-service ctx [reference])))

(defn- delete-references! [reference-service ctx references]
  (->> references
       (core/id-set)
       (partition-all pq/max-param-size)
       (mapcat #(entity/delete-by-query! reference-service ctx (pq/by-ids %)))))

(defn bulk-delete-sans-events! [{:keys [tag-service] :as reference-service} ctx references]
  ;; A reference might exist, but the ws has been marked for deletion, so we check that we can actually retrieve the
  ;; workspace for each reference
  (trace-service/with-span! ::bulk-delete! {:count-references (count references)}
    (when-let [references (not-empty (filter some? references))]
      (let [updated-tags (tag-service/untag-many! tag-service ctx (core/id-set references))]
        (delete-references! reference-service ctx references)
        (hook-service/run-hooks! hook-service/hooks ctx ::hook-service/references-deleted (core/id-set references))
        (references-deleted-metric ctx)
        {:references references
         :updated-tags updated-tags}))))

(defn bulk-delete! [{:keys [event-service] :as reference-service} ctx references]
  (let [result (bulk-delete-sans-events! reference-service ctx references)]
    (when result
      (event-service/publish-events! event-service ctx :update (:updated-tags result))
      (event-service/publish-events! event-service ctx :delete (:references result)))
    (graph-updated! ctx (:references result))))

(defn delete! [reference-service ctx reference]
  (first (bulk-delete! reference-service ctx [reference])))

(defn- ensure-good-reference-type! [model entity]
  (when (nil? (get-in model [:referenceTypes (keyword (str (:type entity)))]))
    (client-utils/throw ::client-utils/bad-reference-type {:referenceType (str (:type entity))
                                                           :referenceId (core/id entity)} entity)))

(defn- ensure-good-root-workspace-and-model! [reference source-component]
  (when (and (:rootWorkspace reference)
             (not= (:rootWorkspace source-component) (:rootWorkspace reference)))
    (client-utils/throw ::client-utils/root-workspace-must-match-source
                        [(:rootWorkspace reference) (:rootWorkspace source-component)]
                        reference))
  (when (and (:model reference)
             (not= (:model source-component) (:model reference)))
    (client-utils/throw ::client-utils/model-must-match-source
                        {:referenceModel (:model reference)
                         :sourceModel (:model source-component)}
                        reference)))

(defn- processable?*
  [models sources {:keys [action entity new-entity] :as op}]
  (cond
    (= :create action)
    (let [source (get sources (:source entity))
          model (get models (:model source))]
      (ensure-good-root-workspace-and-model! entity source)
      (ensure-good-reference-type! model entity)
      true)

    (= :update action)
    (let [source (get sources (:source new-entity))
          model (get models (:model new-entity))]
      (when (not= (:rootWorkspace source) (:rootWorkspace entity))
        (log/info "Changing root workspace of reference"))
      (ensure-good-root-workspace-and-model! new-entity source)
      (ensure-good-reference-type! model new-entity)
      true)

    :else op))

(defmethod crud-service/every-processable? :reference-service
  [service ctx operations]
  (let [create-sources (->> (filter (comp #{:create} :action) operations)
                            (keep (comp :source :entity)))
        update-sources (->> (filter (comp #{:update} :action) operations)
                            (keep (comp :source :new-entity)))
        sources (some->> (into create-sources update-sources)
                         not-empty
                         pq/by-ids
                         (entity/query! component-repo/unredacted-config ctx))
        models (some->> (map :rootWorkspace sources)
                        not-empty
                        pq/by-ids
                        (entity/query! workspace-repo/config ctx)
                        (map :componentModel)
                        pq/by-ids
                        (model-query-service/query! ctx)
                        (medley/index-by core/id))
        sources (medley/index-by core/id sources)]
    (reduce (fn [acc operation]
              (if-let [unprocessable (crud-service/unprocessable-response (processable?* models sources operation))]
                (reduced unprocessable)
                acc))
            true
            operations)))

(defmethod crud-service/processable? :reference-service
  [service ctx op]
  (crud-service/every-processable? service ctx [op]))

(defn on-workspace-deleted! [reference-service ctx workspace-id]
  (->> (repeatedly #(entity/delete-by-query! reference-service ctx
                                             [:in :_id (reference-repo/delete-by-workspace-id-chunk-query workspace-id)]))
       (take-while not-empty)
       (mapcat identity)
       (doall)))

(defn- with-derived-fields*
  [reference model-id->type-id->name readable-ids component-id->component]
  (let [readable-name (fn [component-id]
                        (when (contains? readable-ids component-id)
                          (:name (get component-id->component component-id))))
        source-name (readable-name (:source reference))
        target-name (readable-name (:target reference))
        type-name (or (get-in model-id->type-id->name [(:model reference) (:type reference)])
                      (when (:virtual reference) (:virtualType (get reference core/ardoq-field-name)))
                      "Unknown")]
    (update reference core/ardoq-field-name
            #(cond-> (assoc % :typeName type-name)
               source-name (assoc :sourceName source-name)
               target-name (assoc :targetName target-name)))))

(defn with-derived-data
  "Attach derived `sourceName`, `targetName`, and `typeName` to each reference.
   Omits `:sourceName`/`:targetName` when the caller cannot read the
   corresponding component's workspace; bypassed for system-user contexts.
   `:typeName` is always populated (metamodel is non-confidential)."
  [ctx references]
  (let [model-id->type-id->name
        (->> (entity/query! reference-type-repo/config ctx
                            (reference-type-repo/by-model-ids (util/fn-set :model references))
                            [:modelId :id :name])
             (reduce (fn [acc rt]
                       (assoc-in acc [(:modelId rt) (:id rt)] (:name rt)))
                     {}))
        components
        (entity/query! component-repo/unredacted-config
                       ctx
                       (pq/by-ids
                        (into
                         (util/fn-set :source references)
                         (util/fn-set :target references)))
                       [:name :rootWorkspace])
        readable-ids (component-auth/readable-component-ids! ctx components)
        component-id->component (core/by-id components)]
    (map #(with-derived-fields* % model-id->type-id->name readable-ids component-id->component)
         references)))

(defn query-one-with-deps-fn! [ctx q deps-fn]
  (some->> q
           (entity/query-one! reference-repo/config ctx)
           vector
           (deps-fn ctx)
           first))

(defn query-one! [ctx q]
  (query-one-with-deps-fn! ctx q with-derived-data))

(defn query! [ctx q]
  (->> q
       (entity/query! reference-repo/config ctx)
       (with-derived-data ctx)))

(defn query-simple!
  "This differs from `query!` by _not_ adding derived data to the returned entities."
  ([ctx q] (entity/query! reference-repo/config ctx q))
  ([ctx q fields] (entity/query! reference-repo/config ctx q fields)))

(defn count-by-type-in-workspace!
  "Counts the references rooted in `workspace-id`, grouped by `type`. Returns
   a `type->count` map; a type with no references is simply absent."
  [ctx workspace-id]
  (->> (reference-repo/count-by-type-in-workspace workspace-id)
       (repo/execute! reference-repo/config ctx)
       (core/index-by :type :count)))

(defmethod query-service/query-one! :reference-service [_ ctx q]
  (query-one! ctx q))

(defmethod query-service/query! :reference-service [_ ctx q]
  (query! ctx q))

(defmethod query-service/query-one-simple! :reference-service [_ ctx q]
  (query-one-with-deps-fn! ctx q (fn [_ xs] xs)))

(defmethod query-service/query-simple! :reference-service [_ ctx q]
  (query-simple! ctx q))

(defn update-many! [reference-service ctx references]
  (->> (entity/update-many! reference-service ctx references)
       (with-derived-data ctx)))

(defn ->merge-references-payload [merged-reference-data subsumed-reference-ids]
  {:merged-reference-data merged-reference-data
   :subsumed-reference-ids subsumed-reference-ids})

(defn subsumed-refs-authorized?!
  "Fetches each reference in `subsumed-reference-ids` and checks that the caller has
  :merge-references permission on all of them in `ctx`. Returns false if any ID is
  missing or unauthorized. Pass a scenario-ctx for branch merges so branch-only
  references resolve. Used by PUT /api/reference/:id/merge and its scenario counterpart
  in scenario-api."
  [reference-service ctx subsumed-reference-ids]
  (let [subsumed-refs (entity/query! reference-repo/config ctx (pq/by-ids subsumed-reference-ids))]
    (and (= (count subsumed-refs) (count (distinct subsumed-reference-ids)))
         (authorization-service/every-authorized?
          reference-service ctx :merge-references subsumed-refs))))

(defn merge-references
  [{:keys [tag-service] :as reference-service}
   ctx
   {:keys [subsumed-reference-ids merged-reference-data] :as payload}]
  (let [reference-ids-to-be-deleted (set subsumed-reference-ids)
        id-of-combined-reference (core/id merged-reference-data)
        references-to-be-deleted (->> (pq/by-ids reference-ids-to-be-deleted)
                                      (entity/query! reference-repo/config ctx))
        tags-to-be-added (->> (tag-repo/by-references references-to-be-deleted)
                              (entity/query! tag-repo/config ctx))
        combined-reference-original-data (->> (pq/by-id id-of-combined-reference)
                                              (entity/query-one! reference-repo/config ctx))]
    {:updated-reference (update! reference-service ctx (merge combined-reference-original-data merged-reference-data))
     :deleted-reference-ids (core/id-set (bulk-delete! reference-service ctx references-to-be-deleted))
     ;; We tag last, because the delete step above will modify the same tags during delete. If we
     ;; did it before the delete step, the versions of the tags we return here will already be stale.
     :updated-tags (if (seq tags-to-be-added)
                     (tag-service/tag! tag-service ctx (core/id-set tags-to-be-added) :reference id-of-combined-reference)
                     [])}))

(def ^:private allowed-searchable-reserved-fields
  ;; This is a map from reference attribute name, to the parse fn and failure
  ;; error that converts a string to the corresponding value that is searchable in
  ;; the database
  {:type {:parse-fn (fn [field-name value]
                      (reference-repo/by-type-id (util/parse-long! value)))
          :failure-error ::client-utils/bad-type-value-in-reference-search}
   :source {:parse-fn (fn [field-name value]
                        (reference-repo/by-source-id (util/ensure!
                                                      (when (core/id? value)
                                                        value))))
            :failure-error ::client-utils/bad-endpoint-value-in-reference-search}
   :target {:parse-fn (fn [field-name value]
                        (reference-repo/by-target-id (util/ensure!
                                                      (when (core/id? value)
                                                        value))))
            :failure-error ::client-utils/bad-endpoint-value-in-reference-search}})

(defn search [ctx ws-id field-name value]
  (let [field-type (->> (global-field-repo/by-name (name field-name))
                        (global-field-service/query-one! ctx)
                        :type)
        search-query (field-repo/->search-query allowed-searchable-reserved-fields
                                                field-name
                                                value
                                                field-type)
        query-fn (if ws-id
                   (partial reference-repo/by-field-value-in-workspace ws-id)
                   (fn [q] q))]
    (->> (query-fn search-query)
         (entity/query! reference-repo/config ctx)
         (authorization-service/filter-authorized service-config ctx :read))))

(defn preceding-versions! [ctx references]
  (query-service/preceding-versions! service-config ctx references))

(defn- record-recalculation-time [time reference]
  (assoc-in reference [core/ardoq-persistent-field-name :last-recalculation-time] time))

(defn set-field-values! [{:keys [event-service] :as reference-service} ctx field new-values]
  (trace-service/with-span! ::set-reference-field-values (count new-values)
    (let [ref-id->partial (field-util/coerce-field-values field new-values)
          db-refs (->> (pq/by-ids (keys ref-id->partial))
                       (query! ctx))]
      (->> db-refs
           (field-util/merge-updates ref-id->partial)
           (maybe-run-locally-derived-field-transformations ctx false)
           (map (partial record-recalculation-time (:user-time ctx)))
           (update-many! reference-service (repo/calculated-field-ctx ctx))
           (event-service/publish-events! event-service ctx :update)
           (hook-service/run-hooks! hook-service/hooks ctx ::hook-service/references-updated)
           count))))

(defn sorted-most-used-ref-types
  "Returns a collection of sorted reference type names by most frequently used
  in the workspace for the given source and target components."
  [{:keys [metamodel-service-v2] :as reference-service}
   ctx
   {:keys [source target rootWorkspace] :as params}]
  (let [[source-comp target-comp] (->> (pq/by-ids [source target])
                                       (entity/query! component-repo/unredacted-config ctx)
                                       ((fn [components]
                                          [(medley/find-first (comp #{source} :_id) components)
                                           (medley/find-first (comp #{target} :_id) components)])))

        [source-comp-type target-comp-type] (mapv (fn [{:keys [model typeId]}]
                                                    (->> (component-type-repo/by-model-id-and-type-id model typeId)
                                                         (entity/query-one! component-type-repo/config ctx)))
                                                  [source-comp target-comp])

        org-model-info (metamodel-service-v2/generate! metamodel-service-v2 ctx)

        root-workspace-ref-types (filter #(some (partial = rootWorkspace)
                                                (:usedInWorkspaceIds %))
                                         (:referenceTypes org-model-info))

        workspace-triples-set (set (for [ref-type root-workspace-ref-types]
                                     {:sourceComponentType (:name source-comp-type)
                                      :referenceType (:name ref-type)
                                      :targetComponentType (:name target-comp-type)}))

        workspace-triple-stats (filter #(some (partial = (dissoc % :count))
                                              workspace-triples-set)
                                       (:triples org-model-info))

        ref-type->count (core/index-by :referenceType :count workspace-triple-stats)

        reftype-options-with-counts (map (fn [{:keys [name] :as triple}]
                                           ;; :referenceType in triple stats matches :name in workspace ref types
                                           (let [count (get ref-type->count name 0)]
                                             (assoc triple :count count)))
                                         root-workspace-ref-types)
        no-frequencies-found-value nil]
    (if (empty? workspace-triple-stats)
      no-frequencies-found-value
      (->> reftype-options-with-counts
           (sort-by :count (comp - compare))
           (map :name)))))

(defn with-custom-field
  "Return a map from reference _id to custom field value for the given `field`.

  (Faster than fetching the whole row.)"
  [ctx workspace-id reference-types global-field]
  (when (seq reference-types)
    (->> (entity/query! reference-repo/config ctx
                        (reference-repo/by-workspace-id-and-type-ids
                         workspace-id reference-types)
                        [:_id (pq/select-only-custom-field-name (:name global-field)
                                                                :custom-field)])
         (core/index-by core/id :custom-field))))

(defn- check-action-authorized-on-target-component [reference-service ctx op entity]
  (let [target-id (:target entity)
        reference-access? (authorization-service/admin-or-permission-enforcement reference-service ctx op)
        target-comp-access? (has-access-to-target-component? ctx target-id)]
    (and reference-access? target-comp-access?)))

(defmethod authorization-service/action-authorized? [:reference-service :create]
  [reference-service ctx {:keys [entity] :as op}]
  (check-action-authorized-on-target-component reference-service ctx op entity))

(defmethod authorization-service/action-authorized? [:reference-service :update]
  [reference-service ctx {:keys [new-entity] :as op}]
  (check-action-authorized-on-target-component reference-service ctx op new-entity))

(defn rename-custom-field!
  [reference-service ctx old-name new-name]
  (->> (reference-repo/rename-custom-field-query old-name new-name)
       (entity/execute! reference-service ctx)))

(defn convert-custom-field-values!
  "When this runs, the `global-field` and all its instances have been updated in the DB.
   Updates the value of the field in all references according to the `old-value->new-value` fn."
  [reference-service ctx global-field old-value->new-value]
  (let [attribute (-> global-field :name keyword)
        references-with-field (query! ctx (reference-repo/has-field-with-some-value global-field))]
    (->> references-with-field
         (mapv #(update % attribute old-value->new-value))
         (entity/update-many! reference-service ctx))))

(defrecord ReferenceService []
  crud-service/ICrud
  (create! [service ctx entity]
    (create! service ctx entity))
  (update! [service ctx entity]
    (update! service ctx entity))
  (delete! [service ctx entity]
    (delete! service ctx entity))
  crud-service/IBulkCrud
  (bulk-create! [service ctx entity]
    (bulk-create! service ctx entity))
  (bulk-update! [service ctx entity]
    (bulk-update! service ctx entity))
  (bulk-delete! [service ctx entity]
    (bulk-delete! service ctx entity)))

(defn reference-service [config]
  (map->ReferenceService service-config))

(ns ardoq.service.model-integrity-checks
  {:team "core"}
  (:require
   [ardoq.core :as core]
   [ardoq.persistence.component-type-repo :as component-type-repo]
   [ardoq.persistence.model-repo :as model-repo]
   [ardoq.persistence.model-template-repo :as model-template-repo]
   [ardoq.persistence.postgres-entity :as entity]
   [ardoq.persistence.postgres.branch.context :as branch-context]
   [ardoq.persistence.postgres.branch.tables :as branch-tables]
   [ardoq.persistence.postgres.postgres :as pg]
   [ardoq.persistence.postgres.postgres-query :as pq]
   [ardoq.persistence.reference-type-repo :as reference-type-repo]
   [ardoq.specs :as specs]
   [ardoq.utils.component-type-util :as component-type-util]
   [ardoq.utils.model-utils :as model-util]
   [ardoq.utils.reference-type-util :as reference-type-util]
   [honey.sql.helpers :as hh]
   [medley.core :as medley]
   [superstring.core :as str]))

(defn inconsistent-component-type-hierarchies [ctx]
  (->> (entity/query! model-repo/config ctx pq/all)
       (mapcat model-util/bad-type-hierarchy?)))

(defn unused-models [ctx]
  (entity/query! model-repo/config ctx
                 [:not [:in :_id (-> (hh/select :componentModel)
                                     (hh/from :workspace))]]))

(defn component-types-only-in-model! [ctx]
  (pg/execute! (:org-ds ctx)
               (if (branch-context/on-master? ctx)
                 (-> (hh/select :model :typeId)
                     (hh/from :component_type_view)
                     (hh/where [:not [:in [:composite :model :typeId]
                                      (-> (hh/select :modelId :id)
                                          (hh/from :component_type))]]))
                 (-> (hh/select :model :typeId)
                     (hh/from :branched_component_type_view)
                     (hh/where (pq/and (branch-tables/by-branch-id ctx)
                                       [:not [:in [:composite :model :typeId branch-tables/branch-column]
                                              (-> (hh/select :modelId :id branch-tables/branch-column)
                                                  (hh/from :branched_component_type))]]))))))

(defn component-types-not-in-model! [ctx]
  (pg/execute! (:org-ds ctx)
               (if (branch-context/on-master? ctx)
                 (-> (hh/select [:modelId :model] [:id :typeId])
                     (hh/from :component_type)
                     (hh/where [:not [:in [:composite :modelId :id]
                                      (-> (hh/select :model :typeId)
                                          (hh/from :component_type_view))]]))
                 (-> (hh/select [:modelId :model] [:id :typeId])
                     (hh/from :branched_component_type)
                     (hh/where (pq/and (branch-tables/by-branch-id ctx)
                                       [:not [:in [:composite :modelId :id branch-tables/branch-column]
                                              (-> (hh/select :model :typeId branch-tables/branch-column)
                                                  (hh/from :branched_component_type_view))]]))))))

(defn component-types-with-divergent-data! [ctx]
  (let [models (entity/query! model-repo/config ctx pq/all)
        component-types-by-model-id (->> pq/all
                                         (entity/query! component-type-repo/config ctx)
                                         (group-by :modelId))]
    (reduce (fn same-data? [problems model]
              (let [component-entries (model-util/component-entries model)
                    component-types (get component-types-by-model-id (core/id model))
                    component-types-by-typeId (medley/index-by :id component-types)
                    bad-data (remove
                              (fn equal-entry? [{:keys [id] :as component-entry}]
                                (let [component-type (get component-types-by-typeId id)]
                                  (=
                                   (dissoc (component-type-util/prune component-entry)
                                           ;; none of these should have `parent` but some do...
                                           :parent)
                                   (component-type-util/->model-entry component-type))))
                              component-entries)
                    parents-dont-match
                    (mapcat (fn [{parent-typeId :id
                                  children :children :as component-entry}]
                              (keep (fn [child-typeId]
                                      (let [parent-in-component-type
                                            (:parent (get component-types-by-typeId child-typeId))]
                                        (when (not= parent-in-component-type parent-typeId)
                                          {:parent-in-model-root parent-typeId
                                           :parent-in-component-type parent-in-component-type
                                           :component-entry-in-model-root component-entry})))
                                    (map name (keys children))))
                            component-entries)]
                (if (and (empty? bad-data) (empty? parents-dont-match))
                  problems
                  (conj problems {:model-id (core/id model)
                                  :bad-data bad-data
                                  :parents-dont-match parents-dont-match}))))
            nil
            models)))

(defn component-types-with-broken-image-attachment-uris! [ctx]
  (let [component-types (entity/query! component-type-repo/config ctx pq/all)
        has-image? (fn [{image-uri :image :as component}]
                     (and (some? image-uri)
                          (not (str/blank? image-uri))))
        attachment-id-is-not-_id? (fn [{image-uri :image :as component}]
                                    (let [;; See `attachment-service/attachment->uri` to see how segments are created
                                          uri-segments (str/split image-uri #"/")
                                          attachment-id (last uri-segments)]
                                      ((complement core/id?) attachment-id)))]
    (filter #(and (has-image? %)
                  (attachment-id-is-not-_id? %))
            component-types)))

(defn usable-color?
  "True when `color` is a non-blank color the frontend can actually render."
  [color]
  (and (not (str/blank? color))
       (or (specs/hex-color? color)
           (specs/allowed-named-css-color? color)
           (specs/rgba-css-color? color))))

(defn component-types-with-color-issues!
  "A blank `color` makes the frontend fall back to the hierarchy-level color; an unrecognized
  (non-blank, malformed) `color` is passed through as-is and renders unstyled. Returns the full
  component-type row plus `:issue`, so callers can act on a violation without a second fetch."
  [ctx]
  (->> (entity/query! component-type-repo/config ctx pq/all)
       (keep (fn [{:keys [color] :as component-type}]
               (cond
                 (str/blank? color) (assoc component-type :issue :missing)
                 (not (usable-color? color)) (assoc component-type :issue :invalid))))))

(defn reference-types-only-in-model! [ctx]
  (pg/execute! (:org-ds ctx)
               (if (branch-context/on-master? ctx)
                 (-> (hh/select :model :typeId)
                     (hh/from :reference_type_view)
                     (hh/where [:not [:in [:composite :model :typeId]
                                      (-> (hh/select :modelId :id)
                                          (hh/from :reference_type))]]))
                 (-> (hh/select :model :typeId)
                     (hh/from :branched_reference_type_view)
                     (hh/where (pq/and (branch-tables/by-branch-id ctx)
                                       [:not [:in [:composite :model :typeId branch-tables/branch-column]
                                              (-> (hh/select :modelId :id branch-tables/branch-column)
                                                  (hh/from :branched_reference_type))]]))))))

(defn reference-types-not-in-model! [ctx]
  (pg/execute! (:org-ds ctx)
               (if (branch-context/on-master? ctx)
                 (-> (hh/select [:modelId :model] [:id :typeId])
                     (hh/from :reference_type)
                     (hh/where [:not [:in [:composite :modelId :id]
                                      (-> (hh/select :model :typeId)
                                          (hh/from :reference_type_view))]]))
                 (-> (hh/select [:modelId :model] [:id :typeId])
                     (hh/from :branched_reference_type)
                     (hh/where (pq/and (branch-tables/by-branch-id ctx)
                                       [:not [:in [:composite :modelId :id branch-tables/branch-column]
                                              (-> (hh/select :model :typeId branch-tables/branch-column)
                                                  (hh/from :branched_reference_type_view))]]))))))

(defn reference-types-with-divergent-data! [ctx]
  (let [models (entity/query! model-repo/config ctx pq/all)
        reference-types-by-model-id (->> pq/all
                                         (entity/query! reference-type-repo/config ctx)
                                         (group-by :modelId))]
    (reduce
     (fn divergent-data? [problems model]
       (let [reference-entries (model-util/reference-entries model)
             reference-types (get reference-types-by-model-id (core/id model))
             reference-types-by-typeId (medley/index-by :id reference-types)
             new-problems
             (->> reference-entries
                  (keep
                   (fn divergent-entry? [{:keys [id] :as reference-entry}]
                     (let [reference-type (get reference-types-by-typeId id)]
                       (when (not=
                              ;; If a `reference-entry`has a `nil` value the key is sometimes
                              ;; omitted.
                              (select-keys reference-type (keys reference-entry))
                              (reference-type-util/prune reference-entry))
                         id))))
                  seq)]
         (if new-problems
           (conj problems {:model-id (core/id model) :reference-ids new-problems})
           problems)))
     nil
     models)))

(defn model-ids-with-broken-or-missing-implicit-reference-type! [ctx]
  (let [non-template-model-ids (->> (entity/query! model-repo/config ctx pq/all [:_id])
                                    core/id-set)
        model-id->reference-types (->> (entity/query! reference-type-repo/config ctx pq/all)
                                       (group-by :modelId))
        has-valid-implicit-reference-type? (fn [model-id]
                                             (let [reference-types (model-id->reference-types model-id)]
                                               (->> reference-types
                                                    (filter (fn [ref-type]
                                                              (and (= "Implicit" (:name ref-type))
                                                                   (= 2 (:id ref-type)))))
                                                    first
                                                    some?)))]
    (reduce
     (fn [problematic-model-ids model-id]
       (if (has-valid-implicit-reference-type? model-id)
         problematic-model-ids
         (conj problematic-model-ids model-id)))
     #{}
     non-template-model-ids)))

(defn unsupported-arrow-type?
  "Whether `arrow-type` is a value the frontend has no arrow head for. A missing arrow type is
  not one of them — `metamodel-service-v2` serves it as \"none\", i.e. a line without a head."
  [arrow-type]
  (and (some? arrow-type)
       (not (contains? model-repo/valid-arrow-types arrow-type))))

(defn reference-types-with-invalid-arrow-types! [ctx]
  (->> (entity/query! reference-type-repo/config ctx pq/all)
       (filter (fn [{:keys [lineBeginning lineEnding] :as reference-type}]
                 (or (unsupported-arrow-type? lineBeginning)
                     (unsupported-arrow-type? lineEnding))))))

(defn model-templates-with-invalid-arrow-types! [ctx]
  (->> (entity/query! model-template-repo/config ctx pq/all)
       (filter (fn [{:keys [referenceTypes]}]
                 (some (fn [{:keys [lineBeginning lineEnding]}]
                         (or (unsupported-arrow-type? lineBeginning)
                             (unsupported-arrow-type? lineEnding)))
                       (vals referenceTypes))))))

(defn- field->arrow-type-counts
  "How often each unsupported value occurs, per field, so a failing check says what to fix
  and where."
  [reference-types]
  (let [unsupported-frequencies (fn [arrow-types]
                                  (frequencies (filter unsupported-arrow-type? arrow-types)))]
    {:lineBeginning (unsupported-frequencies (map :lineBeginning reference-types))
     :lineEnding (unsupported-frequencies (map :lineEnding reference-types))}))

(defn run-integrity-checks! [ctx]
  [{:description "model.root hierarchy is consistent"
    :passed? (zero? (count (inconsistent-component-type-hierarchies ctx)))
    :stable? true}
   {:description "All non-template models have a workspace"
    :passed? (zero? (count (unused-models ctx)))
    :stable? true}
   {:description "All model.root types exist in component_type table"
    :passed? (zero? (count (component-types-only-in-model! ctx)))
    :stable? true}
   {:description "All component_type table rows exist in model.root types"
    :passed? (zero? (count (component-types-not-in-model! ctx)))
    :stable? true}
   (let [divergent-models (component-types-with-divergent-data! ctx)]
     {:description "Attribute values of model.root types are identical to component_type table"
      :passed? (empty? divergent-models)
      :stable? true
      :data (when (seq divergent-models)
              {:model-count (count divergent-models)
               :bad-data-count (reduce + (map (comp count :bad-data) divergent-models))
               :parent-mismatch-count (reduce + (map (comp count :parents-dont-match) divergent-models))})})
   (let [violating-component-types-count (count (component-types-with-broken-image-attachment-uris! ctx))]
     {:description "All component type image (attachment) URIs point to the attachment's _id"
      :passed? (zero? violating-component-types-count)
      :data {:count violating-component-types-count}})
   (let [violating-component-types (component-types-with-color-issues! ctx)]
     {:description "All component types have a usable (non-blank, valid) color"
      :passed? (empty? violating-component-types)
      :data (merge {:count (count violating-component-types)}
                   (when (seq violating-component-types)
                     {:ids (map core/id violating-component-types)
                      :by-issue (frequencies (map :issue violating-component-types))
                      :level-counts (frequencies (map :level violating-component-types))
                      :model-count (count (distinct (map :modelId violating-component-types)))
                      :invalid-color-counts (frequencies (keep #(when (= :invalid (:issue %)) (:color %))
                                                               violating-component-types))}))})
   {:description "All model.referenceTypes exist in reference_type table"

(ns ardoq.service.component-integrity-checks
  {:team "core"}
  (:require
   [ardoq.core :as core]
   [ardoq.persistence.component-repo :as component-repo]
   [ardoq.persistence.component-type-repo :as component-type-repo]
   [ardoq.persistence.field-repo :as field-repo]
   [ardoq.persistence.postgres-entity :as entity]
   [ardoq.persistence.postgres.branch.branch-only :as branch-only]
   [ardoq.persistence.postgres.branch.tables :as branch-tables]
   [ardoq.persistence.postgres.postgres :as postgres]
   [ardoq.persistence.postgres.postgres-query :as pq]
   [ardoq.persistence.workspace-repo :as workspace-repo]
   [ardoq.service.component-service :as component-service]
   [ardoq.service.field-query-service :as field-query-service]
   [ardoq.utils.field-utils :as field-util]
   [honey.sql.helpers :as hh]
   [honey.sql.pg-ops :as hpg]
   [superstring.core :as str]))

(def invisible-char-sql-pattern
  "PostgreSQL regex pattern for invisible/zero-width Unicode characters.
   \\u200B - Zero-width space
   \\u2060 - Word joiner
   \\uFEFF - Byte order mark (BOM)"
  "[\\u200B\\u2060\\uFEFF]")

(defn components-with-invisible-characters
  "Find components with invisible/zero-width characters in their names."
  [ctx]
  (postgres/execute! (:org-ds ctx)
                     (-> (hh/select :_id)
                         (hh/from :component)
                         (hh/where [hpg/tilde :name [:inline invisible-char-sql-pattern]]))))

(defn history-out-of-sync?
  "List selected details of [branched] component history entries with version = live ones (they should always be less).
  BEWARE: This may likely be expensive if the live or history tables are large."
  [ctx]
  (let [extra-cols (when (:branch ctx) [branch-tables/branch-column])]
    (postgres/execute!
     (:org-ds ctx)
     (-> (apply hh/select :_id :_version :is_deletion :lastUpdated extra-cols)
         (hh/from (if (:branch ctx)
                    :branched_component__history
                    :component__history))
         (hh/where [:in (vec (concat [:composite :_id :_version] extra-cols))
                    (-> (apply hh/select :_id :_version extra-cols)
                        (hh/from (if (:branch ctx)
                                   :branched_component
                                   :component)))])))))

(defn duplicate-history-rows
  "List (_id, _version, is_deletion) groups in component__history
  that contain more than one row. A duplicate row indicates a bug — restore
  or sync should never insert two history rows for the same logical version."
  [ctx]
  (let [group-cols [:_id :_version :is_deletion]]
    (postgres/execute!
     (:org-ds ctx)

(ns ardoq.service.integrity-check-registry
  "Central registry for all data integrity checks in the system.

  ## Two Registries: Global and Per-Org

  The system maintains two separate registries for different scopes of integrity checks:

  - **`registry-global`**: System-wide checks that run with housekeeping context (access to both
    ardoq and ardoq_customers databases). Use for cross-database or system-level validations
    like invalid indices, global configuration, or ardoq database table checks.

  - **`registry-per-org`**: Organization-scoped checks that run per-org with org context. Use for
    customer data validation within a specific organization's schema (components, references,
    workspaces, etc.).

  ## Adding a New Integrity Check

  1. Implement a public `run-integrity-checks!` function in your service namespace:

     ```clojure
     (defn run-integrity-checks! [ctx]
       [{:description \"Components have valid type IDs\"
         :stable? true
         :passed? (every? valid-type-id? components)}])
     ```

  2. Add your check to the appropriate registry:

     ```clojure
     {:group \"my-group\"
      :check-fn my-service/run-integrity-checks!}
     ```

  3. If your check needs access to the full system (rare), mark it with `:requires-system? true`:

     ```clojure
     {:group \"my-group\"
      :check-fn my-service/run-integrity-checks!
      :requires-system? true}  ; check-fn will be called with (system ctx) instead of (ctx)
     ```

  ## Return Format

  Each check function must return a sequence of maps with:
  - `:description` (required) - String describing what the check validates
  - `:passed?` (required) - Boolean indicating if validation passed
  - `:stable?` (optional) - When true, failures log as errors; omit to log as warnings
  - `:data` (optional) - Diagnostic info for failures (keep small, no sensitive data)

  ## Execution

  - **Per-org checks** run nightly per organization via `ardoq.utils.integrity-job-utils/check-job-per-org-kw`
  - **Global checks** run nightly once via `ardoq.utils.integrity-job-utils/check-job-global-kw`
  - Both can be invoked manually via `ardoq.service.integrity-service/lint!` with the appropriate registry"
  (:require
   [ardoq.auth.saml-integrity-checks :as saml-integrity-checks]
   [ardoq.branch.branch-integrity-checks :as branch-integrity-checks]
   [ardoq.broadcasts.broadcast-integrity-checks
    :as broadcast-integrity-checks]
   [ardoq.dashboards.integrity-checks :as dashboard-integrity-checks]

                     (-> (hh/select :_id :name)

(defn- combined-date-range-fields-query []
  (-> (hh/select :c._id :fkey :fval)
      (hh/from [:component :c]
               [(hh/lateral [:jsonb_each :c.__ardoqCustomFields])
                [[:t :fkey :fval]]])
      (hh/where (pq/and [hpg/? :fval [:inline "start"]]
                        [hpg/? :fval [:inline "end"]]))))

(defn combined-date-range-fields
  "Returns components that have any field with the {:start ... :end ...} structure."
  [ctx]
  (postgres/execute! (:org-ds ctx) (combined-date-range-fields-query)))

(defn combined-date-range-fields-and-same-date-fields
  "Returns components that have any field with the {:start ... :end ...} structure
   and _start_date and _end_date has been set to the same date."
  [ctx]
  (postgres/execute!
   (:org-ds ctx)
   (-> (combined-date-range-fields-query)
       (hh/where (pq/and [:= [:-> pq/ardoq-custom-fields-column [:|| :fkey [:inline "_start_date"]]]
                          [:-> :fval [:inline "start"]]]
                         [:= [:-> pq/ardoq-custom-fields-column [:|| :fkey [:inline "_end_date"]]]
                          [:-> :fval [:inline "end"]]])))))

(defn combined-date-range-fields-and-null-date-fields
  "Returns components that have any field with the {:start ... :end ...} structure.
   and _start_date and _end_date has been set to null."
  [ctx]
  (postgres/execute!
   (:org-ds ctx)
   (-> (combined-date-range-fields-query)
       (hh/where (pq/and [:= [:-> pq/ardoq-custom-fields-column [:|| :fkey [:inline "_start_date"]]]
                          [:inline "null"]]
                         [:= [:-> pq/ardoq-custom-fields-column [:|| :fkey [:inline "_end_date"]]]
                          [:inline "null"]])))))

   (:org-ds ctx)

       (hh/select :c._id :c.model :c.typeId :c.componentTypeId :ct.modelId :ct.id)

57	  "Creates component types by updating all their respective models.
58	  Returns the created component types."
59	  [{:keys [model-service] :as component-type-service} ctx component-types]
60	  (pg/with-transaction-on-org ctx
61	    (doseq [[model-id create-comp-types] (group-by :modelId component-types)]
62	      (let [old-model (model-service/query-one-model-or-org-template! ctx (pq/by-id model-id))

65	            updated-model (model-util/recreate-root old-model updated-comp-types)]

(ns ardoq.service.component-type-service
  {:team "core"}
  (:require
   [ardoq.core :as core]
   [ardoq.persistence.component-type-repo :as component-type-repo]
   [ardoq.persistence.global-field-component-type-repo
    :as global-field-component-type-repo]
   [ardoq.persistence.global-field-repo :as global-field-repo]
   [ardoq.persistence.postgres-entity :as entity]
   [ardoq.persistence.postgres-repo :as repo]
   [ardoq.persistence.postgres.postgres :as pg]
   [ardoq.persistence.postgres.postgres-query :as pq]
   [ardoq.persistence.workspace-repo :as workspace-repo]
   [ardoq.service.authorization-service :as authorization-service]
   [ardoq.service.global-field-service :as global-field-service]
   [ardoq.service.hook-service :as hook-service]
   [ardoq.service.model-service :as model-service]
   [ardoq.service.workspace-authorization :as workspace-auth]
   [ardoq.utils :as util]
   [ardoq.utils.component-type-util :as component-type-util]
   [ardoq.utils.model-utils :as model-util]
   [com.stuartsierra.component :as component]
   [medley.core :as medley]))

(def service-config (merge component-type-repo/config
                           {:service :component-type-service
                            ::authorization-service/policy
                            {:read authorization-service/reader+
                             :overview authorization-service/open
                             :fields-by-type-name authorization-service/reader+
                             :get-usage authorization-service/admin}}))

(defn- bulk-create*! [ctx component-types]
  (some->> component-types
           seq
           (map core/assign-id!)
           (entity/create-many! component-type-repo/config ctx)))

(defn- bulk-update*! [ctx component-types]
  (entity/update-many! component-type-repo/config ctx component-types))

(defn- bulk-delete*! [ctx component-types]
  (some->> component-types
           seq
           component-type-repo/by-component-types
           (entity/delete-by-query! component-type-repo/config ctx)))

;; NOTE: The `bulk-<action>!` functions updates models and that updating
;; models triggers a hook that runs `bulk-<action>*!` to propagate changes
;; to the component types.
;; So, if you just need a simple update of component types *without*
;; updating the associated model, you probably want `bulk-<action>*!` instead.
;; When using the full `bulk-<action>!`, make sure you're not accidentally
;; creating a cycle of model and component type updates.

(defn bulk-create!
  "Creates component types by updating all their respective models.
  Returns the created component types."
  [{:keys [model-service] :as component-type-service} ctx component-types]
  (pg/with-transaction-on-org ctx
    (doseq [[model-id create-comp-types] (group-by :modelId component-types)]
      (let [old-model (model-service/query-one-model-or-org-template! ctx (pq/by-id model-id))
            old-comp-types (entity/query! service-config ctx (component-type-repo/by-model-id model-id))
            updated-comp-types (into old-comp-types create-comp-types)
            updated-model (model-util/recreate-root old-model updated-comp-types)]
        (model-service/update! model-service ctx updated-model)))
    (entity/query! service-config ctx (component-type-repo/by-component-types component-types))))

(defn bulk-update!
  "Updates component types by updating all their respective models.
  Returns the updated component types."
  [{:keys [model-service] :as component-type-service} ctx component-types]
  (pg/with-transaction-on-org ctx
    (doseq [[model-id update-comp-types] (group-by :modelId component-types)]
      (let [old-model (model-service/query-one-model-or-org-template! ctx (pq/by-id model-id))
            updated-type-ids (util/fn-set :id update-comp-types)
            old-comp-types (entity/query! service-config ctx (component-type-repo/by-model-id model-id))
            updated-comp-types (->> old-comp-types
                                    (remove #(contains? updated-type-ids (:id %)))
                                    (into update-comp-types))
            updated-model (model-util/recreate-root old-model updated-comp-types)]
        (model-service/update! model-service ctx updated-model)))
    (entity/query! service-config ctx (component-type-repo/by-component-types component-types))))

(defn bulk-delete!
  "Deletes component types by updating all their respective models.
  Returns the deleted component types."
  [{:keys [model-service] :as component-type-service} ctx component-types]
  (pg/with-transaction-on-org ctx
    (let [deleted-entities (entity/query! service-config ctx (component-type-repo/by-component-types component-types))]
      (doseq [[model-id delete-comp-types] (group-by :modelId component-types)]
        (let [old-model (model-service/query-one-model-or-org-template! ctx (pq/by-id model-id))
              delete-ids (util/fn-set :id delete-comp-types)
              old-comp-types (entity/query! service-config ctx (component-type-repo/by-model-id model-id))
              updated-comp-types (remove #(contains? delete-ids (:id %)) old-comp-types)
              updated-model (model-util/recreate-root old-model updated-comp-types)]
          (model-service/update! model-service ctx updated-model)))
      (hook-service/run-hooks! hook-service/hooks ctx ::hook-service/component-types-deleted
                               (util/fn-set :id deleted-entities))
      deleted-entities)))

(defn create-from-model! [ctx model]
  (->> model
       component-type-util/->component-types
       (bulk-create*! ctx)
       dorun)
  model)

(defn update-component-types*!
  [ctx model-id db-component-types old-component-types updated-component-types]
  (let [add-model-id #(assoc % :modelId model-id)
        id->db-component-types (medley/index-by :id db-component-types)
        id->existing (medley/index-by :id old-component-types)
        id->updated (medley/index-by :id updated-component-types)
        enrich-with-db-entity #(merge (get id->db-component-types (:id %)) %)
        {:keys [create update delete]} (util/change-set id->existing id->updated)]
    (pg/with-transaction-on-org ctx
      (bulk-create*! ctx (map (comp component-type-util/prune add-model-id id->updated) create))
      (bulk-update*! ctx (map (comp component-type-util/prune add-model-id enrich-with-db-entity id->updated) update))
      (bulk-delete*! ctx (map (comp component-type-util/prune add-model-id id->existing) delete)))))

(defn update-component-types! [ctx {:keys [old-model new-model]}]
  (let [model-id (core/id old-model)
        db-component-types (entity/query! component-type-repo/config ctx (component-type-repo/by-model-id model-id))
        old-component-types (component-type-util/->component-types old-model)
        updated-component-types (component-type-util/->component-types new-model)]
    (update-component-types*! ctx model-id db-component-types old-component-types updated-component-types)))

(defrecord ComponentTypeService [model-service event-service track-service]
  component/Lifecycle
  (start [this]
    (hook-service/add-hook! hook-service/hooks
                            ::after-model-but-before-types-updated
                            ::hook-service/after-model-but-before-types-updated
                            update-component-types!
                            :scenario-enabled)
    (hook-service/add-hook! hook-service/hooks
                            ::after-model-but-before-types-created
                            ::hook-service/after-model-but-before-types-created
                            create-from-model!
                            :scenario-enabled)
    this)
  (stop [this]
    (hook-service/remove-hook! hook-service/hooks
                               ::after-model-but-before-types-updated
                               ::hook-service/after-model-but-before-types-updated)
    (hook-service/remove-hook! hook-service/hooks
                               ::after-model-but-before-types-created
                               ::hook-service/after-model-but-before-types-created)
    this))

(defn component-type-service [_config]
  (map->ComponentTypeService service-config))

(defn- annotate-with-global-field-ids* [overview-rows applicability-rows]
  (let [ct-id->field-ids (core/map-group-by :componentTypeId :globalFieldId applicability-rows)]
    (mapv #(assoc % :globalFieldIds (get ct-id->field-ids (core/id %) []))
          overview-rows)))

(defn component-type-overview [ctx
                               {workspace-ids :workspace/ids
                                :as _permission_boundary}]
  (let [overview (->> (component-type-repo/component-type-overview-user workspace-ids)
                      (repo/execute! service-config ctx))
        ct-ids (core/id-set overview)
        applicability (when (seq ct-ids)
                        (entity/query! global-field-component-type-repo/config ctx
                                       (global-field-component-type-repo/by-component-type-ids
                                        ct-ids)))]
    (annotate-with-global-field-ids* overview applicability)))

(defn full-component-type-overview!
  "Returns all component types in the system, regardless of workspace permissions. For internal use only, e.g. for
   metrics collection."
  [ctx]
  (repo/execute! service-config ctx component-type-repo/component-type-overview-all))

(defn query!
  ([ctx q] (entity/query! service-config ctx q))
  ([ctx q columns] (entity/query! service-config ctx q columns)))

(defn query-one! [ctx q]
  (entity/query-one! service-config ctx q))

(defn workspace-component-type-names [ctx workspace-ids]
  (->> (component-type-repo/by-workspace-ids workspace-ids)
       (query! ctx)
       (map :name)
       (distinct)))

(defn fields-by-component-type-name [ctx component-type-name]
  (let [component-types (query! ctx (component-type-repo/by-component-type-name component-type-name))
        workspaces (when (seq component-types)
                     (->> (entity/query! workspace-repo/config ctx
                                         (workspace-repo/by-models (util/fn-set :modelId component-types)))
                          (authorization-service/filter-authorized workspace-auth/authorization-policy ctx :read)))
        global-fields (when (seq component-types)
                        (global-field-service/global-fields!
                         ctx (global-field-repo/by-applied-to-component-type-name component-type-name)))
        applicability (when (seq global-fields)
                        (entity/query! global-field-component-type-repo/config ctx
                                       (global-field-component-type-repo/by-field-names (map :name global-fields))))]
    {:workspaces (or workspaces [])
     :component-types (or component-types [])
     :global-fields (or global-fields [])
     :applicability (or applicability [])}))

   [medley.core :as medley]))

(def service-config (merge reference-type-repo/config
                           {:service :reference-type-service
                            ::authorization-service/policy
                            {:read authorization-service/reader+
                             :fields-by-type-name authorization-service/reader+}}))

(defn- bulk-create*! [ctx reference-types]
  (->> reference-types
       (map core/assign-id!)
       (entity/create-many! reference-type-repo/config ctx)))

(defn- bulk-update*! [ctx reference-types]
  (entity/update-many! reference-type-repo/config ctx reference-types))

(defn- bulk-delete*! [ctx reference-types]
  (->> reference-types
       reference-type-repo/by-reference-types
       (entity/delete-by-query! reference-type-repo/config ctx)))

;; NOTE: The `bulk-<action>!` functions updates models and that updating
;; models triggers a hook that runs `bulk-<action>*!` to propagate changes
;;to the reference types.
;; So, if you just need a simple update of reference types *without*
;; updating the associated model, you probably want `bulk-<action>*!` instead.
;; When using the full `bulk-<action>!`, make sure you're not accidentally
;; creating a cycle of model and reference type updates.

(defn bulk-create!
  "Creates reference types by updating all their respective models.
  Returns the created reference types."
  [{:keys [model-service] :as reference-type-service} ctx reference-types]
  (pg/with-transaction-on-org ctx
    (doseq [[model-id create-ref-types] (group-by :modelId reference-types)]
      (let [old-model (model-service/query-one-model-or-org-template! ctx (pq/by-id model-id))
            updated-model (model-util/upsert-reference-types old-model create-ref-types)]
        (model-service/update! model-service ctx updated-model)))
    (entity/query! service-config ctx (reference-type-repo/by-reference-types reference-types))))

(defn bulk-update!
  "Updates reference types by updating all their respective models.
  Returns the updated reference types."
  [{:keys [model-service] :as reference-type-service} ctx reference-types]
  (pg/with-transaction-on-org ctx
    (doseq [[model-id update-ref-types] (group-by :modelId reference-types)]
      (let [old-model (model-service/query-one-model-or-org-template! ctx (pq/by-id model-id))
            updated-model (model-util/upsert-reference-types old-model update-ref-types)]
        (model-service/update! model-service ctx updated-model)))
    (entity/query! service-config ctx (reference-type-repo/by-reference-types reference-types))))

(defn bulk-delete!
  "Deletes reference types by updating all their respective models.
  Returns the deleted reference types."
  [{:keys [model-service] :as reference-type-service} ctx reference-types]
  (pg/with-transaction-on-org ctx
    (let [deleted-entities (entity/query! service-config ctx (reference-type-repo/by-reference-types reference-types))]
      (doseq [[model-id delete-ref-types] (group-by :modelId reference-types)]
        (let [old-model (model-service/query-one-model-or-org-template! ctx (pq/by-id model-id))
              updated-model (model-util/delete-reference-types old-model delete-ref-types)]
          (model-service/update! model-service ctx updated-model)))
      deleted-entities)))

(defn create-from-model! [ctx model]
  (->> model
       reference-type-util/->reference-types
       (bulk-create*! ctx)
       dorun)
  model)

(defn update-reference-types*!
  [ctx model-id db-reference-types old-reference-types updated-reference-types]
  (let [add-model-id #(assoc % :modelId model-id)
        id->db-reference-types (medley/index-by :id db-reference-types)
        id->existing (medley/index-by :id old-reference-types)
        id->updated (medley/index-by :id updated-reference-types)
        enrich-with-db-entity #(merge (get id->db-reference-types (:id %)) %)
        {:keys [create update delete]} (util/change-set id->existing id->updated)]
    (pg/with-transaction-on-org ctx
      (bulk-create*! ctx (map (comp reference-type-util/prune add-model-id id->updated) create))
      (bulk-update*! ctx (map (comp reference-type-util/prune add-model-id enrich-with-db-entity id->updated) update))
      (bulk-delete*! ctx (map (comp reference-type-util/prune add-model-id id->existing) delete)))))

(defn update-reference-types! [ctx {:keys [old-model new-model]}]
  (let [model-id (core/id old-model)
        db-reference-types (entity/query! reference-type-repo/config ctx (reference-type-repo/by-model-id model-id))
        old-reference-types (reference-type-util/->reference-types old-model)
        updated-reference-types (reference-type-util/->reference-types new-model)]
    (update-reference-types*! ctx model-id db-reference-types old-reference-types updated-reference-types)))

(defrecord ReferenceTypeService [model-service event-service track-service]
  component/Lifecycle
  (start [this]
    (hook-service/add-hook! hook-service/hooks
                            ::after-model-but-before-types-updated
                            ::hook-service/after-model-but-before-types-updated
                            update-reference-types!
                            :scenario-enabled)
    (hook-service/add-hook! hook-service/hooks
                            ::after-model-but-before-types-created
                            ::hook-service/after-model-but-before-types-created
                            create-from-model!
                            :scenario-enabled)
    this)
  (stop [this]
    (hook-service/remove-hook! hook-service/hooks
                               ::after-model-but-before-types-updated
                               ::hook-service/after-model-but-before-types-updated)
    (hook-service/remove-hook! hook-service/hooks
                               ::after-model-but-before-types-created
                               ::hook-service/after-model-but-before-types-created)
    this))

(defn reference-type-service [_config]
  (map->ReferenceTypeService service-config))

(defn- annotate-with-global-field-ids* [overview-rows applicability-rows]
  (let [rt-id->field-ids (core/map-group-by :referenceTypeId :globalFieldId applicability-rows)]
    (mapv #(assoc % :globalFieldIds (get rt-id->field-ids (core/id %) []))
          overview-rows)))

(defn reference-type-overview [ctx
                               {workspace-ids :workspace/ids
                                :as _permission-boundary}]
  (let [overview (->> (reference-type-repo/reference-type-overview-user workspace-ids)
                      (repo/execute! service-config ctx))
        rt-ids (core/id-set overview)
        applicability (when (seq rt-ids)
                        (entity/query! global-field-reference-type-repo/config ctx
                                       (global-field-reference-type-repo/by-reference-type-ids
                                        rt-ids)))]
    (annotate-with-global-field-ids* overview applicability)))

(defn query!
  ([ctx q] (entity/query! service-config ctx q))
  ([ctx q columns] (entity/query! service-config ctx q columns)))

(defn query-one! [ctx q]
  (entity/query-one! service-config ctx q))

(defn workspace-reference-type-names [ctx workspace-ids]
  (->> [:in :modelId
        (workspace-repo/select-model-by-workspace-ids workspace-ids)]
       (query! ctx)
       (map :name)
       (distinct)))

(defn unique-type-names-in-workspace-ids-within-permitted-workspace-ids
  [ctx workspace-ids permitted-workspace-ids]
  (->>
   (-> (hh/with [:unique-reference-types
                 (reference-repo/unique-reference-types-in-workspace-ids-within-permitted-workspace-ids
                  workspace-ids permitted-workspace-ids)])
       (hh/select-distinct :rt.name)
       (hh/from [:reference_type :rt])
       (hh/join [:unique-reference-types :urt]
                (pq/and [:= :rt.modelId :urt.model]
                        [:= :rt.id :urt.type])))
   (repo/execute! reference-type-repo/config ctx)
   (map :name)))

(defn fields-by-reference-type-name [ctx reference-type-name]
  (let [reference-types (query! ctx (reference-type-repo/by-name reference-type-name))
        workspaces (when (seq reference-types)
                     (->> (entity/query! workspace-repo/config ctx
                                         (workspace-repo/by-models (util/fn-set :modelId reference-types)))
                          (authorization-service/filter-authorized workspace-auth/authorization-policy ctx :read)))
        global-fields (when (seq reference-types)
                        (global-field-service/global-fields!
                         ctx (global-field-repo/by-applied-to-reference-type-name reference-type-name)))
        applicability (when (seq global-fields)
                        (entity/query! global-field-reference-type-repo/config ctx
                                       (global-field-reference-type-repo/by-field-names (map :name global-fields))))]
    {:workspaces (or workspaces [])
     :reference-types (or reference-types [])
     :global-fields (or global-fields [])
     :applicability (or applicability [])}))

(ns ardoq.api.model-api
  (:require
   [ardoq.api.crud-api-v2 :as crud-api]
   [ardoq.api.crud-api-v3 :as crud-v3]
   [ardoq.persistence.model-repo :as model-repo]
   [ardoq.router :as router]
   [ardoq.specs :as specs]
   [ardoq.utils.model-utils :as model-utils]
   [clojure.spec.alpha :as s]
   [reitit.core :as r]
   [reitit.ring :as ring]))

(defmethod crud-api/post-read! :model-service [service _ctx document]
  (->> document
       (model-utils/order-component-types)
       (crud-api/camelize-keys service)))

(s/def ::model-with-metadata (s/merge ::model-repo/model ::crud-api/metadata))
(s/def ::models (s/coll-of ::model-with-metadata))

(s/def ::create ::model-repo/model-data)
(s/def ::update ::model-repo/model)

(def crud-config
  {:entity-string "model"
   :route-name-prefix ::crud
   :specs {:create ::create
           :update ::update}
   :service :model-service
   :overrides {::crud-v3/by-id {:responses {200 {:body ::model-with-metadata}}
                                :conflicting true}
               ::crud-v3/delete {:responses {204 {}}}
               ::crud-v3/patch {:responses {200 {:body ::model-with-metadata}}
                                :parameters {:body ::crud-v3/non-empty-request-body}}
               ::crud-v3/all {:swagger {:public false}
                              :responses {200 {:body ::models}}}
               ::crud-v3/rename {:swagger {:public false}}
               ::crud-v3/revisions {:swagger {:public false}}}})

(s/def ::maxReferenceTypeKey (s/nilable ::model-repo/maxReferenceTypeKey))

(s/def ::create8506 (s/keys :req-un [::specs/description
                                     ::model-repo/referenceTypes
                                     ::maxReferenceTypeKey
                                     ::model-repo/root
                                     ::model-repo/startView
                                     ::model-repo/defaultViews
                                     ::model-repo/blankTemplate
                                     ::model-repo/flexible
                                     ::model-repo/category]))

(s/def ::update8506 (s/merge ::specs/identifiable
                             ::model-repo/model-data
                             ::specs/named))

(def model-api
  (router/merge-routers
   (ring/router
    [;; TODO this is a temporary override of the `create-model` handler
     ;; to handle API clients that don't set `:maxReferenceTypeKey` key.
     ;; Once we fully handle this on the backend, this handler can be removed.
     ["" {:post {:name ::create
                 :responses {201 {:body ::model-with-metadata}}
                 :parameters {:body ::create8506}
                 :swagger {:public true}
                 :handler (fn [{{document :body} :parameters
                                ctx :ctx
                                {:keys [model-service] :as system} :system :as request}]
                            (let [helpfully-updated-document (model-utils/helpfully-create-max-ref-types document)]
                              ((crud-api/create* model-service ctx helpfully-updated-document) request)))}}]
     ["/:id" {:parameters {:path {:id ::specs/id}}}
      ;; TODO this is a temporary override of the `update-model` handler
      ;; to handle API clients that don't update `:maxReferenceTypeKey` key. It
      ;; will gracefully handle certain cases which are still valid. See ARD-8436.
      ;; Once we fully handle this on the backend, this handler can be removed.
      ["" {:put {:name ::update
                 :swagger {:public true}
                 :responses {200 {:body ::model-with-metadata}}
                 :parameters {:body ::update8506}
                 :handler (fn [{{document :body
                                 {:keys [id]} :path} :parameters
                                ctx :ctx
                                {:keys [model-service] :as system} :system :as request}]
                            (let [helpfully-updated-document (model-utils/helpfully-update-max-ref-types document)]
                              ((crud-api/update* model-service ctx id helpfully-updated-document) request)))}}]]]
    (update router/default-options :data assoc :swagger {:tags ["Model API"]}))
   (ring/router
    (r/routes (-> (crud-v3/crud-api crud-config)
                  (router/remove-routes-by-name [::crud-update ::crud-create])))
    (update router/default-options :data assoc :swagger {:tags ["Model API"] :public true}))))
