(ns ardoq.api.component-type-api
  (:require
   [ardoq.api.crud-api-v2 :as crud-api]
   [ardoq.api.crud-api-v3 :as crud-v3]
   [ardoq.api.deliberator :as liberator]
   [ardoq.mcp.oauth-scope :as mcp-oauth-scope]
   [ardoq.persistence.postgres.postgres-query :as pq]
   [ardoq.router :as router]
   [ardoq.search.permission-boundary :as permission-boundary]
   [ardoq.service.component-type-service :as component-type-service]
   [ardoq.specs :as specs]
   [ardoq.utils.field-utils :as field-util]
   [reitit.core :as r]
   [reitit.ring :as ring]))

(def crud-config
  {:entity-string "component-type"
   :route-name-prefix ::crud-api
   :service :component-type-service
   :path-overrides {"/:id" {:conflicting true}}})

(defn component-type-overview [{ctx :ctx
                                {:keys [component-type-service]} :system :as req}]
  (->> {:allowed? (fn [_] (crud-api/allowed? component-type-service ctx :overview))
        :handle-ok (fn [_]
                     (component-type-service/component-type-overview
                      ctx (permission-boundary/default-permission-boundary ctx)))}
       (merge (crud-api/query-defaults component-type-service ctx pq/all))
       (liberator/run-resource req)))

(defn fields-by-type-name [{{{:keys [type-name]} :path} :parameters
                            ctx :ctx
                            {:keys [component-type-service]} :system :as req}]
  (->> {:allowed? (fn [_]
                    (crud-api/allowed? component-type-service
                                       ctx
                                       :fields-by-type-name
                                       (component-type-service/fields-by-component-type-name ctx type-name)))
        :handle-ok (fn [{:keys [::crud-api/instance]}]
                     (field-util/format-fields-by-metamodel-type-name instance :componentTypeId :component-types))}
       (merge crud-api/resource-defaults)
       (liberator/run-resource req)))

(def component-type-api
  (ring/router
   [["/overview" {:get {:name ::component-type-overview
                        :handler component-type-overview}
                  :conflicting true
                  :swagger {:public false}}]
    ["/fields/:type-name" {:get {:name ::fields-by-type-name
                                 :handler fields-by-type-name
                                 :mcp-oauth/scopes mcp-oauth-scope/mcp-read-only-scopes
                                 :parameters {:path {:type-name ::specs/non-empty-string}}}
                           :conflicting true
                           :swagger {:public false}}]
    (r/routes (crud-v3/read-only-api crud-config))]
   (assoc router/default-options :data {:swagger {:tags ["Component-Type API"]}})))

25	(defn create-resource!
26	  [{{document :body} :parameters
27	    {:keys [field-service]} :system
28	    context :ctx
29	    :as req}]
30	  (->> {:malformed? (fn [_]
31	                      (if-not (map? document)
32	                        true
33	                        (let [entity (crud-api/pre-create! field-service context document)
34	                              input-error (crud-api/validate-no-id document)]
35	                          (if-let [errors (and input-error {:errors input-error})]
36	                            [true errors]
37	                            [false {::crud-api/entity entity}]))))
38	        :allowed? (fn [{:keys [::crud-api/entity]}]
39	                    (authorization-service/authorized? field-service context
40	                                                       (authorization-service/->op :create entity)))
41	        :processable? (fn [{:keys [::crud-api/entity]}]
42	                        (let [op {:action :create :entity entity}
43	                              result (field-service/processable? context op)]
44	                          [(not (client-utils/error? result)) result]))
45	        :post! (fn [{:keys [::crud-api/entity]}]
46	                 {::crud-api/instance (->> entity
47	                                           (field-service/create! field-service context)
48	                                           (crud-api/post-create! field-service context))})
49	        :new? crud-api/exists?
50	        :handle-created (fn [{:keys [::crud-api/instance] :as liberator-ctx}]
51	                          (crud-api/redirect-to-created liberator-ctx instance))}
52	       (merge crud-api/resource-defaults)
53	       (liberator/run-resource req)))

62	                          (field-service/add-calculated-field-history context)

90	                                                (entity/query-one! workspace-repo/config

93	                        (when (crud-api/allowed? workspace-service/service-config context :recalculate-fields workspace)
94	                          {::fields fields}))))
95	        :respond-with-entity? true

   [ardoq.specs :as specs]
   [ardoq.utils.field-utils :as field-util]
   [clojure.spec.alpha :as s]
   [reitit.ring :as ring]))

(defn create-resource!
  [{{document :body} :parameters
    {:keys [field-service]} :system
    context :ctx
    :as req}]
  (->> {:malformed? (fn [_]
                      (if-not (map? document)
                        true
                        (let [entity (crud-api/pre-create! field-service context document)
                              input-error (crud-api/validate-no-id document)]
                          (if-let [errors (and input-error {:errors input-error})]
                            [true errors]
                            [false {::crud-api/entity entity}]))))
        :allowed? (fn [{:keys [::crud-api/entity]}]
                    (authorization-service/authorized? field-service context
                                                       (authorization-service/->op :create entity)))
        :processable? (fn [{:keys [::crud-api/entity]}]
                        (let [op {:action :create :entity entity}
                              result (field-service/processable? context op)]
                          [(not (client-utils/error? result)) result]))
        :post! (fn [{:keys [::crud-api/entity]}]
                 {::crud-api/instance (->> entity
                                           (field-service/create! field-service context)
                                           (crud-api/post-create! field-service context))})
        :new? crud-api/exists?
        :handle-created (fn [{:keys [::crud-api/instance] :as liberator-ctx}]
                          (crud-api/redirect-to-created liberator-ctx instance))}
       (merge crud-api/resource-defaults)
       (liberator/run-resource req)))

(defn find-all [{context :ctx :as req}]
  (->> {:allowed? (fn [_]
                    (let [fields (field-query-service/query! context pq/all)]
                      (crud-api/allowed-many? field-service/service-config context :read fields)))
        :handle-ok (fn [{:keys [::crud-api/instance]}]
                     (->> instance
                          (map (partial crud-api/post-read! field-service/service-config context))
                          (field-service/add-calculated-field-history context)
                          (metadata-service/flat)))}
       (merge crud-api/resource-defaults)
       (liberator/run-resource req)))

(defn global-fields
  [{context :ctx
    :as req}]
  (->> {:initialize-context (fn [_] {::crud-api/instance (field-service/global-fields! context)})
        :handle-ok (fn [{:keys [::crud-api/instance]}]
                     (map (partial crud-api/post-read! field-service/service-config context) instance))}
       (merge crud-api/resource-defaults)
       (liberator/run-resource req)))

(defn recalculate
  [{{{:keys [id]} :path} :parameters
    {:keys [calculated-field-service]} :system
    context :ctx
    :as req}]
  (->> {:allowed? (fn [_]
                    (let [{:keys [model] :as field} (field-query-service/query-one!
                                                     context (pq/by-id id))
                          fields (if (field-util/date-range-field? field)
                                   (field-query-service/query! context
                                                               (field-repo/by-date-range-name
                                                                (field-util/date-range-base-name field)))
                                   [field])]
                      (when-let [workspace (and (every? field-util/calculated-field? fields)
                                                (entity/query-one! workspace-repo/config
                                                                   context
                                                                   (workspace-repo/by-model-id model)))]
                        (when (crud-api/allowed? workspace-service/service-config context :recalculate-fields workspace)
                          {::fields fields}))))
        :respond-with-entity? true
        :new? false
        :post! (fn [{:keys [::fields]}]
                 (run! #(calculated-field-service/schedule-recalculation! calculated-field-service
                                                                          context
                                                                          %)
                       fields))
        :handle-ok {:status "recalculation queued"}}
       (merge crud-api/resource-defaults)
       (liberator/run-resource req)))

(defn recalculate-all-fields
  [{ctx :ctx
    :as req}]
  (->> {:allowed? (fn [_]
                    (crud-api/allowed? global-field-service/service-config ctx :recalculate))
        :respond-with-entity? true
        :new? false
        :post! (fn [_]
                 (calculated-field-service/schedule-recalculation-of-all-fields! ctx))
        :handle-ok {:status "recalculation queued"}}
       (merge crud-api/resource-defaults)
       (liberator/run-resource req)))

(defn- dependency-graph->response [{:keys [nodes edges unresolved] :as graph}]
  (assoc graph
         :nodes (->> nodes
                     (map #(update % :transformationTypes sort))
                     (sort-by :name))
         :edges (sort-by (juxt :from :to :transformationType) edges)
         :unresolved (sort-by (juxt :from :name) unresolved)))

(defn dependency-graph
  [{ctx :ctx :as req}]
  (->> {:allowed? (fn [_]
                    (crud-api/allowed? global-field-service/service-config ctx :get-dependency-graph))
        :handle-ok (fn [_]
                     (dependency-graph->response
                      (global-field-service/dependency-graph! ctx)))}
       (merge crud-api/resource-defaults)
       (liberator/run-resource req)))

(defn field-connections
  [{{{:keys [id]} :path} :parameters
    ctx :ctx
    :as req}]
  (->> {:allowed? (fn [_]
                    (crud-api/action-on-query-one-allowed? global-field-service/service-config
                                                           ctx
                                                           :get-dependency-graph
                                                           (pq/by-id id)))
        :handle-ok (fn [_]
                     (dependency-graph->response
                      (global-field-service/field-connections! ctx id)))}
       (merge crud-api/resource-defaults)
       (liberator/run-resource req)))

(defn generate-name
  [{{{:keys [label]} :body} :parameters
    ctx :ctx
    :as req}]
  (->> {:allowed? (fn [_]
                    (crud-api/allowed? field-service/service-config ctx :generate-name))
        :new? false
        :respond-with-entity? true
        :exists? true
        :post! (fn [_]
                 (let [generated-name (field-util/->field-name label)]
                   {::result {:name generated-name}}))
        :handle-ok ::result}
       (merge crud-api/resource-defaults)
       (liberator/run-resource req)))

(defn apply-to-types!
  [{{{:keys [id]} :path
     {:keys [componentTypeIds referenceTypeIds]} :body} :parameters
    {:keys [field-service]} :system
    ctx :ctx
    :as req}]
  (->> {:allowed? (fn [_]
                    (crud-api/allowed? global-field-service/service-config ctx :apply-to-types))
        :new? false
        :respond-with-entity? true
        :post! (fn [_]
                 (let [applied (field-service/apply-global-field-to-types!
                                field-service ctx id componentTypeIds referenceTypeIds)]
                   {::result {:appliedFieldIds (mapv core/id applied)}}))
        :handle-ok ::result}
       (merge crud-api/resource-defaults)
       (liberator/run-resource req)))

(defn unapply-from-types!
  [{{{:keys [id]} :path
     {:keys [componentTypeIds referenceTypeIds]} :body} :parameters
    {:keys [field-service]} :system
    ctx :ctx
    :as req}]
  (->> {:allowed? (fn [_]
                    (crud-api/allowed? global-field-service/service-config ctx :unapply-from-types))
        :new? false
        :respond-with-entity? true
        :post! (fn [_]
                 (let [affected (field-service/unapply-global-field-from-types!
                                 field-service ctx id componentTypeIds referenceTypeIds)]
                   {::result {:affectedFieldIds (mapv core/id affected)}}))
        :handle-ok ::result}
       (merge crud-api/resource-defaults)
       (liberator/run-resource req)))

(s/def ::field-with-metadata (s/merge ::field-repo/field ::crud-api/metadata))

(s/def ::componentTypeIds (s/coll-of ::specs/id))
(s/def ::referenceTypeIds (s/coll-of ::specs/id))
(s/def ::apply-to-types-request
  (s/keys :req-un [::componentTypeIds ::referenceTypeIds]))
(s/def ::appliedFieldIds (s/coll-of ::specs/id))
(s/def ::apply-to-types-response (s/keys :req-un [::appliedFieldIds]))
(s/def ::affectedFieldIds (s/coll-of ::specs/id))
(s/def ::unapply-from-types-response (s/keys :req-un [::affectedFieldIds]))

(s/def ::status string?)
(s/def ::recalculate-response (s/keys :req-un [::status]))

(s/def ::label ::specs/non-empty-string)
(s/def ::generate-name-request (s/keys :req-un [::label]))
(s/def ::name ::specs/non-empty-string)
(s/def ::generate-name-response (s/keys :req-un [::name]))

(specs/sdef ::transformationType #{:gremlin :locally-derived})
(specs/sdef ::transformationTypes (s/coll-of ::transformationType))
(specs/sdef ::operation (s/nilable ::specs/non-empty-string))
(specs/sdef ::node (s/keys :req-un [::specs/_id ::name ::transformationTypes ::operation]))
(specs/sdef ::nodes (s/coll-of ::node))

(specs/sdef ::from ::specs/id)
(specs/sdef ::to ::specs/id)
(specs/sdef ::edge (s/keys :req-un [::from ::to ::transformationType]))
(specs/sdef ::edges (s/coll-of ::edge))

(specs/sdef ::unresolved-dependency (s/keys :req-un [::from ::name]))
(specs/sdef ::unresolved (s/coll-of ::unresolved-dependency))

(specs/sdef ::ids (s/coll-of ::specs/id))
(specs/sdef ::paths (s/coll-of (s/coll-of ::specs/id)))
(specs/sdef ::recursion (s/keys :req-un [::ids ::paths]))

(specs/sdef ::dependency-graph-response
            (s/keys :req-un [::nodes ::edges ::unresolved]
                    :opt-un [::recursion]))

(def field-api
  (ring/router
   [["" {:get {:name ::find-all
               :handler find-all}
         :post {:name ::create
                :summary "Create a field"
                :parameters {:body ::field-repo/entity}
                :responses {201 {:body ::field-with-metadata}}
                :handler create-resource!}}]
    ["/global/all" {:get {:name ::global-all
                          :handler global-fields}}]
    ["/global/recalculate" {:post {:name ::recalculate-all
                                   :handler recalculate-all-fields
                                   :responses {200 {:body ::recalculate-response}}}
                            :conflicting true}]
    ["/global/dependency-graph" {:get {:name ::dependency-graph
                                       :summary "The dependency graph between the global fields of the organization"
                                       :responses {200 {:body ::dependency-graph-response}}
                                       :handler dependency-graph}}]
    ["/global/:id/dependency-graph" {:parameters {:path {:id ::specs/id}}
                                     :get {:name ::field-connections
                                           :summary "The part of the dependency graph one global field takes part in"
                                           :responses {200 {:body ::dependency-graph-response}}
                                           :handler field-connections}}]
    ["/generate-name" {:post {:name ::generate-name
                              :parameters {:body ::generate-name-request}
                              :responses {200 {:body ::generate-name-response}}
                              :handler generate-name}
                       :conflicting true}]
    ["/:id" {:parameters {:path {:id ::specs/id}}
             :conflicting true}
     ["/recalculate" {:post {:name ::recalculate
                             :handler recalculate
                             :responses {200 {:body ::recalculate-response}}}}]
     ["/global/apply-to-types" {:post {:name ::apply-to-types
                                       :summary "Apply a global field to component and/or reference types"
                                       :parameters {:body ::apply-to-types-request}
                                       :responses {200 {:body ::apply-to-types-response}}
                                       :handler apply-to-types!}}]
     ["/global/unapply-from-types" {:post {:name ::unapply-from-types
                                           :summary "Unapply a global field from component and/or reference types"
                                           :parameters {:body ::apply-to-types-request}
                                           :responses {200 {:body ::unapply-from-types-response}}
                                           :handler unapply-from-types!}}]]]
   (assoc router/default-options :data {:swagger {:tags ["Field API"]}})))

(defn validate-field-name
  "Returns a value indicating what's wrong with naming a field the given value"
  [field-name]
  (cond
    (str/blank? field-name)
    :blank

    (not (re-matches attribute-name-re field-name))
    :invalid

    (or (str/starts-with? field-name "_")

[current-field updated-field]
  (let [matches-type? (validate-that-default-value-matches-type updated-field)]
    (cond
      (client-utils/error? matches-type?)
      matches-type?

      (attribute-name-changed? current-field updated-field)
      (client-utils/error ::client-utils/field-attribute-name-changed
                          []
                          {:name (:name updated-field)})

      (data-type-changed? current-field updated-field)
      (client-utils/error ::client-utils/field-data-type-changed
                          []
                          {:type (:type updated-field)})

      (display-name-changed? current-field updated-field)
      (client-utils/error ::client-utils/field-display-name-changed
                          []
                          {:label (:label updated-field)})

      (model-changed? current-field updated-field)
      (client-utils/error ::client-utils/field-model-changed
                          []
                          {:model (:model updated-field)})
      :else true)))

(defn- processable*?
  [ctx model added-confidential-fields {:keys [action entity new-entity] :as op}]
  (if (seq added-confidential-fields)
    (reactive-field-reads-confidential-error (field-util/field->attribute-name (or new-entity entity))
                                             added-confidential-fields)
    (case action
      :create
      (let [result (create-allowed? ctx model entity)]
        (if (true? result)
          op
          result))

      :update
      (let [result (update-allowed? entity new-entity)]
        (if (true? result)
          op
          result))

      :delete op

      :read op)))

(defn every-processable?
  "Validates multiple field operations. Returns true | client-utils/error"
  [ctx operations]
  (let [create-fields (->> operations
                           (filter #(= :create (:action %)))
                           (util/fn-set :entity))
        field-id->model (if (empty? create-fields)
                          {}
                          (let [field-id->model-id (core/index-by core/id :model create-fields)
                                models (model-service/query-and-add-org-templates! ctx (pq/by-ids (vals field-id->model-id)))
                                id->model (medley/index-by core/id models)]
                            (update-vals field-id->model-id #(get id->model %))))
        written-fields (keep (fn [{:keys [action entity new-entity]}]
                               (case action
                                 :create entity
                                 :update new-entity
                                 nil))
                             operations)
        field-name->added-confidential (reactive-field-name->confidential-dependencies! ctx written-fields)]
    (reduce (fn [acc {:keys [action entity new-entity] :as operation}]
              (let [model (get field-id->model (core/id entity))
                    written (case action :create entity :update new-entity nil)
                    added-confidential (some->> written
                                                field-util/field->attribute-name
                                                field-name->added-confidential)]
                (if-let [unprocessable (crud-service/unprocessable-response
                                        (processable*? ctx model added-confidential operation))]
                  (reduced unprocessable)
                  acc)))
            true
            operations)))

(defn processable?
  "Validates a single field operation. Returns op | client-utils/error"
  [ctx op]
  (every-processable? ctx [op]))

(defn ensure-processable!
  [ctx op]
  (let [op-or-error (processable? ctx op)]
    (when (client-utils/error? op-or-error)
      (let [error (::client-utils/errors op-or-error)]
        (client-utils/throw (:error-type error)
                            (:format-args error)
                            (:data error))))))

(defn global-fields! [ctx]
  (->> ctx
       global-field-service/global-fields!
       (map field-util/normalized-invariants)))

(defn remove-stale-options-and-rederive-per-workspace! [field-service ctx old-default-value field-name]
  (doseq [field (field-query-service/query! ctx (field-repo/by-name field-name))]
    (when-let [removed-options (field-util/option-removed? (assoc field :defaultValue old-default-value) field)]
      (remove-options! field-service ctx
                       component-repo/unredacted-config
                       (keyword (:name field))
                       (set removed-options)
                       (entity/query!
                        component-repo/unredacted-config ctx (component-repo/by-model-id (:model field))))
      (remove-options! field-service ctx

(specs/sdef ::parent (s/nilable ::specs/id))

(specs/sdef ::origin/_version ::specs/_version)
(specs/sdef ::origin (s/nilable (s/keys :req-un [::origin/id ::origin/_version])))

(specs/sdef ::componentTypeId (s/nilable ::specs/id))

(specs/sdef ::_order number?)

(specs/sdef ::shape (s/nilable string?))
(specs/sdef ::icon (s/nilable string?))
(specs/sdef ::image (s/nilable string?))
(specs/sdef ::component-key string?)

;Used by batch api so `parent` can be a batch id (not validated as object id)
(s/def ::entity-no-ids (s/keys :req-un [::rootWorkspace
                                        ::name]
                               :opt-un [::description
                                        ::children
                                        ::origin
                                        ::model
                                        ::typeId
                                        ::componentTypeId
                                        ::_version
                                        ::_order
                                        ::color
                                        ::shape
                                        ::icon
                                        ::image
                                        ::component-key]))

(s/def ::entity (s/merge ::entity-no-ids
                         (s/keys :opt-un [::parent])))

;; This implements specs/identifiable, but spec-tools annotations
;; didn't play correctly so we inline the required `:_id` instead
;; and annotate the `::_id` in this namespace
(s/def ::component (s/merge (s/keys :req-un [::_id])
                            ::entity))

(s/def ::autocomplete-payload (s/keys :req-un [::name ::type]))

(defn maybe-assoc-meta [component]
  (let [meta-to-persist (get-in component [core/ardoq-field-name :persistent])]
    (cond-> component
      (seq meta-to-persist) (assoc core/ardoq-persistent-field-name meta-to-persist))))

(defn remove-deps [component]
  (-> component
      maybe-assoc-meta
      (dissoc :children :type core/ardoq-field-name :references)))

(def minimal-scopedata-fields
  "Minimal set of component fields needed in scopedata by the frontend."
  #{:_id
    :_version
    :_order
    :name
    :description
    :parent
    :rootWorkspace
    :model
    :typeId
    :type
    :color
    :icon
    :image
    core/ardoq-field-name})

(def user-editable-non-custom-fields
  #{:name :parent :description :typeId
    :color :shape :icon :image})

(def non-custom-fields
  (set/union
   user-editable-non-custom-fields
   metadata-util/provenance-objects-fields
   #{:_id :rootWorkspace
     :isPublic
     :origin
     :model :_version
     :_order
     :componentKey :component-key
     :componentTypeId
     :createdBy :created-by
     :lastUpdated :last-updated
     :lastModifiedBy :last-modified-by
     :created ; TODO we need to define common keys in metadata-service and merge them with
      ; `column-keys` later in the postgres-repo
     :ardoqPersistent
     core/ardoq-persistent-field-name
     core/ardoq-field-name
     branch-tables/branch-column
     pq/ardoq-custom-fields-column}))

(defn pre-write [component old-component]
  (-> component
      (dissoc :component-key)
      (remove-deps)
      (set/rename-keys {core/ardoq-persistent-field-name :ardoqPersistent})
      (repo/gather-custom-fields old-component non-custom-fields)
      util/camelize-keys*))

(defn pre-write-redacted
  "This version of pre-write is aware that redacted confidential fields may
  have been submitted for update. Those redacted fields need to be removed from
  the component before writing, in order to prevent DATA LOSS."
  [field-access-context component old-component]
  (-> component
      (dissoc :component-key)
      (field-permission-util/remove-cf-fields-from-component-before-write
       field-access-context
       (:rootWorkspace old-component))
      (remove-deps)
      (set/rename-keys {core/ardoq-persistent-field-name :ardoqPersistent})
      (repo/gather-custom-fields old-component non-custom-fields)
      util/camelize-keys*))

(defn- post-read [component]
  (-> component
      (repo/spread-custom-fields)
      (branch-tables/->unbranched-entity)))

(defn- post-read-redacted [field-access-context component]
  (->> component
       (repo/spread-custom-fields)
       (field-permission-util/apply-field-permissions-one field-access-context)
       (branch-tables/->unbranched-entity)))

(def unredacted-config
  "BEWARE! Using `unredacted-config` could result in leakage of sensitive
  customer data to users that are not permitted to see it.

  'Unredacted' in this context relates to Ardoq's Confidential Fields feature.
  When a global field is marked as confidential, we redact (nil out) the values
  of confidential fields on all components that are queried using the
  `component-service/redacted-repo-config`.

  Generally you should strive to not use `unredacted-config` and are encouraged
  to think carefully about why you may need to use it instead of the query
  functions in `component-service` which have `redacted-repo-config` baked in."
  {:versioned? true
   :branched? true
   :prop->column-type-hint {pq/ardoq-custom-fields-column :jsonb}
   :spec ::component
   :entity-type :component
   :table "component"
   :scenario-field-overrides-table "scenario_component_calculated_field_overrides"
   :transform-keys {:componentKey :component-key
                    :ardoqPersistent :ardoq-persistent}
   :has-ardoqPersistent? true
   :pre-write-please-don't-use pre-write
   :post-read-please-don't-use post-read})

(s/fdef create-redaction-hooks
  :args (s/cat :field-access-context ::field-permission-util/field-access-context)
  :ret map?)

(defn create-redaction-hooks
  [{:keys [user-can-see-all-fields?] :as field-access-context}]
  {:pre-write-please-don't-use (if user-can-see-all-fields?
                                 pre-write
                                 (partial pre-write-redacted field-access-context))
   :post-read-please-don't-use (if user-can-see-all-fields?
                                 post-read
                                 (partial post-read-redacted field-access-context))})

(defn by-workspace-id [workspace-id]
  [:= :rootWorkspace workspace-id])

(ns ardoq.api.reference-api
  (:require
   [ardoq.api.crud-api-v2 :as crud-api]
   [ardoq.api.crud-api-v3 :as crud-v3]
   [ardoq.api.deliberator :as liberator]
   [ardoq.core :as core]
   [ardoq.persistence.component-repo :as component-repo]
   [ardoq.persistence.postgres-entity :as entity]
   [ardoq.persistence.postgres.postgres-query :as pq]
   [ardoq.persistence.reference-repo :as reference-repo]
   [ardoq.persistence.workspace-repo :as workspace-repo]
   [ardoq.router :as router]
   [ardoq.service.authorization-service :as authorization-service]
   [ardoq.service.reference-service :as reference-service]
   [ardoq.service.viewpoint-service.scope :as viewpoint-scope]
   [ardoq.service.workspace-service :as workspace-service]
   [ardoq.specs :as specs]
   [clojure.spec.alpha :as s]
   [reitit.core :as r]
   [reitit.ring :as ring]))

(s/def ::reference-with-metadata (s/merge ::reference-repo/reference ::crud-api/metadata))
(s/def ::references (s/coll-of ::reference-with-metadata))

(defn reference-search-get [{{{wid :workspace
                               field :field
                               value :value} :query} :parameters
                             context :ctx :as req}]
  (->> {:allowed? (constantly true) ;; Authorization here is checked in service layer per-reference, by workspace
        :exists? (constantly true)
        :handle-ok (fn [_] (->> (reference-service/search context wid field value)
                                (map (partial crud-api/post-read! reference-service/service-config context))))}
       (merge crud-api/resource-defaults)
       (liberator/run-resource req)))

(defn reference-search-post [{{{wid :workspace
                                field :field
                                value :value} :body} :parameters
                              context :ctx :as req}]
  (->> {:allowed? (constantly true) ;; Authorization here is checked in service layer per-reference, by workspace
        :exists? (constantly true)
        :new? false
        :respond-with-entity? true
        :can-post-to-missing? false
        :handle-ok (fn [_] (->> (reference-service/search context wid field value)
                                (map (partial crud-api/post-read! reference-service/service-config context))))}
       (merge crud-api/resource-defaults)
       (liberator/run-resource req)))

(defn- merge-references [{{{reference-id :id} :path payload :body} :parameters
                          {:keys [reference-service]} :system
                          :keys [ctx] :as req}]
  (->> {:new? false
        :respond-with-entity? true
        :malformed? (fn [_] (not= reference-id (core/id (:merged-reference-data payload))))
        :processable? (fn [{:keys [::crud-api/instance]}]
                        (crud-api/processable? reference-service ctx {:action :merge-references
                                                                      :entity instance
                                                                      :payload payload}))
        :allowed? (fn [_]
                    (when-let [surviving-allowed (crud-api/action-on-query-one-allowed?
                                                  reference-service ctx :merge-references
                                                  (pq/by-id reference-id))]
                      (when (reference-service/subsumed-refs-authorized?! reference-service ctx
                                                                          (:subsumed-reference-ids payload))
                        surviving-allowed)))
        :handle-ok (fn [_]
                     (reference-service/merge-references reference-service
                                                         ctx
                                                         (reference-service/->merge-references-payload (:merged-reference-data payload)
                                                                                                       (:subsumed-reference-ids payload))))}
       (merge crud-api/resource-defaults)
       (liberator/run-resource req)))

(s/def ::create ::reference-repo/entity)
(s/def ::update ::reference-repo/reference)

(def crud-config
  {:entity-string "reference"
   :route-name-prefix ::crud
   :specs {:create ::create
           :update ::update}
   :service :reference-service
   :overrides {::crud-v3/by-id {:responses {200 {:body ::reference-with-metadata}}
                                :conflicting true}
               ::crud-v3/delete {:responses {204 {}}}
               ::crud-v3/update {:responses {200 {:body ::reference-with-metadata}}
                                 :parameters {:body ::reference-repo/reference}}
               ::crud-v3/patch {:responses {200 {:body ::reference-with-metadata}}
                                :parameters {:body ::crud-v3/non-empty-request-body}}
               ::crud-v3/create {:responses {201 {:body ::reference-with-metadata}}
                                 :parameters {:body ::reference-repo/entity}}
               ::crud-v3/all {:swagger {:public false}
                              :responses {200 {:body ::references}}}}
   :path-overrides {"/:id" {:conflicting true}}})

(def spec-swaggers
  {::workspace {:swagger/type "string"
                :swagger/title "Workspace ID"
                :swagger/description "This *must* be the `rootWorkspace` of the reference. References contain both `rootWorkspace` and `targetWorkspace` attributes, depending on whether they connect components that span workspaces.\n\n This endpoint _only_ allows searching references in the `rootWorkspace`."
                :swagger/example :generate}
   ::field {:swagger/type "string"
            :swagger/title "Field Name"
            :swagger/description "The field name corresponds to the `name` (_not_ `label`) attribute on your entities. This may look different than what you see in-app as the \"human readible\" label. To find this value, please refer to the values on the entities themselves, or refer to the `name` attribute on your field of interest"
            :swagger/example ""}
   ::value {:swagger/type "string"
            :swagger/title "Field Value"
            :swagger/description "For `Text` fields, this accepts a regex string"
            :swagger/example ""}})

(specs/sdef ::workspace ::specs/id)
(specs/sdef ::field ::specs/non-empty-string)
(specs/sdef ::value ::specs/non-empty-string)

(s/def ::search-query-params (s/keys :req-un [::field ::value]
                                     :opt-un [::workspace]))
(s/def ::search-body-params (s/keys :req-un [::field ::value]
                                    :opt-un [::workspace]))
(s/def ::subsumed-reference-ids ::specs/ids)
(s/def ::merged-reference-data ::crud-v3/non-empty-request-body)
(s/def ::merge-references-request (s/keys :req-un [::subsumed-reference-ids
                                                   ::merged-reference-data]))

(s/def ::updated-reference ::reference-repo/reference)
(s/def ::deleted-reference-ids ::specs/ids)
(s/def ::updated-tags (s/coll-of :ardoq.persistence.tag-repo/tag))
(s/def ::merge-references-response (s/keys :req-un [::updated-reference
                                                    ::deleted-reference-ids
                                                    ::updated-tags]))

(s/def ::reference-ids ::specs/ids)
(s/def ::reference-scope-body (s/keys :req-un [::reference-ids]))

(specs/sdef ::rootWorkspace ::specs/id)
(specs/sdef ::source ::specs/id)
(specs/sdef ::target ::specs/id)

(s/def ::reference-type-suggestions-body
  (s/keys :req-un [::source ::target ::rootWorkspace]))

(defn- references-scopedata
  [{_ :system
    {{:keys [reference-ids]} :body} :parameters
    context :ctx
    :as req}]
  (->> {:can-post-to-missing? false
        :new? false
        :respond-with-entity? true
        :handle-ok (fn [{:keys [::crud-api/instance]}]
                     (viewpoint-scope/construct-reference-scopedata! context instance))}
       (merge (crud-api/query-defaults reference-service/service-config context
                                       (pq/by-ids reference-ids)))
       (liberator/run-resource req)))

(defn- sorted-reference-type-suggestions
  [{{:keys [reference-service] :as system} :system
    {{:keys [source] :as body} :body} :parameters
    ctx :ctx
    :as req}]
  (->> {:allowed? (fn [_]
                    (let [source-component (->> (pq/by-id source)
                                                (entity/query-one! component-repo/unredacted-config ctx))
                          workspace (->> (pq/by-id (:rootWorkspace body))
                                         (entity/query-one! workspace-repo/config ctx))]
                      (and (not-any? nil? [source-component workspace])
                           (= (:rootWorkspace source-component) (core/id workspace))
                           (authorization-service/authorized? workspace-service/service-config
                                                              ctx
                                                              (authorization-service/->op :read workspace)))))
        :new? false
        :respond-with-entity? true
        :handle-ok (fn [_]
                     {:sortedByMostUsedRefTypes
                      (reference-service/sorted-most-used-ref-types reference-service ctx body)})}
       (merge crud-api/resource-defaults)
       (liberator/run-resource req)))

(def reference-api
  (ring/router
   [["/scopedata" {:post {:name ::reference-scopedata
                          :parameters {:body ::reference-scope-body}
                          :handler references-scopedata
                          :allow-impersonation? true
                          :allow-readers-or-contributors? true}
                   :swagger {:public false}
                   :conflicting true}]
    ["/search" {:get {:name ::search
                      :handler reference-search-get
                      :summary "Search for references by field name and value."
                      :parameters {:query ::search-query-params}
                      :responses {200 {:description "References that matched the search"
                                       :body ::references}}}
                :post {:name ::search
                       :handler reference-search-post
                       :summary "Search for references by field name and value."
                       :parameters {:body ::search-body-params}
                       :responses {200 {:description "References that matched the search"
                                        :body ::references}}
                       :allow-impersonation? true
                       :allow-readers-or-contributors? true}
                :conflicting true}]
    ["/:id/merge" {:put {:name ::merge-reference
                         :parameters {:path {:id ::specs/id}
                                      :body ::merge-references-request}
                         :handler merge-references
                         :responses {200 {:body ::merge-references-response}}}}]
    ["/sorted-type-suggestions" {:post {:name ::sorted-reference-type-suggestions
                                        :parameters {:body ::reference-type-suggestions-body}
                                        :handler sorted-reference-type-suggestions}
                                 :swagger {:public false}
                                 :conflicting true}]
    (r/routes (crud-v3/crud-api crud-config))]
   (assoc router/default-options :data {:swagger {:public true
                                                  :tags ["Reference API"]}})))

32	    (->> (pq/by-id id)
33	         (crud-api/query-one-defaults service context)

59	  (merge {:name (util/join-keywords-with-dashes route-name-prefix :update)
60	          :summary (str "Update a " entity-string)
61	          :parameters {:body (:update specs)}
62	          :handler (fn [{{document :body

(ns ardoq.api.crud-api-v3
  "Automatic CRUD API for services. See `crud-api` for usage."
  (:require
   [ardoq.api.crud-api-v2 :as crud-api]
   [ardoq.api.deliberator :as liberator]
   [ardoq.persistence.postgres.postgres-query :as pq]
   [ardoq.router :as router]
   [ardoq.service.metadata-service :as metadata-service]
   [ardoq.specs :as specs]
   [ardoq.utils :as util]
   [clojure.spec.alpha :as s]
   [reitit.core :as r]
   [reitit.ring :as ring]))

(s/def ::non-empty-request-body some?)

(defn service->crud-config [service-config]
  {:entity-string (name (:entity-type service-config))
   :route-name-prefix ::crud
   :specs {:create ::non-empty-request-body
           :update ::non-empty-request-body}
   :service (:service service-config)})

;; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
;;                             Route Constructors
;; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

(defn by-id [service-kw {{{:keys [id]} :path} :parameters
                         context :ctx
                         system :system :as req}]
  (let [service (get system service-kw)]
    (->> (pq/by-id id)
         (crud-api/query-one-defaults service context)
         (liberator/run-resource req))))

(defn- crud-by-id [{:keys [route-name-prefix entity-string service] :as config}]
  (merge {:name (util/join-keywords-with-dashes route-name-prefix :by-id)
          :summary (str "Get a " entity-string)
          :crud-type :read-only
          :handler (partial by-id service)}
         (get-in config [:overrides ::by-id])))

(defn delete [service-kw
              {{{:keys [id]} :path} :parameters
               context :ctx
               system :system :as req}]
  (let [service (get system service-kw)]
    (->> id
         (crud-api/delete-defaults service context)
         (liberator/run-resource req))))

(defn- crud-delete [{:keys [route-name-prefix entity-string service] :as config}]
  (merge {:name (util/join-keywords-with-dashes route-name-prefix :delete)
          :summary (str "Delete a " entity-string)
          :handler (partial delete service)}
         (get-in config [:overrides ::delete])))

(defn- crud-update [{:keys [specs route-name-prefix entity-string service] :as config}]
  (merge {:name (util/join-keywords-with-dashes route-name-prefix :update)
          :summary (str "Update a " entity-string)
          :parameters {:body (:update specs)}
          :handler (fn [{{document :body
                          {:keys [id]} :path} :parameters
                         system :system :keys [ctx] :as request}]
                     ((crud-api/update* (service system) ctx id document) request))}
         (get-in config [:overrides ::update])))

(defn- crud-patch [{:keys [specs route-name-prefix entity-string service] :as config}]
  (merge {:name (util/join-keywords-with-dashes route-name-prefix :patch)
          :summary (str "Patch a " entity-string)
          :parameters {:body ::non-empty-request-body}
          :handler (fn [{{document :body
                          {:keys [id]} :path} :parameters
                         system :system :keys [ctx] :as request}]
                     ((crud-api/patch* (service system) ctx id document) request))}
         (get-in config [:overrides ::patch])))

(defn- crud-rename [{:keys [specs route-name-prefix entity-string service] :as config}]
  (merge {:name (util/join-keywords-with-dashes route-name-prefix :rename)
          :summary (str "Rename a " entity-string)
          :parameters {:body (s/merge ::specs/named ::specs/versioned)}
          :handler (fn [{{rename-request :body
                          {:keys [id]} :path} :parameters
                         system :system :keys [ctx] :as request}]
                     ((crud-api/rename* (service system) ctx id rename-request) request))}
         (get-in config [:overrides ::rename])))

(defn revisions [service-kw
                 {{{:keys [id revision]} :path} :parameters
                  context :ctx
                  system :system :as req}]
  (let [service (get system service-kw)
        revision (util/parse-long! revision)]
    (->> (crud-api/revisions-defaults service context id revision)
         (liberator/run-resource req))))

(defn- crud-revisions [{:keys [route-name-prefix entity-string service] :as config}]
  (merge {:name (util/join-keywords-with-dashes route-name-prefix :revisions)
          :crud-type :read-only
          :summary (str "Get revisions for a " entity-string)
          :handler (partial revisions service)}
         (get-in config [:overrides ::revisions])))

(defn- crud-create [{:keys [specs route-name-prefix entity-string service] :as config}]
  (merge {:name (util/join-keywords-with-dashes route-name-prefix :create)
          :summary (str "Create a " entity-string)
          :parameters {:body (:create specs)}
          :handler (fn [{{document :body} :parameters
                         system :system :keys [ctx] :as request}]
                     ((crud-api/create* (service system) ctx document) request))}
         (get-in config [:overrides ::create])))

(defn all [service-kw {context :ctx
                       system :system :as req}]
  (let [service (get system service-kw)]
    (->> (crud-api/query-defaults (metadata-service/flat service) context pq/all)
         (liberator/run-resource req))))

(defn- crud-all [{:keys [route-name-prefix entity-string service] :as config}]
  (merge {:name (util/join-keywords-with-dashes route-name-prefix :all)
          :summary (str "Get all " entity-string "s")
          :crud-type :read-only
          :responses {200 {:body sequential?}}
          :handler (partial all service)}
         (get-in config [:overrides ::all])))

;; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
;;                                Routes
;; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

(s/def ::revision (s/and (s/conformer util/string->long str) ::specs/pos-int))

(defn- all-routes [{:keys [path-overrides] :as config}]
  (ring/router
   [["" (merge {:post (crud-create config)
                :get (crud-all config)}
               (get path-overrides ""))]
    ["/:id" {:parameters {:path {:id ::specs/id}}}
     ["" (merge {:get (crud-by-id config)
                 :delete (crud-delete config)
                 :put (crud-update config)
                 :patch (crud-patch config)}
                (get path-overrides "/:id"))]
     ["/rename" (merge {:patch (crud-rename config)}
                       (get path-overrides "/rename"))]
     ["/versions/:revision"
      (merge {:parameters {:path {:revision ::revision}}
              :get (crud-revisions config)}
             (get path-overrides "/versions/:revision"))]]]
   router/default-options))

;; ------------------------------------
;;       Public API Functions
;; ------------------------------------

(defn read-only-api [config]
  (router/filter-router
   (fn [route] (= (:crud-type route) :read-only))
   (all-routes config)))

(defn crud-api
  "Create default CRUD routes for a service.

  Basic usage looks something like the following. More options are supported for the config.
  ```
  (s/def ::create ::example-repo/entity)
  (s/def ::update ::example-repo/example-widget)

  (def crud-config
    {:entity-string \"example-widget\"
     :route-name-prefix ::crud
     :specs {:create ::create
             :update ::update}
     :service :example-service})

  (def example-api
    (ring/router
     [(r/routes (crud-v3/crud-api crud-config))]
     (assoc router/default-options :data {:swagger {:tags [\"Example API\"]}})))
  ```

  The `entity` spec should contain the keys specific to this kind of entity, while the `example-widget` (think
  `component`, `reference`, etc) should extend `entity` with `identifiable` (not `versioned`, as that would make
  `_version` required for `repo/create!`.)

  The `service` must be registered in the Component System (see `ardoq.app`). A minimal service looks something like
  the following.
  ```
  (def service-config (merge example-repo/config
                             {:service :example-service
                              ::authorization-service/policy
                              {:read authorization-service/reader+
                               :create authorization-service/admin
                               :update authorization-service/admin
                               :delete authorization-service/admin}}))
  ```

  See the multimethods and protocols defined in `ardoq.service.crud-service` and `ardoq.api.crud-api-v2` for
  customization of the entity handling. There's also `:path-overrides` and `:overrides` in the config for customizing
  the routes themselves."
  [config]
  (all-routes config))

(defn service-config->crud-api-router [service-config swagger-api-name]
  (ring/router
   [(r/routes (crud-api (service->crud-config service-config)))]
   (update router/default-options :data assoc :swagger {:tags [swagger-api-name]})))

(defn bulk-create! [field-service ctx fields]
  (trace-service/with-span! ::bulk-create! {:create (count fields)}
    (let [created-fields (bulk-create-sans-hooks-and-events! field-service ctx fields)]
      (emit-events-after-fields-created! field-service ctx created-fields))))

(defn create! [{:keys [calculated-field-service] :as field-service} ctx field]
  (let [created (first (bulk-create! field-service ctx [field]))]
    (calculated-field-service/maybe-configure-calculated-fields! calculated-field-service ctx [created])
    created))

(defn create-preserving-existing-invariants!
  "Create a field, preserving global invariants from existing fields with the same name if they exist.

  When existing fields with the same name are found, the new field will be created using
  those fields' global invariant attributes (label, type, description, etc.) rather than
  the provided field's attributes. This maintains consistency across fields with the same name.

  If no existing fields with the same name exist, the field is created with its own attributes."
  [field-service ctx field]
  (let [{:keys [field-with-ensured-name siblings]} (ensured-name-and-siblings-from-field! field ctx)
        field-without-extras (dissoc field-with-ensured-name calculated-field-history/calculatedFieldExtras)]
    (if (empty? siblings)
      (create! field-service ctx field-without-extras)
      (let [sibling-invariants (field-util/normalized-invariants (first siblings))
            field-with-sibling-invariants (merge (apply dissoc field-without-extras
                                                        field-util/keys-that-have-to-be-equal)
                                                 sibling-invariants)]
        (create! field-service ctx field-with-sibling-invariants)))))

(defn bulk-create-preserving-existing-invariants!
  "Batch version of [[create-preserving-existing-invariants!]].
  Pre-applies sibling invariants in memory from a single batch query before bulk-inserting,
  so that ensure-global-field-invariant! inside bulk-create! does not throw on conflicts."
  [{:keys [calculated-field-service] :as field-service} ctx fields]
  (let [fields-with-ensured-names+siblings (ensured-names-and-siblings-from-fields! ctx fields)

(ns ardoq.api.metamodel-sync-api
  (:require
   [ardoq.api.crud-api-v2 :as crud-api]

   [ardoq.service.global-field-service :as global-field-service]
   [ardoq.service.metamodel-sync-service :as metamodel-sync-service]

   [ardoq.service.model-service :as model-service]
   [ardoq.specs :as specs]
   [ardoq.utils :as util]
   [clojure.set :as set]
   [clojure.spec.alpha :as s]
   [reitit.ring :as ring]))

(defn get-metamodel
  [{{{:keys [id]} :path} :parameters
    :keys [ctx]
    :as req}]
  (->> {:allowed? (fn [_]
                    (crud-api/action-on-query-one-allowed? model-service/service-config
                                                           ctx
                                                           :update
                                                           (model-repo/by-workspace-query (pq/by-id id))))
        :handle-ok (fn [{:keys [::crud-api/instance]}]
                     (let [result (metamodel-sync-service/model! ctx instance id)]
                       (set/rename-keys result {:workspace-id :workspaceId
                                                :component-types :componentTypes
                                                :reference-types :referenceTypes
                                                :flexible? :flexible})))}
       (merge crud-api/resource-defaults)
       (liberator/run-resource req)))

(defn sync-metamodel
  [{{{:keys [id]} :path
     {:keys [componentTypes referenceTypes fields flexible] :as payload} :body} :parameters
    {:keys [metamodel-sync-service] :as system} :system
    :keys [ctx]
    :as req}]
  (->> {:allowed? (fn [_]
                    (let [model (model-query-service/query-one! ctx (model-repo/by-workspace-query (pq/by-id id)))]
                      (when (authorization-service/authorized? metamodel-sync-service/service-config
                                                               ctx
                                                               {:action :sync-metamodel
                                                                :payload (assoc payload :model model)})
                        {::crud-api/instance model})))
        :processable? (fn [{:keys [::crud-api/instance]}]
                        (crud-api/processable? metamodel-sync-service
                                               ctx
                                               {:payload (merge payload {:model instance})}))
        :respond-with-entity? true
        :can-put-to-missing? false
        :new? false
        :handle-ok (fn [_]
                     (let [result (metamodel-sync-service/sync! metamodel-sync-service
                                                                ctx
                                                                {:workspace-id id
                                                                 :flexible? flexible
                                                                 :component-types componentTypes
                                                                 :reference-types referenceTypes
                                                                 :fields fields})]
                       (set/rename-keys result {:workspace-id :workspaceId
                                                :component-types :componentTypes
                                                :reference-types :referenceTypes
                                                :local-id->persisted-id :batchIds
                                                :flexible? :flexible})))}
       (merge crud-api/resource-defaults)
       (liberator/run-resource req)))

(defn global-fields
  [{:keys [ctx] :as req}]
  (->> {:initialize-context (fn [_] {::crud-api/instance (metamodel-sync-service/global-fields! ctx)})
        :handle-ok (fn [{:keys [::crud-api/instance]}]
                     instance)}
       (merge crud-api/resource-defaults)
       (liberator/run-resource req)))

(defn create-global-field
  [{{globalField :body} :parameters
    {:keys [metamodel-sync-service]} :system
    :keys [ctx]
    :as req}]
  (->> {:allowed? (fn [_]
                    (crud-api/allowed? field-service/service-config ctx :global-create))
        :processable? (fn [_]
                        (metamodel-sync-service/global-field-create-processable? ctx globalField))
        :respond-with-entity? true
        :post! (fn [_]
                 {::result
                  (metamodel-sync-service/create-global-field! metamodel-sync-service ctx globalField)})
        :handle-created ::result}
       (merge crud-api/resource-defaults)
       (liberator/run-resource req)))

(defn update-global-field
  [{{globalField :body} :parameters
    {:keys [metamodel-sync-service]} :system
    ctx :ctx
    :as req}]
  (->> {:allowed? (fn [_]
                    (crud-api/allowed? field-service/service-config ctx :update))
        :processable? (fn [_]
                        (metamodel-sync-service/global-field-update-processable? ctx globalField))
        :new? false
        :respond-with-entity? true
        :handle-ok (fn [_]
                     (metamodel-sync-service/update-global-field! metamodel-sync-service ctx globalField))}
       (merge crud-api/resource-defaults)
       (liberator/run-resource req)))

(defn delete-global-field
  [{{{:keys [id]} :path} :parameters
    {:keys [metamodel-sync-service field-service]} :system
    ctx :ctx
    :as req}]
  (->> {:allowed? (fn [_]
                    (let [global-field (global-field-service/query-one! ctx (pq/by-id id))]
                      (crud-api/allowed? field-service ctx :global-delete global-field)))
        :delete! (fn [{:keys [::crud-api/instance]}]
                   {::crud-api/instance
                    (metamodel-sync-service/delete-global-field! metamodel-sync-service ctx instance)})
        :delete-enacted? crud-api/exists?
        :handle-ok ::crud-api/instance}
       (merge crud-api/resource-defaults)
       (liberator/run-resource req)))

(defn recalculate-global-field
  [{{{:keys [id]} :path} :parameters
    {:keys [metamodel-sync-service global-field-service]} :system
    ctx :ctx
    :as req}]
  (->> {:allowed? (fn [_]
                    (crud-api/action-on-query-one-allowed? global-field-service ctx :recalculate (pq/by-id id)))
        :respond-with-entity? true
        :new? false
        :post! (fn [{:keys [::crud-api/instance]}]
                 (metamodel-sync-service/recalculate-global-field! metamodel-sync-service ctx instance))
        :handle-ok {:status "recalculation queued"}}
       (merge crud-api/resource-defaults)
       (liberator/run-resource req)))

(defn global-field-usage
  [{{{:keys [id]} :path} :parameters
    {:keys [global-field-service]} :system
    ctx :ctx
    :as req}]
  (->> {:allowed? (fn [_]
                    (crud-api/action-on-query-one-allowed? global-field-service ctx :get-usage (pq/by-id id)))
        :handle-ok (fn [{:keys [::crud-api/instance]}]
                     (-> (metamodel-sync-service/global-field-usage! ctx instance)
                         util/camelize-keys))}
       (merge crud-api/resource-defaults)
       (liberator/run-resource req)))

(defn implicit-references
  [{:keys [ctx] :as req}]
  (->> {:allowed? (fn [_] (crud-api/allowed? metamodel-sync-service/service-config ctx :list-implicit-references))
        :exists? (constantly true)
        :handle-ok (fn [_] (metamodel-sync-service/implicit-references! ctx))}

(defn suggest-reference-types

    {{:keys [rejectedSuggestions]} :body} :parameters
    {:keys [metamodel-sync-service]} :system
    :as req}]
  (->> {:allowed? (fn [_] (crud-api/allowed? metamodel-sync-service/service-config ctx :suggest-reference-types))
        :post! (fn [_]
                 {::crud-api/result
                  (metamodel-sync-service/suggest-reference-types!

(defmethod authorization-service/action-authorized? [:metamodel-sync-service :sync-metamodel]
  [_metamodel-sync-service-config ctx {:keys [payload] :as op}]
  (and (authorization-service/authorized? model-service/service-config ctx {:action :update
                                                                            :entity (:model payload)})
       (authorized-gremlin-changes? ctx op)))

(defn- processable?
  [ctx {:keys [payload] :as op}]
  (trace-service/with-span! ::processable? nil
    (let [{:keys [model flexible componentTypes referenceTypes fields]} payload
          referenced-comp-type-ids (set (remove nil? (mapcat :componentType fields)))
          referenced-ref-type-ids (set (remove nil? (mapcat :referenceType fields)))
          parent-comp-type-ids (set (remove nil? (map :parent componentTypes)))
          comp-type-ids (util/fn-set :_id componentTypes)
          ref-type-ids (util/fn-set :_id referenceTypes)
          comp-type-names (map :name componentTypes)
          ref-type-names (map :name referenceTypes)
          field-names (map :name fields)]
      (cond
        (empty? componentTypes)
        (client-util/throw ::client-util/cannot-delete-all-component-types)

        (not= (count field-names) (count (set field-names)))
        (let [duplicate-labels (some
                                (fn [[field occurrences]]
                                  (when (< 1 occurrences) (:label field)))
                                (frequencies fields))]
          (client-util/throw ::client-util/duplicate-field-names []
                             {:duplicate-names duplicate-labels}))

        (not= (count comp-type-names) (count (set comp-type-names)))
        (let [duplicate-names (some
                               (fn [[comp-type occurrences]]
                                 (when (< 1 occurrences) (:name comp-type)))
                               (frequencies componentTypes))]
          (client-util/throw ::client-util/duplicate-component-type-names []
                             {:duplicate-names duplicate-names}))

        (not= (count ref-type-names) (count (set ref-type-names)))
        (let [duplicate-names (some
                               (fn [[ref-type occurrences]]
                                 (when (< 1 occurrences) (:name ref-type)))
                               (frequencies referenceTypes))]
          (client-util/throw ::client-util/duplicate-reference-type-names []
                             {:duplicate-names duplicate-names}))

        (not (set/subset? referenced-comp-type-ids comp-type-ids))
        (let [missing (set/difference referenced-comp-type-ids comp-type-ids)]
          (client-util/throw ::client-util/cannot-delete-component-type-referenced-by-field []
                             {:missing-type-ids missing}))

        (not (set/subset? referenced-ref-type-ids ref-type-ids))
        (let [missing (set/difference referenced-ref-type-ids ref-type-ids)]
          (client-util/throw ::client-util/cannot-delete-reference-type-referenced-by-field []
                             {:missing-type-ids missing}))

        (not (set/subset? parent-comp-type-ids comp-type-ids))
        (let [missing (set/difference parent-comp-type-ids comp-type-ids)]
          (client-util/throw ::client-util/cannot-delete-referenced-parent-component-type []
                             {:missing-type-ids missing}))

        (metamodel-sync-util/invalid-parent-child-component-type-hierarchy componentTypes)
        (let [first-cycle (-> componentTypes
                              metamodel-sync-util/invalid-parent-child-component-type-hierarchy
                              first)]
          (client-util/throw ::client-util/invalid-parent-child-component-type-hierarchy []
                             {:type-id-cycle first-cycle}))

        (some? flexible)
        (client-util/throw-if-error (model-service/validate-flexibility ctx model (assoc model :flexible flexible)))

        :else
        op))))

# Save nugget

Capture one durable fact about the codebase into the shared workspace nuggets, with its source, so the next agent does not have to rediscover it.

A **nugget** is information that is *about the repo*, not about your task: a convention, a rule, a structural principle, a peculiarity, an explicit instruction found in documentation. It outlives the task that surfaced it and is useful to **any** agent — an augmentor about to write code, an enforcer judging conventions, an investigator orienting itself.

## What qualifies

Save it if another agent, arriving cold, would write worse code or waste effort without knowing it:

- **Unusual or repo-specific conventions** — a naming, layering, module or error-handling pattern that is consistent here but not standard practice generally.
- **Explicit documented instructions** — a README/CONTRIBUTING/CLAUDE.md/ADR/wiki page that states "do X this way" or "never do Y". Note where it says so.
- **Structural principles** — what lives in which layer or package and why; what the boundary rules are; where a given kind of code is registered.
- **Test, build and tooling peculiarities** — how tests must be run here, a fixture/harness requirement, a lint rule that bites, a generated artifact that must be regenerated rather than edited.
- **Exceptions and traps** — a place that deliberately violates the general rule, a deprecated path that still looks current, a helper that must be used instead of the obvious inline approach, an abstraction that is load-bearing in a non-obvious way.

## What does NOT qualify

- **Anything specific to the task at hand.** Findings that answer your current question belong in your report to your parent, not here. This is the most common misuse.
- Conclusions, plans, progress, or status of work in flight.
- General software practice that is not specific to this codebase.
- Anything already stated in a `CLAUDE.md`, or plainly visible from a file's name or location.
- A restatement of what some code does. A nugget is a rule or a principle, not a description of one function.
- Speculation. If you have not verified it, do not save it. "Two files do this" is a pattern worth one careful look, not yet a convention.

## Workflow

### 1. Locate the workspace

The agent workspace is the directory that sits alongside the repo roots and holds the `specs/` folder — in the Ardoq checkout that is `.aispace/`, but the name varies, so detect it rather than assuming:

```bash
# walk up from the working directory looking for the workspace
d=$PWD; while [ "$d" != "/" ]; do
  for c in "$d"/.aispace; do [ -d "$c" ] && echo "$c"; done
  d=$(dirname "$d"); done
```

Prefer a candidate that contains `specs/`. If several exist, pick the one nearest the repos you are working in. If none exists, do not invent a location elsewhere — create `nuggets/` inside the workspace the parent named, or ask.

Nugget files live in `<workspace>/nuggets/`. Create the directory if it is missing.

### 2. Check for duplication — before writing anything

Read what is already recorded. This is mandatory: the nugget files are shared, and a second copy of a known fact makes the whole set less trustworthy.

```bash
ls <workspace>/nuggets/
grep -ril "<distinctive keyword from your nugget>" <workspace>/nuggets/
```

Search on the distinctive terms of the fact itself — the namespace, helper, flag, file or rule name — not on your phrasing of it. Then read the files that hit. Outcomes:

Search on the distinctive terms of the fact itself — the namespace, helper, flag, file or rule name — not on your phrasing of it. Then read the files that hit. Outcomes:

- **Already recorded, same fact** → do not save. Say so in your report and move on.
- **Recorded but you have verified it more precisely, or found the authoritative source it lacked** → add the refinement to **your own** file, with a one-line cross-reference to the existing note (`See also: nuggets/<file>.md — "<nugget title>"`).
- **Recorded and now wrong or outdated** → record the correction in **your own** file, cite your evidence, and cross-reference the stale note. State plainly that it contradicts the earlier one.
- **Not recorded** → save it.

**Never edit or delete another agent's nugget file.** You only ever append to your own. Reconciling and reorganising the collected nuggets is a separate job.

### 3. Write it

One file per agent. Name it `<agent-type>-<YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS>.md`, timestamped at the agent's first nugget, e.g. `nuggets/investigator-20260916-143210.md`. If you save several nuggets during one run, **append** to that same file rather than creating more.

File header, written once:

```markdown
# Nuggets — <agent-type>, <YYYY-MM-DD>

Context: <one clause naming what this agent was doing when it found these — enough to judge the finding's provenance, no more.>
```

Then one block per nugget:

```markdown
## <short, declarative title stating the rule>

- **Kind:** convention | structure | documented-rule | test | build | exception | trap
- **Applies to:** <repo, package or path scope this holds within>
- **Source:** <path/to/file.clj:120> · <doc path or URL> · <command whose output shows it>
- **Confidence:** verified in N places | stated in documentation | single instance, unconfirmed
- **Nugget:** <the rule, stated as a rule in one or two sentences>
- **Comment:** <optional: why it matters, when it does not apply, what breaks if ignored>
```

Rules for the content:

- **State it as a rule**, in the imperative or as a general fact — not as a story about how you found it.
- **Always cite a source** a later agent can open: `file:line`, a doc path, a URL, or the exact command. A nugget without a source is not usable.
- **Be honest about confidence.** Mark a single unconfirmed instance as such rather than promoting it to a convention.
- **Scope it.** A rule that holds only in one package must say so; an over-broad nugget is worse than none.
- **Keep it short.** A few lines. No background, no narrative, no code blocks unless the exact text *is* the rule.

### 4. Report it in one line

Tell your parent, briefly: what you saved and where (`saved nugget "<title>" → nuggets/<file>.md`), or that the fact was already recorded. Never let the nugget displace or pad the answer your parent actually asked for.
